en: Try two greedy orders – reduce the first red as much as possible, then the second if budget remains; repeat with the roles swapped. Return the smaller resulting product.
ru: Do greedy orders try karta hai – pehle red ko jitna ho sake reduce karta hai, phir agar budget bache toh doosre ko; roles swap karke repeat karta hai. Chota resulting product return karta hai.

en: This function calculates the rank of a number based on its multiples of two given divisors and their LCM.
ru: Ye function ek number ki rank calculate karta hai do diye gaye divisors aur unke LCM ke multiples ke hisab se.

en: A mutable reference to a 2‑D vector ⟦0⟧ (rows × cols) and an integer ⟦1⟧.
ru: Ek 2-D vector ⟦0⟧ (rows × cols) ka mutable reference aur ek integer ⟦1⟧.

en: ⟦0⟧ if ⟦1⟧ is a rotation of ⟦2⟧, otherwise ⟦3⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ agar ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ki rotation ho, warna ⟦3⟧.

en: Evaluate an arithmetic expression given in Reverse Polish Notation.
ru: Reverse Polish Notation mein diye gaye ek arithmetic expression ko evaluate karta hai.

en: Retrieve the node’s world, check the ⟦0⟧ flag, construct a ⟦1⟧ populated with world, node ID, trigger ID, and value, then forward it to the hardware trigger queue via ⟦2⟧.
ru: Node ki world retrieve karta hai, ⟦0⟧ flag check karta hai, world, node ID, trigger ID, aur value se populated ek ⟦1⟧ construct karta hai, phir use ⟦2⟧ ke zariye hardware trigger queue tak forward kar deta hai.

en: The function iterates over each inner ⟦0⟧ using a range‑based loop, then iterates over each element in that row, outputting the value followed by a space. After processing a row, it prints a newline. This simple double‑loop handles empty outer or inner vectors gracefully, producing no output for them.
ru: Function range-based loop ka use karke har inner ⟦0⟧ par iterate karta hai, phir us row ke har element par iterate karta hai aur value ke baad space ke sath output karta hai. Har row process karne ke baad newline print karta hai. Yeh simple double-loop empty outer ya inner vectors ko bhi gracefully handle karta hai aur unke liye koi output nahi deta.

en: Initialise a message‑digest state buffer with the fixed constants required by the MD algorithm.
ru: MD algorithm ke zaroori fixed constants ke sath ek message-digest state buffer initialise karta hai.

en: Iterate over the vector, convert each integer to a string with ⟦0⟧, append it and a space to the result string, then return the accumulated string.
ru: Vector par iterate karta hai, har integer ko ⟦0⟧ se ek string mein convert karta hai, use aur ek space ko result string mein append karta hai, phir accumulated string return kar deta hai.

en: A ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ representing a non‑negative integer.
ru: Aik ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ jo non-negative integer ko represent karta hai.

en: A float in [0, 1) representing the generated random value.
ru: [0, 1) mein ek float jo generated random value represent karta hai.

en: bool – true if t is NaN, false otherwise.
ru: bool – true agar t NaN ho, warna false.

en: Convert the tree into an adjacency list where each edge records the neighbour and the direction needed to move from the current node. Perform BFS from s to record each node’s predecessor and the direction taken. Reconstruct the path by walking backwards from t to s, collecting directions, then reverse the string.
ru: Tree ko ek adjacency list mein convert karta hai jahan har edge neighbour aur current node se move karne ki direction record karta hai. s se BFS perform karke har node ka predecessor aur li gayi direction record karta hai. t se s tak backwards chal ke path reconstruct karta hai, directions collect karte hue, phir string ko reverse kar deta hai.

en: Generate all palindromes ≤ ⟦0⟧ and store them sorted. First check if N itself is a palindrome. Then use a two‑pointer technique on the sorted list to test for a pair that sums to N; if none exists, return 3 (guaranteed by number‑theoretic result).
ru: ⟦0⟧ tak sab palindromes generate karta hai aur unhe sorted store karta hai. Pehle check karta hai ke N khud ek palindrome hai ya nahi. Phir sorted list par ek two-pointer technique istemal karta hai ye test karne ke liye ke koi pair N tak sum hota hai; agar koi na mile, 3 return karta hai (number-theoretic result se guaranteed).

en: Initialise a counter to zero, then perform a depth‑first search passing the current maximum value along the ⟦0⟧. Each recursive call updates the counter when a node meets the “good” condition. Finally, return the counter.
ru: Counter ko zero initialise karta hai, phir ⟦0⟧ ke saath current maximum value pass karte hue ek depth-first search perform karta hai. Har recursive call counter ko update karti hai jab ek node "good" condition poori kare. Akhir mein, counter return karta hai.

en: To interlace two rows of bytes by copying elements from the second row into the first row at specific intervals.
ru: Bytes ki do rows ko interlace karne ke liye doosri row ke elements ko specific intervals par pehli row mein copy karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ (number of vertices), ⟦1⟧ (list of edges where each edge is represented ⟦2⟧), ⟦3⟧ (source vertex).
ru: ⟦0⟧ (vertices ki tadaad), ⟦1⟧ (edges ki list jahan har edge ko ⟦2⟧ represent karta hai), ⟦3⟧ (source vertex).

en: Calls the low‑level ⟦0⟧ to clear the counter enable bit for the timer instance referenced by the handle. Optional state reset and advanced‑timer brake features are noted but left disabled to avoid side effects.
ru: Handle se reference kiye gaye timer instance ke liye counter enable bit clear karne ke liye low-level ⟦0⟧ call karta hai. Optional state reset aur advanced-timer brake features note kiye jate hain lekin side effects se bachne ke liye disabled rakhe jate hain.

en: Iterates through each city, counts how many other cities it can reach within the distance threshold, and keeps track of the city with the minimum count.
ru: Har city ke through iterate karta hai, yeh count karta hai ke distance threshold ke andar woh kitni doosri cities tak pohanch sakti hai, aur jis city ka count minimum ho usay track karta rehta hai.

en: The function checks the input against a series of hard‑coded synonym groups using chained ⟦0⟧ statements; when a match is found it returns the group’s canonical name, falling back to the original value if no match exists.
ru: Ye function chained ⟦0⟧ statements istemal karke input ko hard-coded synonym groups ki ek series ke khilaf check karta hai; jab match mil jaye, group ka canonical name return karta hai, agar koi match na ho toh original value par fall back kar deta hai.

en: Recursively visit the node, appending its value to res, then recursively traverse the left child followed by the right child. The recursion terminates when a null pointer is encountered.
ru: Node ko recursively visit karta hai, uski value res mein append karte hue, phir left child ko recursively traverse karta hai uske baad right child ko. Recursion tab khatam hoti hai jab null pointer mile.

en: Computes the remainder of x and y when divided by 4 to find their positions within the cycle. Returns true if both positions are the same but the indices themselves are different.
ru: x aur y ke 4 se divide karne par remainder compute karta hai unki cycle ke andar positions dhoondne ke liye. True return karta hai agar dono positions same hon lekin indices khud mukhtalif hon.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the source string; ⟦1⟧ – number of characters to examine from the start of ⟦0⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – source string; ⟦1⟧ – ⟦0⟧ ke start se examine kiye jane wale characters ki tadaad.

en: ⟦0⟧ – adjacency list where ⟦1⟧ contains all vertices adjacent to ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – adjacency list jahan ⟦1⟧ mein ⟦2⟧ ke sab adjacent vertices hote hain.

en: Calculate the Euclidean magnitudes of the goal vector and the trajectory’s last point, find their dot product to obtain the cosine of the angle, clamp and convert this cosine to an angle via acos, then multiply by a configurable gain.
ru: Goal vector aur trajectory ke last point ki Euclidean magnitudes calculate karta hai, angle ka cosine hasil karne ke liye unka dot product nikalta hai, is cosine ko clamp karke acos ke zariye angle mein convert karta hai, phir ek configurable gain se multiply kar deta hai.

en: Constructs a ⟦0⟧ from the input range to deduplicate and sort characters. Then overwrites the original buffer with the set’s contents and appends a null character.
ru: Input range se aik ⟦0⟧ construct karta hai taake characters ko deduplicate aur sort kiya ja sake. Phir original buffer ko set ke contents se overwrite karta hai aur end mein null character append karta hai.

en: s1 and s2 – two binary strings of equal length; n – number of characters to examine (typically ⟦0⟧()).
ru: s1 aur s2 – equal length ki do binary strings; n – examine karne wale characters ki tadaad (typically ⟦0⟧()).

en: Convert a binary tree into its mirror image and provide an in‑order traversal printer.
ru: Ek binary tree ko uski mirror image mein convert karta hai aur ek in-order traversal printer faraham karta hai.

en: A vector of integers where each element is either the smallest 'x' satisfying the condition or -1 if no such 'x' exists.
ru: Integers ka ek vector jahan har element ya toh condition satisfy karne wala sabse chota 'x' hai ya -1 agar aisa koi 'x' na ho.

en: two vectors x, y of equal length ⟦0⟧ and an integer K.
ru: Equal length ⟦0⟧ ke do vectors x, y aur ek integer K.

en: Compute the length of the longest contiguous subarray that is strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.
ru: Sabse lambi contiguous subarray ki length compute karta hai jo strictly increasing ya strictly decreasing ho.

en: Prints, for each character in the string, how many later characters are lexicographically smaller.
ru: String ke har character ke liye print karta hai ke uske baad kitne characters lexicographically chote hain.

en: If the margin height is less than the rectangle height, subtract ⟦0⟧ from the rectangle’s bottom edge, then divide by the usable ⟦1⟧. If the margin is too large, return 0.0 to avoid invalid normalization.
ru: Agar margin height rectangle ki height se kam ho to rectangle ke bottom edge se ⟦0⟧ subtract karta hai, phir usable ⟦1⟧ se divide karta hai. Agar margin bohat zyada ho to invalid normalization se bachne ke liye 0.0 return karta hai.

en: Sort the array in non‑decreasing order; then, because pairing adjacent elements yields the optimal result, sum every element at an even ⟦0⟧. The total is returned.
ru: Array ko non-decreasing order mein sort karta hai; phir, chunke adjacent elements ko pair karna optimal result deta hai, har even ⟦0⟧ par element ko sum karta hai. Total return kiya jata hai.

en: Compute r1 = ⟦0⟧ / ⟦1⟧ and r2 = ⟦2⟧ / ⟦3⟧ as doubles, then return the result of r1 > r2. Edge cases such as zero weight are not explicitly handled in the original code.
ru: r1 = ⟦0⟧ / ⟦1⟧ aur r2 = ⟦2⟧ / ⟦3⟧ ko doubles ke taur par calculate karta hai, phir r1 > r2 ka result return karta hai. Zero weight jaisi edge cases ko original code mein explicitly handle nahi kiya gaya.

en: Subtract the nanosecond fields; if the left nanoseconds are smaller, borrow one ⟦0⟧ to avoid negative nanoseconds, adjusting the seconds field accordingly; otherwise subtract fields directly. The result is returned in a struct with normalized fields.
ru: Nanosecond fields ko subtract karta hai; agar left nanoseconds chote hon, negative nanoseconds se bachne ke liye ek ⟦0⟧ borrow karta hai, seconds field ko us hisab se adjust karte hue; warna fields ko directly subtract karta hai. Result ek struct mein normalized fields ke sath return hota hai.

en: Subtract the offset between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ from the base class pointer to get the derived class pointer.
ru: ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke darmiyan offset ko base class pointer se subtract karke derived class pointer hasil karta hai.

en: First checks length equality; then scans both strings simultaneously, setting flags when a '1' is encountered. If both flags become true, it returns true immediately. After the scan, it returns true only when neither flag was ⟦0⟧, otherwise false.
ru: Sab se pehle dono strings ki length equal check karta hai. Phir dono strings ko aik sath scan karta hai aur jab 1 milta hai to flags set karta hai. Agar dono flags true ho jayein to foran true return karta hai. Scan ke baad sirf tab true return karta hai jab dono mein se koi bhi flag ⟦0⟧ na ho, warna false return karta hai.

en: Traverse the list, advancing m‑1 steps to locate the node after which deletion starts, then advance n‑1 steps to find the last node to delete. Relink to skip the deleted segment; repeat until the list ends or fewer than n nodes remain.
ru: List ko traverse karta hai, us node ko locate karne ke liye m-1 steps advance karta hai jiske baad deletion shuru hoti hai, phir delete karne wale last node ko dhoondne ke liye n-1 steps advance karta hai. Deleted segment ko skip karne ke liye relink karta hai; ye repeat karta hai jab tak list khatam na ho jaye ya n se kam nodes na bachein.

en: The function computes the barycenter by taking a weighted average of the coordinates of the two points, where the weights are normalized by their sum to ensure the result is a valid barycenter.
ru: Function do points ke coordinates ka weighted average le kar barycenter calculate karta hai, jahan weights ko unke sum se normalize kiya jata hai taake result ek valid barycenter ho.

en: Counts the occurrences of each character across all words, then checks if each count is divisible by the number of words.
ru: Sab words ke across har character ke occurrences count karta hai, phir check karta hai ke har count words ki tadaad se divisible hai ya nahi.

en: Reverses the order of non-space characters in a string while keeping spaces in their original positions.
ru: Spaces ko unki original positions par rakhte hue string mein non-space characters ki order reverse karta hai.

en: For each i from 1 to N, factor out all 2s and 5s, accumulating their total counts; the result is the minimum of the two totals. (A more efficient method sums ⌊N/5^k⌋ for k≥1.)
ru: 1 se N tak har i ke liye, sab 2s aur 5s ko factor out karta hai, unke total counts accumulate karte hue; result in dono totals mein se minimum hota hai. (Ek zyada efficient method k≥1 ke liye ⌊N/5^k⌋ ka sum leta hai.)

en: Count subarrays whose number of equal‑value pairs is at least k.
ru: Un subarrays ko count karta hai jinke equal-value pairs ki tadaad kam az kam k ho.

en: Iterates over each leaf edge in an orthtree and applies a functor to it.
ru: Ek orthtree mein har leaf edge par iterate karta hai aur use ek functor apply karta hai.

en: The matrix C filled with ⟦0⟧[j] * ⟦1⟧[j] for all i, j.
ru: Matrix C sab i, j ke liye ⟦0⟧[j] * ⟦1⟧[j] se filled hoti hai.

en: Recursively traverse the tree comparing node keys with the target. When the key matches, walk left subtree to find the ⟦0⟧ and right subtree to find the ⟦1⟧. Otherwise, propagate potential ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ down the recursion.
ru: Tree ko recursively traverse karta hai node keys ko target se compare karte hue. Jab key match kare, ⟦0⟧ dhoondne ke liye left subtree aur ⟦1⟧ dhoondne ke liye right subtree chalta hai. Warna, potential ⟦2⟧ ya ⟦3⟧ ko recursion ke neeche propagate karta hai.

en: Compute, for each node in a DAG, the list of all its ancestors.
ru: DAG ke har node ke liye uske tamam ancestors ki list calculate karta hai.

en: Directly assigns zero to each of the four 64‑bit words of the scalar. This deterministic, constant‑time approach ensures the entire value is wiped without using memory‑set functions that might be optimized away.
ru: Scalar ke chaar 64-bit words mein se har ek ko directly zero assign karta hai. Ye deterministic, constant-time approach ensure karta hai ke pori value bina memory-set functions istemal kiye wipe ho jaye jo optimize away ho sakte hain.

en: Iterate through the input digits, building combinations incrementally. For the first digit, create one‑character strings. For subsequent digits, extend each existing string with every possible character for the current digit, handling repeated digits by reusing the previously selected character. After processing each digit, swap the temporary results into the main output list.
ru: Input digits ke through iterate karta hai, combinations incrementally build karte hue. Pehle digit ke liye, one-character strings create karta hai. Baad ke digits ke liye, har existing string ko current digit ke har possible character se extend karta hai, repeated digits ko previously selected character reuse karke handle karte hue. Har digit process hone ke baad, temporary results ko main output list mein swap kar deta hai.

en: First scans the column to detect duplicates, then scans the row, and finally iterates over the square region ⟦0⟧ to ensure the value does not already appear. If any check fails, it returns false; otherwise true.
ru: Pehle duplicates detect karne ke liye column scan karta hai, phir row scan karta hai, aur akhir mein square region ⟦0⟧ par iterate karta hai ye ensure karne ke liye ke value pehle se mojood na ho. Agar koi check fail ho jaye toh false return karta hai; warna true.

en: Uses ⟦0⟧'s ⟦1⟧ with ⟦2⟧ to locate and remove the nth occurrence of the search sequence.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke ⟦1⟧ ko ⟦2⟧ ke sath use karke search sequence ki nth occurrence ko locate karta hai aur remove karta hai.

en: Returns the length of the longest consecutive integer sequence in the input vector.
ru: Input vector mein sabse lambi consecutive integer sequence ki length return karta hai.

en: Starting at the root, iterate through each character, convert it to an ⟦0⟧, add the child’s ⟦1⟧ to the running total, and advance to that child. The loop assumes the word contains only lowercase English letters and that the trie has a full 26‑child array per node.
ru: Root se shuru karke, har character par iterate karta hai, use ek ⟦0⟧ mein convert karta hai, child ke ⟦1⟧ ko running total mein add karta hai, aur us child ki taraf advance karta hai. Loop assume karta hai ke word mein sirf lowercase English letters hain aur har node mein trie ka ek full 26-child array hai.

en: A ⟦0⟧ representing the binary addition of a and b without leading ⟦1⟧.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ jo bina leading ⟦1⟧ ke a aur b ki binary addition represent karta hai.

en: Count how many cells contain odd numbers after applying row‑ and column‑increment operations.
ru: Row aur column-increment operations apply karne ke baad kitne cells mein odd numbers hain, ye count karta hai.

en: Computes n^k modulo p using binary exponentiation.
ru: Binary exponentiation istemal karke n^k modulo p compute karta hai.

en: Convert N to a string, then walk through the digits, grouping maximal runs where each adjacent digit pair sums to K. For each run of odd length, multiply the answer ⟦0⟧/2; even‑length runs contribute a factor of 1. The final product is returned.
ru: N ko ek string mein convert karta hai, phir digits ke through chalta hai, maximal runs group karte hue jahan har adjacent digit pair K tak sum ho. Odd length wale har run ke liye, answer ko ⟦0⟧/2 se multiply karta hai; even-length runs ek factor of 1 contribute karti hain. Final product return kiya jata hai.

en: Compute the integer floor of √⟦0⟧. If n² equals x, x is a perfect square and the answer is x+1. Otherwise, ⟦1⟧², the next perfect square after x.
ru: √⟦0⟧ ka integer floor compute karta hai. Agar n², x ke barabar ho, x ek perfect square hai aur answer x+1 hai. Warna, ⟦1⟧², x ke baad ka agla perfect square.

en: First check if n is a power of two using the classic bit‑trick (n && !(n&(n-1))). If not, return -1. Otherwise, repeatedly right‑shift n, counting iterations until n becomes zero; the count equals the position of the lone set bit.
ru: Pehle classic bit-trick (n && !(n&(n-1))) istemal karke check karta hai ke n power of two hai ya nahi. Agar nahi, -1 return karta hai. Warna, baar baar n ko right-shift karta hai, iterations count karte hue jab tak n zero na ho jaye; count akeli set bit ki position ke barabar hota hai.

en: Normalize an angle within a specified range [0, hi).
ru: Angle ko specified range [0, hi) ke andar normalize karta hai.

en: Insert the iterator it into the set. If a previous flat exists, insert its iterator; similarly, if a next flat exists, insert that iterator. No further processing is performed.
ru: Iterator it ko set mein insert karta hai. Agar ek previous flat mojood ho, uska iterator insert karta hai; isi tarah, agar ek next flat mojood ho, uska iterator insert karta hai. Koi further processing perform nahi hoti.

en: ⟦0⟧ (reference to a map of groups), ⟦1⟧ (identifier of the group), ⟦2⟧ (new configuration to set).
ru: ⟦0⟧ (groups ke ek map ka reference), ⟦1⟧ (group ka identifier), ⟦2⟧ (set karne wala naya configuration).

en: An ⟦0⟧ indicating the comparison result.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ jo comparison result indicate karta hai.

en: Utilizes two stacks—one for characters and one for indices—to track unmatched parentheses and calculate the length of valid substrings as they are encountered.
ru: Unmatched parentheses track karne aur valid substrings ki length calculate karne ke liye do stacks istemal karta hai—ek characters ke liye aur ek indices ke liye—jaise wo mile jate hain.

en: First compute the naive ⟦0⟧. Then recover the part of a that was lost due to rounding by computing bvirt = a‑x, which yields the exact value that would produce x. Finally, the error is the difference between this virtual b and the original ⟦1⟧. This yields a compensated subtraction useful for extended‑precision arithmetic.
ru: Pehle naive ⟦0⟧ compute karta hai. Phir bvirt = a-x compute karke a ka wo part recover karta hai jo rounding ki wajah se lost ho gaya tha, jo x produce karne wali exact value deta hai. Akhir mein, error is virtual b aur original ⟦1⟧ ke darmiyan farq hota hai. Ye extended-precision arithmetic ke liye useful ek compensated subtraction deta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ compares characters from both ends moving inward, returning false on the first mismatch. ⟦1⟧ recursively checks if the current string is a palindrome; if not, it discards the leading ⟦2⟧ and adds one to the recursive result until the base case is reached.
ru: ⟦0⟧ dono ends se characters ko andar ki taraf move karte hue compare karta hai, pehle mismatch par false return karta hai. ⟦1⟧ recursively check karta hai ke current string palindrome hai ya nahi; agar nahi, toh leading ⟦2⟧ ko discard karta hai aur recursive result mein ek add karta hai jab tak base case na aa jaye.

en: Repeatedly extracts the least‑significant digit using modulo 10; if a zero digit is found the function returns ⟦0⟧. The number is divided by 10 each loop to progress toward termination. If the loop finishes, all digits were non‑zero, so it returns ⟦1⟧.
ru: Modulo 10 istemal karke baar baar least-significant digit nikalta hai; agar zero digit mil jaye toh function ⟦0⟧ return kar deta hai. Har loop mein number ko 10 se divide kiya jata hai taake termination ki taraf barha ja sake. Agar loop mukammal ho jaye, matlab sab digits non-zero thay, toh ⟦1⟧ return karta hai.

en: Iterates through each row of the matrix at the specified column index and increments a counter if the element is zero.
ru: Specified column index par matrix ki har row par iterate karta hai aur agar element zero ho toh ek counter increment kar deta hai.

en: Boolean indicating if ⟦0⟧ has a higher value-to-weight ratio than ⟦1⟧.
ru: Boolean jo indicate karta hai ke ⟦0⟧ ka value-to-weight ratio ⟦1⟧ se zyada hai ya nahi.

en: Compute n/2 using integer division, construct a denominator string starting with '1' and appending n/2 zeros, then output the formatted fraction. Edge cases such as n≤0 or odd n are implicitly handled by the integer division.
ru: Integer division istemal karke n/2 compute karta hai, '1' se shuru hone wali aur n/2 zeros append karne wali ek denominator string construct karta hai, phir formatted fraction output karta hai. n≤0 ya odd n jese edge cases integer division se implicitly handle ho jate hain.

en: An output iterator pointing to the end of the destination range.
ru: Destination range ke end ki taraf point karne wala ek output iterator.

en: Uses the extended Euclidean algorithm recursively; the base case handles b = 0, setting coefficients ⟦0⟧. Each recursive step swaps the roles of a and b and, after returning, adjusts y with the quotient a/b to maintain the Bézout identity. The comma operator is used to return the gcd while updating y in a single statement.
ru: Extended Euclidean algorithm ko recursively istemal karta hai; base case b = 0 handle karta hai, coefficients ⟦0⟧ set karte hue. Har recursive step a aur b ke roles swap karta hai aur, wapas aane ke baad, Bézout identity maintain karne ke liye y ko quotient a/b se adjust karta hai. Comma operator gcd return karne ke liye istemal hota hai jabke y ek single statement mein update hota hai.

en: Determine the size of the uncompressed data for a Snappy-compressed buffer.
ru: Ek Snappy-compressed buffer ke liye uncompressed data ka size determine karta hai.

en: If ⟦0⟧ is 0, ⟦1⟧. Otherwise recursively obtain the previous row, then construct the current row by summing adjacent pairs from the previous row and surrounding the sums with 1s at both ends. This yields the classic Pascal triangle construction.
ru: Agar ⟦0⟧ 0 ho, ⟦1⟧. Warna previous row ko recursively hasil karta hai, phir previous row se adjacent pairs ka sum karke aur dono ends par sums ko 1s se surround karke current row construct karta hai. Ye classic Pascal triangle construction deta hai.

en: Dynamic programming builds a table ⟦0⟧ storing the cheapest cost to paint up to house *i* ending with colour *c*. For each house we add its painting cost to the minimum of the two alternative colours from the previous house. The answer is the minimum of the three values for the last house.
ru: Dynamic programming ek table ⟦0⟧ build karta hai jo house *i* tak colour *c* se khatam hone wala sabse sasta cost store karta hai. Har house ke liye pichle house ke do alternative colours mein se minimum mein uska painting cost add karte hain. Answer last house ke liye teen values mein se minimum hota hai.

en: Creates a read‑only Game object representing Rock‑Paper‑Scissors.
ru: Ek read-only Game object create karta hai jo Rock-Paper-Scissors ko represent karta hai.

en: Scan the string from the least‑significant digit backward until an odd digit is found; then return the substring from the start up to that position. If the scan finishes without finding an odd digit, return an empty string.
ru: String ko least-significant digit se backward scan karta hai jab tak ek odd digit na mile; phir start se us position tak substring return karta hai. Agar scan bina odd digit mile khatam ho jaye, ek empty string return karta hai.

en: Reads the entire contents of a file into a ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ek file ke pure contents ko ek ⟦0⟧ mein parhta hai.

en: Calculate the minimal extra A needed using ceiling division, clamp it to zero, then count the range from that minimum up to C, ensuring a non‑negative result.
ru: Ceiling division istemal karke zaroori minimal extra A calculate karta hai, use zero par clamp karta hai, phir us minimum se C tak range count karta hai, non-negative result ensure karte hue.

en: For every spatial location, compute the sum of squares of its C ⟦0⟧. Perform a binary search on a fixed‑point range to obtain the inverse square root. Finally, multiply each channel by this factor and write to B.
ru: Har spatial location ke liye, iske C ⟦0⟧ ke squares ka sum compute karta hai. Inverse square root hasil karne ke liye ek fixed-point range par binary search perform karta hai. Akhir mein, har channel ko is factor se multiply karke B mein likhta hai.

en: Retrieve the “equal environment” and “has equal environment” booleans from the source’s face and set the corresponding fields on the target half‑edge, including a combined flag for target‑and‑face.
ru: Source ke face se "equal environment" aur "has equal environment" booleans retrieve karta hai aur target half-edge par corresponding fields set karta hai, target-and-face ke liye ek combined flag samet.

en: Writes to ⟦0⟧ either “ - 1” if no split works, or the split indices followed by “ ? ”.
ru: ⟦0⟧ par ya toh "- 1" likhta hai agar koi split kaam na kare, ya split indices likhta hai jinke baad "? " aata hai.

en: The code scans both strings run‑by‑⟦0⟧. For each run in name it ensures a corresponding run exists in typed with the same character and at least the same length. If any run fails these checks or extra characters remain unmatched, it returns false; otherwise true.
ru: Code dono strings ko run-by-⟦0⟧ scan karta hai. name mein har run ke liye ensure karta hai ke typed mein bhi wahi character aur kam az kam wahi length wala corresponding run mojood ho. Agar koi run in checks mein fail ho jaye ya extra characters unmatched reh jayein, toh false return karta hai; warna true.

en: Verify that the facet is a triangle and that the edge index is valid, convert the corner‑based edge index to the standard triangle ordering, then use the mesh's half‑edge adjacency query to fetch the neighboring facet.
ru: Verify karta hai ke facet ek triangle hai aur edge index valid hai, corner-based edge index ko standard triangle ordering mein convert karta hai, phir mesh ki half-edge adjacency query istemal karke neighboring facet fetch karta hai.

en: Counts the number of overlapping “1” cells when matrix B is shifted relative to matrix A.
ru: Jab matrix B ko matrix A ke relative shift kiya jaye toh overlapping "1" cells ki tadaad count karta hai.

en: Compute the “Bulls and Cows” hint for a number-guessing game.
ru: Ek number-guessing game ke liye "Bulls and Cows" hint compute karta hai.

en: Iterate i from 1 to n, use Kernighan’s algorithm to count set bits of i, add i to the total when the count equals 2. The loop runs ⟦0⟧ time.
ru: i ko 1 se n tak iterate karta hai, i ke set bits count karne ke liye Kernighan's algorithm istemal karta hai, jab count 2 ho toh i ko total mein add kar deta hai. Loop ⟦0⟧ time mein chalta hai.

en: Prints two integers: the XOR of all n‑digit Armstrong numbers and the OR of all n‑digit Armstrong numbers.
ru: Do integers print karta hai: tamam n-digit Armstrong numbers ka XOR aur tamam n-digit Armstrong numbers ka OR.

en: Initialise a 1‑D DP array representing the current row/column with ⟦0⟧. Iterate over the smaller coordinate, updating each entry by adding the value to its left, thereby accumulating binomial coefficients. The final entry holds the total number of paths.
ru: Current row/column ko represent karne wala ek 1-D DP array ⟦0⟧ se initialise karta hai. Chote coordinate par iterate karta hai, har entry ko uske left ki value add karke update karte hue, is tarah binomial coefficients accumulate karte hue. Final entry paths ki total tadaad rakhti hai.

en: The function checks whether the next preorder value fits within [left, right]; if not, it returns nullptr. Otherwise it consumes the value, creates a node, and recursively builds the left subtree with an updated upper ⟦0⟧ and the right subtree with an updated lower ⟦0⟧, advancing the shared index throughout.
ru: Ye function check karta hai ke agla preorder value [left, right] ke andar fit hota hai ya nahi; agar nahi, nullptr return karta hai. Warna value consume karta hai, ek node create karta hai, aur updated upper ⟦0⟧ ke sath left subtree aur updated lower ⟦0⟧ ke sath right subtree recursively build karta hai, shared index ko throughout advance karte hue.

en: First, construct a prefix array counting zeros up to each index and a suffix array counting ones from each index to the end. Then, iterate over all possible split positions, combining the corresponding prefix and suffix values, and track the maximum. Edge ⟦0⟧ naturally yield a score of 0.
ru: Pehle, har index tak zeros count karne wala ek prefix array aur har index se end tak ones count karne wala ek suffix array construct karta hai. Phir, sab possible split positions par iterate karta hai, corresponding prefix aur suffix values combine karte hue, aur maximum track karta hai. Edge ⟦0⟧ naturally 0 ka score dete hain.

en: A ⟦0⟧ representing the longest “nice” substring; empty if none exists.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ jo sabse lambi "nice" substring represent karta hai; empty agar koi na ho.

en: Returns ⟦0⟧ if the "$EndNodes" marker is found and vertices are loaded, otherwise ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ return karta hai agar "$EndNodes" marker mil jaye aur vertices load ho jayein, warna ⟦1⟧.

en: Shift the first value ⟦0⟧ left by 10 bits and then perform a bitwise OR operation with the second value ⟦1⟧. This effectively combines the two values into a single 32-bit value where the lower 10 bits represent ⟦1⟧ and the upper 22 bits represent ⟦0⟧.
ru: Pehli value ⟦0⟧ ko 10 bits left shift karta hai aur phir doosri value ⟦1⟧ ke sath bitwise OR operation perform karta hai. Is tarah dono values ko ek single 32-bit value mein combine karta hai, jahan lower 10 bits ⟦1⟧ ko aur upper 22 bits ⟦0⟧ ko represent karte hain.

en: ⟦0⟧ - A vector containing the cards revealed in increasing order.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - Ek vector jismein increasing order mein reveal ki gayi cards hoti hain.

en: ⟦0⟧ – returns ⟦1⟧ if divisible, otherwise ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – divisible hone par ⟦1⟧ return karta hai, warna ⟦2⟧.

en: The tensor ⟦0⟧ is updated in‑place with the computed results.
ru: Tensor ⟦0⟧ ko calculated results ke sath in-place update karta hai.

en: Initialize ⟦0⟧ to 0 and iterate ⟦1⟧ from 1 to ⟦2⟧. If ⟦3⟧ matches ⟦4⟧, increment ⟦5⟧ and set ⟦6⟧. On mismatch, backtrack ⟦5⟧ using previously computed LPS values until a match is found or ⟦5⟧ becomes 0, then advance ⟦1⟧. This runs in linear time ⟦7⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko 0 par initialize karta hai aur ⟦1⟧ ko 1 se ⟦2⟧ tak iterate karta hai. Agar ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ se match kare, ⟦5⟧ increment karta hai aur ⟦6⟧ set karta hai. Mismatch par, previously computed LPS values istemal karke ⟦5⟧ ko backtrack karta hai jab tak match na mile ya ⟦5⟧ 0 ho jaye, phir ⟦1⟧ advance karta hai. Ye linear time ⟦7⟧ mein chalta hai.

en: Counts the frequency of each character in both strings and compares these counts. If all counts match, the strings are anagrams.
ru: Dono strings mein har character ki frequency count karta hai aur in counts ko compare karta hai. Agar sab counts match karein, strings anagrams hain.

en: A single ⟦0⟧ s – the string to analyze.
ru: Aik single ⟦0⟧ s – analyze karne ke liye string.

en: Returns the length of the bytecode buffer in bytes as a ⟦0⟧.
ru: Bytecode buffer ki length ko bytes mein ek ⟦0⟧ ki tarah return karta hai.

en: The complement weight w2 = 1‑w1 is derived, then each output coordinate is calculated as a linear combination: x = w1·p1x + w2·p2x and similarly for y. This yields the point on the line segment joining the two inputs at the specified proportion.
ru: Complement weight w2 = 1-w1 derive kiya jata hai, phir har output coordinate ek linear combination ki tarah calculate kiya jata hai: x = w1·p1x + w2·p2x aur isi tarah y ke liye. Ye specified proportion par dono inputs ko jodne wale line segment par point deta hai.

en: Generates all 2ⁿ subset masks, discards any mask with adjacent set bits using the expression ⟦0⟧, and increments a counter for each remaining mask. The final count is returned.
ru: Sab 2ⁿ subset masks generate karta hai, expression ⟦0⟧ istemal karke adjacent set bits wale kisi bhi mask ko discard kar deta hai, aur har remaining mask ke liye ek counter increment karta hai. Final count return hota hai.

en: First checks for equality and returns ⟦0⟧ to satisfy strict weak ordering; if not equal, it compares the internal ⟦1⟧ members to decide the order.
ru: Pehle equality check karta hai aur strict weak ordering satisfy karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ return karta hai; agar barabar na hon, order decide karne ke liye internal ⟦1⟧ members ko compare karta hai.

en: Convert a textual grid representation into a numeric 2‑D vector.
ru: Textual grid representation ko numeric 2-D vector mein convert karta hai.

en: Iterate from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧, comparing each dereferenced element to ⟦2⟧. On a match, assign ⟦3⟧ to the current iterator and return true; if the end is reached, assign ⟦3⟧ to ⟦1⟧ and return false.
ru: ⟦0⟧ se ⟦1⟧ tak iterate karta hai, har dereferenced element ko ⟦2⟧ se compare karte hue. Match milne par, ⟦3⟧ ko current iterator assign karta hai aur true return karta hai; agar end tak pahunch jaye toh ⟦3⟧ ko ⟦1⟧ assign karta hai aur false return karta hai.

en: Returns the number of logical CPU cores available on the host system.
ru: Host system par available logical CPU cores ki tadaad return karta hai.

en: Uses modular arithmetic to repeatedly construct numbers made up of only ones until finding one divisible by K or exhausting all possibilities within K iterations.
ru: Modular arithmetic istemal karte hue baar baar sirf ones se bane numbers construct karta hai jab tak koi K se divisible na mile ya K iterations ke andar sab possibilities khatam na ho jayein.

en: The function uses a divide-and-conquer approach to repeatedly narrow down the search interval until the target is found or the interval is exhausted.
ru: Ye function ek divide-and-conquer approach istemal karta hai jab tak target mil jaye ya interval khatam na ho jaye baar baar search interval ko narrow down karte hue.

en: Starting from power = 1, repeatedly compute the sum of each digit of x raised to that power. If the sum equals x, return true; if the sum exceeds x, return false. The helper power uses recursive exponentiation by squaring.
ru: Power = 1 se shuru karke, baar baar x ke har digit ka us power tak sum compute karta hai. Agar sum x ke barabar ho, true return karta hai; agar sum x se zyada ho, false return karta hai. Helper power squaring ke zariye recursive exponentiation istemal karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ if all characters are the ⟦2⟧, otherwise ⟦3⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ agar sab characters ⟦2⟧ hon, warna ⟦3⟧.

en: ⟦0⟧ – source text; ⟦1⟧ – desired chunk ⟦2⟧; ⟦3⟧ – padding character.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – source text; ⟦1⟧ – desired chunk ⟦2⟧; ⟦3⟧ – padding character.

en: To compare two pointers to objects of type T based on their time stamps.
ru: Type T ke objects ke do pointers ko unke time stamps ke hisab se compare karne ke liye.

en: Prints to ⟦0⟧ the integer count of qualifying substrings.
ru: Qualifying substrings ka integer count ⟦0⟧ par print karta hai.

en: Perform a depth‑first search, returning false for null nodes. At each leaf, compare the accumulated sum plus the leaf’s value to the target. For internal nodes, recurse on both children with the updated running total; combine results with logical OR.
ru: Ek depth-first search perform karta hai, null nodes ke liye false return karta hai. Har leaf par, accumulated sum plus leaf ki value ko target se compare karta hai. Internal nodes ke liye, updated running total ke sath dono children par recurse karta hai; results ko logical OR se combine kar deta hai.

en: Initialise factorial and arithmetic sum for i = 1. Iterate i from 2 to n, updating the ⟦0⟧ and the running integer ⟦1⟧. At each step add the difference between these two values to the overall sum, then return it.
ru: i = 1 ke liye factorial aur arithmetic sum initialise karta hai. i ko 2 se n tak iterate karta hai, ⟦0⟧ aur running integer ⟦1⟧ update karte hue. Har step par in dono values ka farq overall sum mein add karta hai, phir use return kar deta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a candidate ⟦1⟧; ⟦2⟧ – vector of integers; ⟦3⟧ – window ⟦4⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ek candidate ⟦1⟧; ⟦2⟧ – integers ka vector; ⟦3⟧ – window ⟦4⟧.

en: Computes the maximum total value obtainable by selecting up to two non‑overlapping events.
ru: Zyada se zyada do non-overlapping events select karke hasil hone wali maximum total value compute karta hai.

en: Initialise all strides with itemsize, then, if the shape is non‑empty, iterate from the last dimension toward the first, multiplying the current stride by the size of the next dimension to obtain the preceding stride.
ru: Tamam strides ko itemsize se initialise karta hai, phir, agar shape non-empty ho, last dimension se first ki taraf iterate karta hai, current stride ko next dimension ke size se multiply karke preceding stride hasil karta hai.

en: First reject if total cards aren’t divisible by ⟦0⟧. Count frequencies of each value in an ordered map. Repeatedly take the smallest remaining value as the start of a straight and attempt to consume one copy of each consecutive value up to ⟦0⟧. If any needed value is missing, return false; otherwise, continue until the map is empty.
ru: Pehle reject karta hai agar total cards ⟦0⟧ se divisible na hon. Ek ordered map mein har value ki frequency count karta hai. Baar baar sabse choti remaining value ko ek straight ke start ki tarah leta hai aur ⟦0⟧ tak har consecutive value ki ek copy consume karne ki koshish karta hai. Agar koi zaroori value missing ho, false return karta hai; warna map ke khali hone tak continue karta hai.

en: Sort the input intervals, then linearly merge overlapping or directly adjacent intervals into segs. Finally, walk the merged list to emit gaps before the first segment, between consecutive segments, and after the last segment. Edge case of an empty input yields a single gap covering the whole domain.
ru: Input intervals ko sort karta hai, phir overlapping ya directly adjacent intervals ko segs mein linearly merge karta hai. Akhir mein, merged list ko chalta hai pehle segment se pehle, consecutive segments ke darmiyan, aur last segment ke baad gaps emit karne ke liye. Empty input ka edge case pura domain cover karne wala ek single gap deta hai.

en: ll a – first factor, ll b – second factor, ll mod – ⟦0⟧.
ru: ll a – pehla factor, ll b – doosra factor, ll mod – ⟦0⟧.

en: Compute the total time needed to transport all fruits given per‑type travel times and a trip capacity limit.
ru: Per-type travel times aur ek trip capacity limit diye jane par sab fruits transport karne ke liye zaroori total time compute karta hai.

en: Uses recursion with memoization; for each call it enumerates all proper non‑empty subsets s of state, recursively solves the sub‑problem for the remaining bits with one fewer group, and keeps the minimum over the maximum of ⟦0⟧ and the recursive result.
ru: Memoization ke sath recursion istemal karta hai; har call mein ye state ke sab proper non-empty subsets s enumerate karta hai, ek fewer group ke sath remaining bits ke liye sub-problem ko recursively solve karta hai, aur ⟦0⟧ aur recursive result ke maximum mein se minimum rakhta hai.

en: Boolean value indicating whether the strings differ by exactly 2 characters or are identical.
ru: Ek Boolean value jo batata hai ke strings exactly 2 characters se differ karti hain ya identical hain.

en: Determine whether a string can become a palindrome by changing at most two characters.
ru: Check karta hai ke string zyada se zyada do characters change karke palindrome ban sakti hai ya nahi.

en: Two pointers to the head nodes of the ⟦0⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke head nodes ke do pointers.

en: Iterate once through the string, maintaining the start index of the current consecutive run. When the run ⟦0⟧, update the maximum length and reset the start. The scan runs in ⟦1⟧ time and ⟦2⟧ extra space.
ru: String ke through ek dafa iterate karta hai, current consecutive run ka start index maintain karte hue. Jab run ⟦0⟧, maximum length update karta hai aur start reset kar deta hai. Scan ⟦1⟧ time aur ⟦2⟧ extra space mein chalta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ if intervals are disjoint, ⟦2⟧ if they are exact swapped endpoints, otherwise an indeterminate state.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ agar intervals disjoint hon, ⟦2⟧ agar wo exact swapped endpoints hon, warna ek indeterminate state.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a mutable 2‑D integer ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ek mutable 2-D integer ⟦1⟧.

en: Sets the maximum size for log file rotation.
ru: Log file rotation ke liye maximum size set karta hai.

en: Compute the total number of seats booked for each of N flights given a list of range bookings.
ru: Range bookings ki given list ke mutabiq N flights mein har flight ke liye total booked seats calculate karta hai.

en: Count the number of ways to partition the array into subarrays where each subarray’s max‑min ≤ k.
ru: Array ko subarrays mein partition karne ke tareeqon ko count karta hai jahan har subarray ka max-min ≤ k ho.

en: Adds a new method to a PyrClass's method table.
ru: Ek PyrClass ke method table mein ek naya method add karta hai.

en: Scan the input left‑to‑right while maintaining a stack that records whether the current context is ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. For each '+' or '-', emit the appropriate sign based on the top of the stack. When encountering '(' after a sign, push a new context reflecting whether the sign flips the sign; on ')' pop the context. All other characters are copied verbatim.
ru: Input ko left-to-right scan karta hai ek stack maintain karte hue jo record karta hai ke current context ⟦0⟧ hai ya ⟦1⟧. Har '+' ya '-' ke liye, stack ke top ke hisab se sahi sign emit karta hai. Sign ke baad '(' milne par, ek naya context push karta hai ye reflect karte hue ke sign flip hota hai ya nahi; ')' par context pop kar deta hai. Baaki sab characters verbatim copy ho jate hain.

en: Iterate through each plot in the flowerbed. If the current plot is empty and both its adjacent ⟦0⟧ are also empty, plant a flower there and decrement k. Continue until all plots are checked or k flowers have been planted.
ru: Flowerbed ke har plot par iterate karta hai. Agar current plot empty ho aur uske dono adjacent ⟦0⟧ bhi empty hon, wahan ek phool plant karke k decrement kar deta hai. Ye tab tak continue karta hai jab tak sab plots check na ho jayein ya k phool plant ho chuke hon.

en: Determine whether a decimal string represents a number divisible by 36.
ru: Check karta hai ke decimal string kisi aise number ko represent karti hai jo 36 se divisible hai ya nahi.

en: Walk through the plants sequentially, watering as long as the remaining water suffices. When the bucket is insufficient, add the round‑trip steps to ⟦0⟧, reset the water, and continue from the same plant.
ru: Plants ke through sequentially chalta hai aur jab tak remaining water kafi ho watering karta rehta hai. Jab bucket mein water kafi na ho to round-trip steps ko ⟦0⟧ mein add karta hai, water ko reset karta hai aur usi plant se dobara continue karta hai.

en: If ⟦0⟧ is non‑positive, return immediately. Otherwise convert ⟦0⟧ to nanoseconds, fill a ⟦1⟧ with 0 seconds and that nanosecond count, and call ⟦2⟧ to suspend execution.
ru: Agar ⟦0⟧ non-positive ho, turant return kar deta hai. Warna ⟦0⟧ ko nanoseconds mein convert karta hai, ek ⟦1⟧ ko 0 seconds aur us nanosecond count se fill karta hai, aur execution suspend karne ke liye ⟦2⟧ call karta hai.

en: Convert a list of integer frequencies into a single space‑separated string.
ru: Integer frequencies ki ek list ko ek single space-separated string mein convert karta hai.

en: Traverse nums with a sliding window. When an element is ⟦0⟧, all subarrays ending at that index are valid; when it is < L, it can extend previously valid subarrays; when > R, the window resets. Accumulate counts accordingly.
ru: Ek sliding window ke sath nums ko traverse karta hai. Jab ek element ⟦0⟧ ho, us index par khatam hone wale sab subarrays valid hote hain; jab ye L se kam ho, ye pehle se valid subarrays extend kar sakta hai; jab R se zyada ho, window reset ho jati hai. Us hisab se counts accumulate karta hai.

en: Compute the byte index as bitp>>3 and the intra‑byte offset as 7-(bitp&0x7), shift the target byte right by that offset, mask the LSB to obtain the bit, then increment bitp for the next call.
ru: Byte index ko bitp>>3 aur intra-byte offset ko 7-(bitp&0x7) ki tarah compute karta hai, target byte ko us offset se right shift karta hai, bit hasil karne ke liye LSB mask karta hai, phir agli call ke liye bitp increment kar deta hai.

en: c – a single character; mask – a bitmask of ⟦0⟧ flags specifying which classes to test.
ru: c – aik single character; mask – ⟦0⟧ flags ka bitmask jo specify karta hai ke kin classes ko test karna hai.

en: If the sub‑array contains more than one element, partition it around a pivot, then recursively sort the left and right partitions. The recursion stops when the sub‑array size is zero or one.
ru: Agar sub-array mein ek se zyada element hon, use ek pivot ke around partition karta hai, phir left aur right partitions ko recursively sort karta hai. Recursion tab rukti hai jab sub-array ka size zero ya ek ho.

en: Writes a header line, then sequentially streams each option label followed by its value, converting booleans via ⟦0⟧ and joining percentile values via ⟦1⟧, ending each line with ⟦2⟧. The function returns the original stream.
ru: Header line write karta hai, phir har option label ko uski value ke sath sequentially stream karta hai. Booleans ko ⟦0⟧ ke zariye convert karta hai aur percentile values ko ⟦1⟧ ke zariye join karta hai, har line ko ⟦2⟧ par end karta hai. Function original stream return karta hai.

en: Compute the minimum number of arrows needed to burst all balloons represented by intervals.
ru: Intervals se represent kiye gaye tamam balloons ko burst karne ke liye minimum arrows ki tadaad calculate karta hai.

en: Sort a vector of integers in ascending order using a recursive approach resembling bubble sort.
ru: Integer vector ko recursive approach use karke bubble sort ki tarah ascending order mein sort karta hai.

en: An ⟦0⟧ representing the total islands found.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ jo mile hue total islands represent karta hai.

en: If the length is even, the target good string must alternate two characters, so the code counts frequencies at even and odd positions and retains the most common character from each parity. If the length is odd, a good string can consist of a single repeated character, so it keeps the most frequent overall character. The answer is the original length minus the kept characters.
ru: Agar length even ho, target good string ko do characters alternate karne chahiyein, isliye code even aur odd positions par frequencies count karta hai aur har parity se sabse common character retain karta hai. Agar length odd ho, ek good string ek single repeated character se ban sakti hai, isliye ye overall sabse frequent character rakhta hai. Answer original length mein se rakhe gaye characters minus hota hai.

en: Establish a bidirectional connection between two vertices.
ru: Do vertices ke darmiyan ek bidirectional connection establish karta hai.

en: Count leaf nodes whose keys are exact integer powers of a given base x.
ru: Un leaf nodes ko count karta hai jinki keys diye gaye base x ki exact integer powers hon.

en: The function performs a depth‑first recursion with memoization. It prunes branches where the sum exceeds K, returns cached results when available, and at the final index checks for exact sum equality. For each position it explores both “choose” and “skip” actions, updating the sum only when an element is chosen, and records the result in dp for future reuse.
ru: Ye function memoization ke sath ek depth-first recursion perform karta hai. Ye un branches ko prune karta hai jahan sum K se zyada ho jaye, mojood hone par cached results return karta hai, aur final index par exact sum equality check karta hai. Har position ke liye ye "choose" aur "skip" dono actions explore karta hai, sum sirf tab update karta hai jab element choose kiya jaye, aur result ko future reuse ke liye dp mein record kar deta hai.

en: Benchmarks both key generation and key agreement using data from a hex‑encoded file.
ru: Ek hex-encoded file se data istemal karke key generation aur key agreement dono ko benchmark karta hai.

en: Scan each decimal digit of n by repeatedly taking n % 10 and dividing by 10. For each digit, if it is non‑zero and n is divisible by it, increment a counter. Return the final count.
ru: Baar baar n % 10 lekar aur 10 se divide karke n ke har decimal digit ko scan karta hai. Har digit ke liye, agar wo non-zero ho aur n us se divisible ho, ek counter increment kar deta hai. Final count return karta hai.

en: int – the minimal sum of increments required.
ru: int – zaroori increments ka minimal sum.

en: ⟦0⟧ (vector of integers), ⟦1⟧ (integer).
ru: ⟦0⟧ (integers ka vector), ⟦1⟧ (integer).

en: To compute the result of raising a base to an exponent under modulo operation efficiently.
ru: Modulo operation ke tehat ek base ko exponent tak raise karne ka result efficiently compute karne ke liye.

en: Initialise a visited array and a queue with the start node. Repeatedly dequeue a vertex, output it, then enqueue each unvisited neighbour, marking them visited upon enqueue to prevent repeats. The loop ends when the queue is empty.
ru: Ek visited array aur start node ke sath ek queue initialise karta hai. Baar baar ek vertex dequeue karta hai, use output karta hai, phir har unvisited neighbour ko enqueue karta hai, enqueue karte hi unhe visited mark karte hue taake repeats se bacha ja sake. Loop tab khatam hota hai jab queue khali ho jaye.

en: Determines if a given floating-point number is ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek diya gaya floating-point number ⟦0⟧ hai ya nahi.

en: Loop through the string stepping by two, starting at index 1. For each digit, compute its numeric value, add it to the preceding letter's ASCII code, and store the result back at the digit's position. Return the updated string.
ru: Index 1 se shuru karke, string ko do do steps mein loop karta hai. Har digit ke liye, uski numeric value compute karta hai, use pehle wale letter ke ASCII code mein add karta hai, aur result ko digit ki position par wapas store kar deta hai. Updated string return karta hai.

en: Compute and display the length of a perpendicular bisector defined by two radii.
ru: Do radii se define ki gayi ek perpendicular bisector ki length compute karta hai aur display karta hai.

en: Uses an unordered map to keep track of the replacement characters. Iterates through the input string, assigns a unique lowercase letter to each new character, and updates the string accordingly.
ru: Replacement characters track karne ke liye ek unordered map istemal karta hai. Input string ke through iterate karta hai, har naye character ko ek unique lowercase letter assign karta hai, aur us hisab se string update kar deta hai.

en: Iterate i from 1 to √n + 1; each time i divides n, add 1 (perfect square) or 2 (divisor pair) to a counter. After the loop, output based on the counter’s parity.
ru: i ko 1 se √n + 1 tak iterate karta hai. Jab i, n ko divide kare to perfect square ki surat mein 1 aur divisor pair ki surat mein 2 counter mein add karta hai. Loop ke baad counter ki parity ke mutabiq result output karta hai.

en: Perform BFS from the central ⟦0⟧ to obtain shortest distances to all clients. For each client, calculate its round‑trip time and how many resend intervals occur before the first reply, then derive the time the last reply arrives. The answer is the maximum such time across all clients.
ru: Sab clients ke shortest distances hasil karne ke liye central ⟦0⟧ se BFS perform karta hai. Har client ke liye, uska round-trip time aur pehli reply se pehle kitne resend intervals hote hain calculate karta hai, phir last reply aane ka time derive karta hai. Answer sab clients mein aisa maximum time hota hai.

en: Perform a post‑order ⟦0⟧. For each node, recursively verify that both left and right subtrees consist solely of in‑range nodes. If they do and the current node’s value is in range, increment the counter. The helper returns a boolean indicating subtree validity, allowing the parent to decide its own inclusion.
ru: Ek post-order ⟦0⟧ perform karta hai. Har node ke liye, recursively verify karta hai ke dono left aur right subtrees sirf in-range nodes par mushtamil hon. Agar ho aur current node ki value range mein ho, counter increment kar deta hai. Helper ek boolean return karta hai jo subtree validity indicate karta hai, jisse parent apni inclusion decide kar sake.

en: Iterates i from 1 to n, adding i × (n‑i) to an accumulator, then adds n to account for the final step. The formula simplifies the sum of products across all split points.
ru: i ko 1 se n tak iterate karta hai, i × (n-i) ko ek accumulator mein add karte hue, phir final step ko account karne ke liye n add karta hai. Formula sab split points ke across products ke sum ko simplify karta hai.

en: Decodes a packed integer into separate game state components.
ru: Ek packed integer ko separate game state components mein decode karta hai.

en: An ⟦0⟧ representing the maximum number of runes that can be reserved together under the adjacency rule.
ru: Aik ⟦0⟧ jo adjacency rule ke tehat aik sath reserve kiye ja sakne wale runes ki maximum tadaad ko represent karta hai.

en: Count each character’s frequency, then iteratively perform a forward ⟦0⟧ appending any remaining letters, followed by a backward ⟦1⟧ doing the same, until the result length matches the original. This yields the required alternating smallest‑largest sequence.
ru: Har character ki frequency count karta hai, phir remaining letters ko append karte hue iteratively ek forward ⟦0⟧ perform karta hai, uske baad wahi kaam karne wala ek backward ⟦1⟧, jab tak result ki length original ke barabar na ho jaye. Ye zaroori alternating smallest-largest sequence deta hai.

en: int – count of cells whose final value equals the maximum possible after all ops.
ru: int – un cells ka count jinki final value sab ops ke baad maximum possible ke barabar ho.

en: For each integer i from 2 to N, test i and i‑2 for primality using a helper that checks divisibility up to √i; increment a counter when both are prime; finally output the counter.
ru: Har integer i ke liye 2 se N tak, i aur i-2 ki primality check karta hai. Is ke liye aik helper use karta hai jo √i tak divisibility check karta hai. Jab dono prime hon to counter ko increment karta hai aur aakhir mein counter ko output karta hai.

en: Determines a textual direction based on two integers.
ru: Do integers ke hisab se ek textual direction determine karta hai.

en: The function flips the zero‑based top‑down index to a bottom‑up count by computing 1 + (rows - 1 - row), then converts that integer to a string using ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ye function zero-based top-down index ko 1 + (rows - 1 - row) compute karke bottom-up count mein flip karta hai, phir us integer ko ⟦0⟧ istemal karke string mein convert kar deta hai.

en: A vector of two integers representing the indices of the pair, or ⟦0⟧ if none exist.
ru: Do integers ka ek vector jo pair ke indices represent karta hai, ya ⟦0⟧ agar koi na ho.

en: vector& nums – the array of integers; int k – maximum allowed index distance between consecutive chosen elements.
ru: vector& nums – integers ka array; int k – consecutive chosen elements ke darmiyan maximum allowed index distance.

en: Index outer and Index inner – logical indices used by the outer‑inner indexing scheme.
ru: Index outer aur Index inner – outer-inner indexing scheme ke istemal hone wale logical indices.

en: Combines two hash values into a single hash.
ru: Do hash values ko ek single hash mein combine karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – two integer vectors to be merged; ⟦1⟧ – the vector to be sorted.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – merge hone wale do integer vectors; ⟦1⟧ – sort hone wala vector.

en: Determine which corner a laser ray reaches in a rectangular room with mirrored walls.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke mirrored walls wale ek rectangular room mein laser ray kis corner tak pahunchti hai.

en: Compute the longest strictly increasing path moving only right, right‑up, or right‑down in a grid.
ru: Grid mein sirf right, right-up, ya right-down move karte hue sab se lambi strictly increasing path calculate karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - The input stream to read from; ⟦1⟧ - The vector to store the tetrahedral indices; ⟦2⟧ - The number of tetrahedra to read; ⟦3⟧ - Flag indicating whether the input is in binary format.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - jahan se parhna hai wo input stream; ⟦1⟧ - tetrahedral indices store karne wala vector; ⟦2⟧ - parhne wale tetrahedra ki tadaad; ⟦3⟧ - flag jo batata hai ke input binary format mein hai ya nahi.

en: int – the duplicated integer.
ru: int – duplicate hone wala integer.

en: Extracts header names from "//import <...>" directives in a C‑style source string.
ru: C-style source string mein "//import <...>" directives se header names extract karta hai.

en: An int representing the k‑th smallest total sum.
ru: Ek int jo k-th smallest total sum represent karta hai.

en: Nodes store the XOR of previous and next ⟦0⟧. Insertion updates the old head’s XOR to include the new node and sets the new node’s XOR to point to the old head. Traversal recomputes the next node by XOR‑ing the previous node with the stored ⟦1⟧. ⟦2⟧ first moves N steps forward, then walks to the list end while a second pointer lags, ultimately printing the data of the lagging pointer.
ru: Nodes previous aur next ⟦0⟧ ka XOR store karte hain. Insertion old head ke XOR ko naye node ko shamil karne ke liye update karti hai aur naye node ke XOR ko old head ki taraf point karne ke liye set karti hai. Traversal previous node ko stored ⟦1⟧ se XOR karke next node recompute karta hai. ⟦2⟧ pehle N steps forward move karta hai, phir list ke end tak chalta hai jabke ek doosra pointer piche rehta hai, akhir mein lagging pointer ka data print karte hue.

en: Converts a single character representing a hexadecimal digit to its corresponding integer value.
ru: Ek single character jo hexadecimal digit represent karta hai use uski corresponding integer value mein convert karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧; side‑effects are the registration of the two points at infinity.
ru: ⟦0⟧; side-effects infinity par do points ka registration hain.

en: Two ints A and B, representing the numbers to add.
ru: Do ints A aur B, jo add karne wale numbers represent karte hain.

en: Compute the maximum length of consecutive '0's in a binary string, allowing a wrap‑around segment that joins leading and trailing zeros.
ru: Binary string mein consecutive '0's ki maximum length calculate karta hai, aur wrap-around segment ko bhi allow karta hai jo starting aur ending zeros ko connect karta hai.

en: Extracts the first keyword from input.
ru: Input se pehla keyword extract karta hai.

en: Sort the cards ascending. Iterate over the result array cyclically, filling the first empty slot, then skipping the next empty slot, repeating until all cards are placed. This simulates the “reveal‑and‑move‑bottom” process in reverse.
ru: Cards ko ascending sort karta hai. Result array par cyclically iterate karta hai, pehla empty slot fill karke, phir agla empty slot skip karke, sab cards place hone tak repeat karte hue. Ye "reveal-and-move-bottom" process ko reverse mein simulate karta hai.

en: Securely erase any unused portion of the internal buffer.
ru: Internal buffer ke jo portion use nahi ho rahe, unhein securely erase karta hai.

en: Provides access to a shared static pointer of type T.
ru: Type T ke ek shared static pointer tak access faraham karta hai.

en: Returns a copy of an image file recolored with a single base color.
ru: Image file ki aik copy return karta hai jise aik single base color ke sath recolor kiya gaya ho.

en: Computes the array after repeatedly scaling the smallest element k times.
ru: Sabse chote element ko k baar scale karne ke baad array compute karta hai.

en: Iterate over each row, count ⟦0⟧ characters, and store counts for rows with at least one beam. Then traverse the collected counts, adding the product of each adjacent pair to the result. Edge ⟦1⟧ naturally yield zero.
ru: Har row par iterate karta hai, ⟦0⟧ characters count karta hai, aur un rows ke counts store karta hai jinmein kam az kam ek beam ho. Phir collected counts ko traverse karta hai, har adjacent pair ka product result mein add karte hue. Edge cases ⟦1⟧ naturally zero deti hain.

en: Calculate averages of subarrays of size 2k+1 in the given array.
ru: Diye gaye array mein size 2k+1 ke subarrays ke averages calculate karta hai.

en: Handle the trivial cases of one or two numbers directly. For longer lists, place the first number outside parentheses and group all subsequent numbers inside a single pair of parentheses, concatenating them with '/' to ensure the denominator is multiplied, which maximizes the overall value.
ru: Ek ya do numbers ke simple cases ko directly handle karta hai. Lambi list ke liye pehle number ko parentheses ke bahar rakhta hai aur baqi tamam numbers ko aik hi pair of parentheses ke andar group karta hai, unhein '/' se concatenate karta hai taake denominator multiply ho aur overall value maximum ho.

en: Log the point of sv for debugging, then retrieve the index from sv0 and assign it to sv. The function assumes both handles are valid.
ru: Debugging ke liye sv ka point log karta hai, phir sv0 se index retrieve karke use sv ko assign kar deta hai. Function assume karta hai ke dono handles valid hain.

en: Build a suffix ⟦0⟧ where ⟦1⟧ holds the count of ‘a’ characters from i to the end. Then scan the string left‑to‑right, maintaining the count of ‘b’ seen so ⟦2⟧. At each split point i, the deletions needed equal ⟦3⟧ plus ⟦4⟧ (remove following ‘a’s); the minimum over all split points is returned.
ru: Ek suffix ⟦0⟧ build karta hai jahan ⟦1⟧ i se end tak 'a' characters ka count rakhta hai. Phir string ko left-to-right scan karta hai, ab tak dekhe gaye 'b' ka count ⟦2⟧ maintain karte hue. Har split point i par, zaroori deletions ⟦3⟧ plus ⟦4⟧ ke barabar hoti hain (baad wale 'a's remove karte hue); sab split points mein se minimum return kiya jata hai.

en: The function first asserts that the cell's dimension is ⟦0⟧. It then obtains and returns the vertex handle by calling ⟦1⟧ on the stored cell handle.
ru: Function sab se pehle check karta hai ke cell ki dimension ⟦0⟧ hai. Phir stored cell handle par ⟦1⟧ call karke vertex handle hasil karta hai aur return karta hai.

en: For each digit 0‑9, iterate through the array, remove that digit from each number using string conversion, sum the results, and track the minimum sum across all digits. Finally, output the minimum.
ru: Har digit 0-9 ke liye, array ke through iterate karta hai, string conversion istemal karke har number se wo digit remove karta hai, results ka sum leta hai, aur sab digits mein minimum sum track karta hai. Akhir mein, minimum output karta hai.

en: int N – the target integer to test.
ru: int N – woh target integer jise test karna hai.

en: The function maintains two arrays: ⟦0⟧ stores the lowest effective cost for i‑th transaction, and ⟦1⟧ stores the best profit after i transactions. It scans prices once, updating these arrays in reverse order so each step can reuse the previous transaction’s profit, yielding ⟦2⟧ time and ⟦3⟧ extra space.
ru: Ye function do arrays maintain karta hai: ⟦0⟧ i-th transaction ke liye sabse kam effective cost store karta hai, aur ⟦1⟧ i transactions ke baad best profit store karta hai. Ye prices ko ek dafa scan karta hai, in arrays ko reverse order mein update karte hue taake har step pichli transaction ka profit reuse kar sake, ⟦2⟧ time aur ⟦3⟧ extra space dete hue.

en: Generate Pascal's Triangle up to the nth row.
ru: nth row tak Pascal's Triangle generate karta hai.

en: Early‑exit checks discard cases where the behind object is slower or equal. If needed, the positions and speeds are swapped so the first object starts ahead. Then the code simulates simultaneous jumps until the leading object falls behind; equality at any step yields true.
ru: Early-exit checks un cases ko discard karti hain jahan peeche wala object slower ya equal ho. Agar zaroori ho, positions aur speeds swap kar diye jate hain taake pehla object aage se shuru ho. Phir code simultaneous jumps simulate karta hai jab tak leading object peeche na reh jaye; kisi bhi step par equality true deti hai.

en: Compute the planar area of a simple polygon given its vertex coordinates.
ru: Ek simple polygon ke vertex coordinates diye jane par uska planar area compute karta hai.

en: For each puzzle generate all 2⁶ possible letter subsets that include the mandatory first letter and map each resulting bitmask to the puzzle’s index. Then, for each word compute its unique letter bitmask; if that mask exists in the map, increment the counters of all associated puzzles.
ru: Har puzzle ke liye sab 2⁶ possible letter subsets generate karta hai jo mandatory first letter shamil karte hon aur har resulting bitmask ko puzzle ke index se map karta hai. Phir, har word ke liye uska unique letter bitmask compute karta hai; agar wo mask map mein mojood ho, sab associated puzzles ke counters ko increment kar deta hai.

en: Performs a binary search on the array, checking at each midpoint whether K falls within the interval. If K is less than the interval's start, the search continues in the left sub‑array; otherwise it proceeds right. Returns the found index or -1 after exhausting the search space.
ru: Array par ek binary search perform karta hai, har midpoint par check karte hue ke K interval ke andar aata hai ya nahi. Agar K interval ke start se kam ho, search left sub-array mein continue hoti hai; warna right ki taraf proceed karti hai. Search space khatam hone ke baad found index ya -1 return karta hai.

en: First verify the triangle inequality for the three sides; if it fails, return "none". Then compare the sides: if all equal, return "equilateral"; if all distinct, return "scalene"; otherwise, return "isosceles".
ru: Pehle teen sides ke liye triangle inequality verify karta hai; agar fail ho, "none" return karta hai. Phir sides compare karta hai: agar sab equal hon, "equilateral" return karta hai; agar sab distinct hon, "scalene"; warna, "isosceles" return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - The minimum value found in the tree.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - Tree mein milne wali minimum value.

en: A vector where index i contains the identifier of the last marked node on the optimal path from node i.
ru: Ek vector jahan index i us last marked node ka identifier rakhta hai jo node i se optimal path par hai.

en: Interprets the float’s bit pattern as an integer, applies the classic fast inverse‑square‑root magic ⟦0⟧ to obtain an estimate of 1/√number, then multiplies by the original value to yield √number. This leverages IEEE‑754 exponent bias for a quick initial guess.
ru: Float ke bit pattern ko ek integer ki tarah interpret karta hai, 1/√number ka estimate hasil karne ke liye classic fast inverse-square-root magic ⟦0⟧ apply karta hai, phir √number dene ke liye original value se multiply karta hai. Ye ek quick initial guess ke liye IEEE-754 exponent bias ka faida uthata hai.

en: Store the original number, then repeatedly strip its least‑significant digit, appending each stripped digit to the right of the stored number. The loop stops when no digits remain, yielding a number whose right half is the reverse of the left ⟦0⟧.
ru: Original number ko store karta hai, phir repeatedly uska least-significant digit remove karta hai aur har removed digit ko stored number ke right side par append karta hai. Loop tab rukta hai jab tamam digits khatam ho jayein, jis se aisa number hasil hota hai jiska right half left ⟦0⟧ ka reverse hota hai.

en: Uses bitwise AND to check each bit of 'b'. If the bit is set, multiplies 'res' by 'a'.
ru: Bitwise AND use karke b ke har bit ko check karta hai. Agar bit set ho to res ko a ke sath multiply karta hai.

en: Compute the maximum possible length of a balanced string using all three types of brackets present in the input.
ru: Input mein mojood sab teen types ke brackets istemal karke ek balanced string ki maximum possible length compute karta hai.

en: Calculate the smallest axis-aligned cuboid enclosing a given bounding box.
ru: Di gayi bounding box ko enclose karne wala sab se chhota axis-aligned cuboid calculate karta hai.

en: Use a sliding window with two ⟦0⟧ maintaining the sum of the current window. While expanding, shrink the window when the sum exceeds the goal or when leading zeros can be skipped, tracking the number of consecutive ⟦1⟧. When the sum matches the goal, add ⟦2⟧ to the answer, accounting for all subarrays that start at any of those zeros.
ru: Do ⟦0⟧ ke sath ek sliding window istemal karta hai jo current window ka sum maintain karta hai. Expand karte hue, window ko shrink karta hai jab sum goal se zyada ho jaye ya jab leading zeros skip kiye ja sakte hon, consecutive ⟦1⟧ ka number track karte hue. Jab sum goal se match kare, answer mein ⟦2⟧ add karta hai, un sab subarrays ko account karte hue jo un zeros mein se kisi bhi se start hote hon.

en: Iterate i from 1 to k, compute i! using a helper that multiplies numbers sequentially, and test divisibility by k; return the first i that meets the condition.
ru: i ko 1 se k tak iterate karta hai, ek helper istemal karke i! compute karta hai jo numbers ko sequentially multiply karta hai, aur k se divisibility test karta hai; wo pehla i return karta hai jo condition poora kare.

en: Initialize the result with the trivial divisors. Loop i from 2 up to √x; whenever i divides x, replace the result with the ⟦0⟧. After the loop, return the stored ⟦1⟧.
ru: Result ko trivial divisors se initialize karta hai. i ko 2 se √x tak loop karta hai; jab bhi i, x ko divide kare, result ko ⟦0⟧ se replace kar deta hai. Loop ke baad, stored ⟦1⟧ return kar deta hai.

en: Extract the pivot ⟦0⟧ from ⟦1⟧, advance the LU pointer past eliminated rows, then iterate over the remaining rows, subtracting ⟦0⟧ times the corresponding L entries from the dense ⟦2⟧. A final single‑row update handles an odd ⟦3⟧.
ru: ⟦1⟧ se pivot ⟦0⟧ extract karta hai, LU pointer ko eliminated rows ke aage advance karta hai, phir remaining rows par iterate karta hai, dense ⟦2⟧ se corresponding L entries ka ⟦0⟧ guna subtract karte hue. Ek final single-row update odd ⟦3⟧ handle karta hai.

en: The function initializes a local ⟦0⟧ object ⟦1⟧ with the value of ⟦2⟧. It then calls the member function ⟦3⟧ on ⟦1⟧ with ⟦4⟧ as the argument, effectively subtracting ⟦4⟧ from ⟦1⟧. The modified ⟦1⟧ is returned.
ru: Ye function ⟦2⟧ ki value ke sath ek local ⟦0⟧ object ⟦1⟧ initialize karta hai. Phir ye ⟦1⟧ par member function ⟦3⟧ ko ⟦4⟧ ko argument ki tarah lekar call karta hai, effectively ⟦1⟧ mein se ⟦4⟧ subtract karte hue. Modified ⟦1⟧ return kar diya jata hai.

en: The sequence repeats every 4 steps with ⟦0⟧ × (d0+d1) mod 10. Compute the sum of one full 4‑term ⟦1⟧, count how many complete blocks fit in k‑3, add the remaining 0‑3 ⟦2⟧ via a switch, then test the total sum modulo 3. Edge cases: k < 3 yields negative block count; C++’s % on negative numbers may affect the result.
ru: Sequence har 4 steps mein ⟦0⟧ × (d0+d1) mod 10 ke sath repeat hoti hai. Ek full 4-term ⟦1⟧ ka sum compute karta hai, k-3 mein kitne complete blocks fit hote hain count karta hai, ek switch ke zariye remaining 0-3 ⟦2⟧ add karta hai, phir total sum ko modulo 3 test karta hai. Edge cases: k < 3 negative block count deta hai; negative numbers par C++'s % result ko affect kar sakta hai.

en: Cast dst to a ⟦0⟧*, then iteratively store the least‑significant byte of w and shift w right by 8 bits, repeating six times. Higher bits of w are ignored.
ru: dst ko ek ⟦0⟧* mein cast karta hai, phir iteratively w ka least-significant byte store karta hai aur w ko 8 bits right shift karta hai, chhe baar repeat karte hue. w ke higher bits ignore kiye jate hain.

en: Returns the integer resulting from the bit ⟦0⟧.
ru: Bit ⟦0⟧ se milne wala integer return karta hai.

en: Prints the triplet to ⟦0⟧ or a not‑found message; returns void.
ru: Triplet ko ⟦0⟧ par print karta hai ya ek not-found message; void return karta hai.

en: Nested loops iterate through each element to check if its negation is also in the array. Updates the result with the maximum absolute value found.
ru: Nested loops har element ke liye iterate karte hain ye check karne ke liye ke uski negation bhi array mein hai ya nahi. Result ko mile hue maximum absolute value se update kar deta hai.

en: Initialise a vector of size col. Repeatedly take the remainder of state modulo 3 to obtain the next digit, store it, then divide state by 3. Continue for all positions, leaving any remaining slots as zero.
ru: Size col ka ek vector initialise karta hai. Baar baar state ka modulo 3 se remainder leta hai agla digit hasil karne ke liye, use store karta hai, phir state ko 3 se divide karta hai. Sab positions ke liye continue karta hai, kisi bhi remaining slots ko zero rakhte hue.

en: Computes the smallest integer k such that the sum 1+2+…+k exceeds the original input n‑1.
ru: Sabse chota integer k compute karta hai jaise sum 1+2+…+k original input n-1 se zyada ho jaye.

en: Compute the sum of all node values that reside at the deepest level of a binary tree.
ru: Binary tree ke deepest level par mojood tamam nodes ki values ka sum calculate karta hai.

en: The function checks for a null ⟦0⟧, executes ⟦1⟧ on the current node, recursively traverses the left subtree, prints the node’s value, then recursively traverses the right subtree, thereby visiting nodes in left‑node‑right order.
ru: Ye function ek null ⟦0⟧ check karta hai, current node par ⟦1⟧ execute karta hai, left subtree ko recursively traverse karta hai, node ki value print karta hai, phir right subtree ko recursively traverse karta hai, is tarah nodes ko left-node-right order mein visit karte hue.

en: Initialise a vector with all player IDs. Repeatedly pair the first and last remaining players, advancing the tracked players automatically and randomly selecting a winner for other pairs. After each round, sort survivors to maintain deterministic pairing order. Continue until the two tracked players are paired, then return the current round count.
ru: Sab player IDs ke sath ek vector initialise karta hai. Baar baar remaining players mein pehle aur akhri ko pair karta hai, tracked players ko automatically advance karte hue aur baaki pairs ke liye randomly ek winner select karte hue. Har round ke baad, deterministic pairing order maintain karne ke liye survivors ko sort karta hai. Jab tak do tracked players pair na ho jayein continue karta hai, phir current round count return kar deta hai.

en: Each string is sorted individually. Then, for every ⟦0⟧ and for each adjacent pair of rows i and i+1 up to len‑1, the code checks that the character in row i is ≤ the character in row i+1. If any violation is found, it returns false; otherwise it returns true.
ru: Har string ko individually sort karta hai. Phir har ⟦0⟧ ke liye adjacent rows i aur i+1 ko len-1 tak check karta hai aur dekhta hai ke row i ka character, row i+1 ke character se chhota ya barabar hai. Agar koi violation mile to false return karta hai, warna true return karta hai.

en: Returns the index of the last remaining ⟦0⟧.
ru: Last remaining ⟦0⟧ ka index return karta hai.

en: Performs a breadth‑first search on the state space of remaining values, starting from n. Each transition subtracts a square i², generating a new remainder. The first time 0 is reached yields the optimal count because BFS explores states by increasing step count. A visited array prevents revisiting the same remainder.
ru: n se shuru karke remaining values ke state space par ek breadth-first search perform karta hai. Har transition ek square i² subtract karta hai, ek naya remainder generate karte hue. Pehli baar 0 milna optimal count deta hai kyunke BFS states ko increasing step count ke hisab se explore karta hai. Ek visited array wahi remainder revisit hone se rokta hai.

en: Returns a double representing the counter‑factual reach ⟦0⟧.
ru: Aik double return karta hai jo counter-factual reach ⟦0⟧ ko represent karta hai.

en: Global doubles r1, r2, r3 representing the radii of the three outer circles.
ru: Global doubles r1, r2, r3 jo teen outer circles ke radii ko represent karte hain.

en: Convert a string to a double.
ru: Ek string ko double mein convert karta hai.

en: Concatenate ⟦0⟧ with itself and check if ⟦1⟧ is a substring of this concatenated string. This works because any rotation of ⟦0⟧ will appear as a substring in ⟦2⟧.
