ru: ⟦0⟧ ko khud ke sath concatenate karta hai aur check karta hai ke kya ⟦1⟧ is concatenated string ka substring hai. Yeh is liye kaam karta hai kyun ke ⟦0⟧ ki koi bhi rotation ⟦2⟧ mein substring ke taur par mojood hogi.

en: Start with an identity matrix, then overwrite the elements of the fourth row (⟦0⟧, (3,1), (3,2)) with the components of T, leaving the rest of the matrix unchanged. The resulting matrix represents a pure translation.
ru: Identity matrix se start karta hai, phir fourth row ke elements (⟦0⟧, (3,1), (3,2)) ko T ke components se overwrite karta hai, jabke baqi matrix ko unchanged rakhta hai. Resulting matrix pure translation ko represent karta hai.

en: Simulate request handling using a min‑⟦0⟧ for busy servers and a ⟦1⟧ for idle ones; for each request, free completed servers, locate the appropriate idle server respecting circular assignment, update counts, and finally gather servers with the maximal count.
ru: Busy servers ke liye min-⟦0⟧ aur idle servers ke liye ⟦1⟧ use karke requests ko simulate karta hai. Har request ke liye completed servers ko free karta hai, circular assignment ko follow karte hue munasib idle server find karta hai, counts update karta hai aur aakhir mein sab se zyada count wale servers ko collect karta hai.

en: Calls '⟦0⟧' with the flag set to true to keep the specified components.
ru: ‘⟦0⟧’ ko flag true ke sath call karta hai taake specified components ko rakha ja sake.

en: For each row in the image, iterate through its pixels, outputting each pixel followed by a tab. After finishing a row, output a newline to start the next row. This preserves the original row/column structure in the console.
ru: Image ki har row ke liye, uske pixels par iterate karta hai, har pixel ke baad ek tab output karte hue. Ek row khatam hone ke baad, agli row shuru karne ke liye ek newline output karta hai. Ye console mein original row/column structure preserve karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – number of users; ⟦1⟧ – list of forbidden user pairs; ⟦2⟧ – list of friend‑request pairs.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – users ki tadaad; ⟦1⟧ – forbidden user pairs ki list; ⟦2⟧ – friend-request pairs ki list.

en: Not applicable here; this struct supplies the ⟦0⟧ that tree ⟦1⟧ rely on to navigate and store ordered data.
ru: Yahan applicable nahi; ye struct wo ⟦0⟧ faraham karta hai jin par tree ⟦1⟧ navigate karne aur ordered data store karne ke liye rely karte hain.

en: Repeatedly decrement all three numbers while they remain positive, counting the iterations. The iteration count equals the smallest original value; the loop exits as soon as any value hits zero. Edge case: if any argument is non‑positive, the loop never runs and the function returns 0.
ru: Jab tak teeno numbers positive rahein, baar baar unhe decrement karta hai, iterations count karte hue. Iteration count sabse chote original value ke barabar hota hai; jaise hi koi value zero par pahunche loop khatam ho jata hai. Edge case: agar koi argument non-positive ho, loop kabhi nahi chalta aur function 0 return karta hai.

en: Repeatedly output the lowest 7 bits of ⟦0⟧, setting the high bit to indicate continuation, and right‑shift ⟦0⟧ by 7 until it fits in one byte. Finally write the remaining 7‑bit chunk without the continuation flag and return the updated buffer pointer.
ru: Baar baar ⟦0⟧ ke lowest 7 bits output karta hai, continuation indicate karne ke liye high bit set karte hue, aur ⟦0⟧ ko 7 se right-shift karta hai jab tak wo ek byte mein fit ho jaye. Akhir mein bina continuation flag ke remaining 7-bit chunk likhta hai aur updated buffer pointer return karta hai.

en: Count each value’s frequency using a fixed‑size offset array. Then scan the frequency array; for each non‑zero count, treat the count itself as an index and check if that index has already been marked. A previously marked index signals a duplicate frequency, causing an early ⟦0⟧. If the scan finishes without conflict, return ⟦1⟧.
ru: Ek fixed-size offset array istemal karke har value ki frequency count karta hai. Phir frequency array scan karta hai; har non-zero count ke liye, count ko khud ek index ki tarah treat karta hai aur check karta hai ke wo index pehle se mark ho chuka hai ya nahi. Pehle se marked index duplicate frequency signal karta hai, jisse ek early ⟦0⟧ hota hai. Agar scan bina conflict ke khatam ho jaye, ⟦1⟧ return karta hai.

en: Repeatedly take the remainder of num divided by 2, convert it to the character '0' or '1', and append to the result while dividing num by 2 until it reaches zero. The loop builds the string from least‑significant to most‑significant bit.
ru: Baar baar num ko 2 se divide karne ka remainder leta hai, use character '0' ya '1' mein convert karta hai, aur result mein append karta hai jabke num ko 2 se divide karta hai jab tak zero na ho jaye. Loop string ko least-significant se most-significant bit tak build karta hai.

en: This function processes the input signal to generate a wavetable. It iterates through the signal, calculating two entries in the wavetable for each pair of adjacent samples. The final two entries handle the wrap-around effect by connecting the last sample to the first.
ru: Ye function ek wavetable generate karne ke liye input signal ko process karta hai. Ye signal ke through iterate karta hai, har adjacent samples ke pair ke liye wavetable mein do entries calculate karte hue. Aakhri do entries wrap-around effect handle karti hain last sample ko first se connect karke.

en: Initialize a default name "unknown". Use a preprocessor chain to replace it with a specific OS name when the corresponding macro is defined. Finally, return the resulting pointer. If none of the macros match, the default remains.
ru: Ek default name "unknown" initialize karta hai. Jab corresponding macro defined ho toh use ek specific OS name se replace karne ke liye ek preprocessor chain istemal karta hai. Akhir mein, resulting pointer return karta hai. Agar koi macro match na kare, default rehta hai.

en: Prints all factorial values that are less than or equal to a given limit.
ru: Sab factorial values print karta hai jo ek di gayi limit se kam ya barabar hon.

en: Repeatedly clear the least‑significant set bit using mask &= mask-1, incrementing a counter each iteration; the loop terminates when no bits remain, yielding the pop‑count in ⟦0⟧ time.
ru: mask &= mask-1 istemal karke baar baar least-significant set bit clear karta hai, har iteration mein ek counter increment karte hue; loop tab khatam hota hai jab koi bit na bache, pop-count ⟦0⟧ time mein deta hue.

en: Calls ⟦0⟧ (policy‑aware truncation) to obtain the integer portion, stores it via the pointer, then subtracts this integer from the original value to produce the fractional remainder.
ru: Integer portion hasil karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ (policy-aware truncation) call karta hai, use pointer ke zariye store karta hai, phir fractional remainder produce karne ke liye is integer ko original value se subtract kar deta hai.

en: Compares two integers based on their parity and value.
ru: Do integers ko unki parity aur value ke hisab se compare karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - Error status indicating success or failure.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - Error status jo success ya failure ko indicate karta hai.

en: Iterate through both vectors simultaneously, maintaining an unordered map to track the frequency of elements seen so far. Increment a counter whenever an element is encountered for the second time in either vector. Store the counter value at each position in the result vector.
ru: Dono vectors par simultaneously iterate karta hai, ab tak dekhe gaye elements ki frequency track karne ke liye ek unordered map maintain karte hue. Jab bhi kisi vector mein koi element doosri baar mile, ek counter increment karta hai. Result vector mein har position par counter value store karta hai.

en: The function copies the source vertex from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧, then uses the two‑argument overload to insert ⟦1⟧ after ⟦0⟧, and finally inserts ⟦2⟧ after ⟦1⟧, thus maintaining the circular adjacency order.
ru: Ye function source vertex ⟦0⟧ se ⟦1⟧ mein copy karta hai, phir two-argument overload istemal karke ⟦1⟧ ko ⟦0⟧ ke baad insert karta hai, aur akhir mein ⟦2⟧ ko ⟦1⟧ ke baad insert karta hai, is tarah circular adjacency order maintain karte hue.

en: Two integers x and y.
ru: Do integers x aur y.

en: Determines whether the decimal string s2 is an exact integer power of the decimal string s1.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke decimal string s2, decimal string s1 ki exact integer power hai ya nahi.

en: This function calculates the minimum difference between the sum of any two segments of equal length in a given array, where each segment contains exactly one-third of the total elements.
ru: Ye function ek diye gaye array mein equal length ke kisi bhi do segments ke sum ke darmiyan minimum difference calculate karta hai, jahan har segment total elements ka exactly ek-third hota hai.

en: Start with a digit count of 1. Repeatedly compare n against 10, 100, 1000, and 10000, returning the accumulated count when n fits in fewer than four digits. If n is ≥ 10000, divide n by 10000 and add 4 to the count, looping until the condition is met. This reduces the number of division operations by processing four digits per iteration.
ru: 1 ke digit count se shuru karta hai. Baar baar n ko 10, 100, 1000, aur 10000 se compare karta hai, jab n char digits se kam mein fit ho jaye toh accumulated count return karta hai. Agar n ≥ 10000 ho, n ko 10000 se divide karta hai aur count mein 4 add karta hai, condition poori hone tak loop karte hue. Ye har iteration mein char digits process karke division operations kam karta hai.

en: Walk the list once, copying each node’s value into a vector. Then use two ⟦0⟧ to compare elements symmetrically; any mismatch returns false, otherwise true after all pairs match.
ru: List ko ek dafa chalta hai, har node ki value ko ek vector mein copy karte hue. Phir elements ko symmetrically compare karne ke liye do ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai; koi bhi mismatch false return karta hai, warna sab pairs match hone ke baad true.

en: ⟦0⟧ first searches for the smallest palindrome prefix by increasing length and breaks when found; if none exists it returns ⟦1⟧. Then it searches for any palindrome suffix of length ≥ 2, returning ⟦2⟧ on the first match; otherwise ⟦1⟧. Palindrome testing is delegated to ⟦3⟧, which reverses a copy of the candidate substring and compares it to the original.
ru: ⟦0⟧ pehle increasing length se sabse chota palindrome prefix search karta hai aur milne par break kar deta hai; agar koi na ho ⟦1⟧ return karta hai. Phir ye length ≥ 2 wali koi bhi palindrome suffix search karta hai, pehle match par ⟦2⟧ return karte hue; warna ⟦1⟧. Palindrome testing ⟦3⟧ ko delegate ki jati hai, jo candidate substring ki ek copy reverse karke use original se compare karta hai.

en: Compute prefix sums and a suffix‑minimum array of those sums. Then slide two ⟦0⟧ across the array, using the minima to test in ⟦1⟧ whether the current window can be extended while staying ≤ k, updating the best length found. The overall complexity is ⟦2⟧ time and ⟦2⟧ extra space.
ru: Prefix sums aur un sums ka ek suffix-minimum array compute karta hai. Phir array ke across do ⟦0⟧ slide karta hai, minima istemal karke ⟦1⟧ mein test karta hai ke current window ≤ k rehte hue extend ho sakti hai ya nahi, best length ko update karte hue. Overall complexity ⟦2⟧ time aur ⟦2⟧ extra space hai.

en: Scan s, separating vowels and consonants into two vectors. Compute M = Nc/(Nv‑1) (number of consonants per gap). Then iterate over the vowel vector, appending each vowel and the next M consonants from the consonant vector to the result. Edge cases such as Nv ≤ 1 are not handled in the original code.
ru: s ko scan karta hai, vowels aur consonants ko do vectors mein separate karte hue. M = Nc/(Nv-1) compute karta hai (har gap mein consonants ki tadaad). Phir vowel vector par iterate karta hai, har vowel aur consonant vector se agle M consonants ko result mein append karte hue. Nv ≤ 1 jese edge cases original code mein handle nahi kiye gaye.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the mesh is modified in‑place; no value is returned.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – mesh in-place modify hoti hai; koi value return nahi hoti.

en: Convert the 1‑based indices to 0‑based, then append each vertex to the other's adjacency list. No validation is performed; the caller must guarantee valid indices.
ru: 1-based indices ko 0-based mein convert karta hai, phir har vertex ko doosre vertex ki adjacency list mein add karta hai. Koi validation perform nahi karta; caller ko valid indices ensure karne honge.

en: Provides a cross‑platform sleep function that pauses the current thread for a given number of milliseconds.
ru: Ek cross-platform sleep function faraham karta hai jo current thread ko di gayi milliseconds ki tadaad ke liye pause kar deta hai.

en: Scan the string once to collect indices of all '0's. If the count of zeros is zero or odd, return 0. Otherwise, iterate over the zero indices in steps of two, multiplying the result by the distance between each adjacent pair.
ru: String ko ek dafa scan karke sab '0's ke indices collect karta hai. Agar zeros ka count zero ya odd ho, 0 return karta hai. Warna, zero indices par do do steps mein iterate karta hai, har adjacent pair ke darmiyan distance se result ko multiply karte hue.

en: The function simply copies the location from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧ and returns ⟦1⟧.
ru: Function sirf ⟦0⟧ se location ko copy karke ⟦1⟧ mein rakhta hai aur ⟦1⟧ return karta hai.

en: Maintain two min‑heaps – one for idle servers ordered ⟦0⟧ and one for busy servers ordered ⟦1⟧. Simulate time, fast‑forwarding when no idle server exists, releasing servers whose free‑time matches the current time, and assigning tasks that have arrived.
ru: Do min-heaps maintain karta hai – ek idle servers ke liye ⟦0⟧ ke hisab se ordered aur ek busy servers ke liye ⟦1⟧ ke hisab se ordered. Time simulate karta hai, jab koi idle server na ho toh fast-forward karte hue, un servers ko release karte hue jinka free-time current time se match kare, aur aa chuki tasks assign karte hue.

en: Recursively traverse the tree, pruning sub‑trees that cannot contain qualifying ⟦0⟧. If a node’s value is within the range, add it to the sum of both sub‑trees; otherwise, continue only down the side that may hold valid nodes.
ru: Tree ko recursively traverse karta hai, un sub-trees ko prune karte hue jinmein qualifying ⟦0⟧ nahi ho sakte. Agar node ki value range ke andar ho, use dono sub-trees ke sum mein add karta hai; warna, sirf us side down continue karta hai jahan valid nodes ho sakte hain.

en: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ – 64‑bit integers defining the bounds of the ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ – 64-bit integers jo ⟦2⟧ ke bounds define karte hain.

en: The code builds three shifted versions of ⟦0⟧ (×2, ×4) and combines them with XOR to form an initial sum. It then computes the carry bits caused by the addition using AND/OR, iteratively propagates these carries with a loop, and finally right‑shifts the result to complete the division by two, yielding the 3.5× product.
ru: Code ⟦0⟧ ke teen shifted versions (×2, ×4) banata hai aur unhe XOR se combine karke ek initial sum banata hai. Phir ye AND/OR istemal karke addition se hone wale carry bits compute karta hai, ek loop se in carries ko iteratively propagate karta hai, aur akhir mein division by two poora karne ke liye result ko right-shift karta hai, 3.5× product dete hue.

en: Compute results of division queries based on given equations.
ru: Diye gaye equations ke hisab se division queries ke results compute karta hai.

en: Flips the lower 8 bits of the given integer.
ru: Diye gaye integer ke lower 8 bits ko flip karta hai.

en: Compute the maximum weighted sum using available counts of four item types.
ru: Chaar item types ke available counts ka istemal karke maximum weighted sum compute karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a pointer that must actually point to a ⟦1⟧ object containing the execution context.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ek pointer jo actually mein ek ⟦1⟧ object ki taraf point karna chahiye jismein execution context hota hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – base of first series, ⟦1⟧ – base of second series, ⟦2⟧ – exponent multiplier.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – first series ka base, ⟦1⟧ – second series ka base, ⟦2⟧ – exponent multiplier.

en: The function uses a recursive approach where it multiplies the number ⟦0⟧ by the factorial of ⟦1⟧ until it reaches the base case where ⟦0⟧ is either 0 or 1.
ru: Ye function ek recursive approach istemal karta hai jahan ye number ⟦0⟧ ko ⟦1⟧ ke factorial se multiply karta hai jab tak base case tak na pahunche jahan ⟦0⟧ ya toh 0 ho ya 1.

en: Uses binary ⟦0⟧ to compute ⟦1⟧ in ⟦2⟧ time, handling the edge case where the base becomes 0 modulo ⟦3⟧. The ⟦4⟧ function treats N = 1 as a special case before delegating to ⟦5⟧.
ru: ⟦1⟧ ko ⟦2⟧ time mein compute karne ke liye binary ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai, us edge case ko handle karte hue jahan base modulo ⟦3⟧ ke hisab se 0 ho jaye. ⟦4⟧ function N = 1 ko ⟦5⟧ ko delegate karne se pehle ek special case ki tarah treat karta hai.

en: This function sends a notification message to all users in the system without requiring any additional arguments.
ru: Ye function bina kisi additional arguments ke system ke sab users ko ek notification message send karta hai.

en: int N – the count of natural ⟦0⟧; int D – an integer offset to add.
ru: int N – natural ⟦0⟧ ka count; int D – add karne ke liye ek integer offset.

en: an int representing the minimal total cost, or a large ⟦0⟧ if transformation is impossible.
ru: Aik int return karta hai jo minimum total cost ko represent karta hai, ya agar transformation possible na ho to aik bari ⟦0⟧ value return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧<⟦1⟧> – a list of tokens extracted between delimiters.
ru: ⟦0⟧<⟦1⟧> – delimiters ke darmiyan extract ki gayi tokens ki ek list.

en: Uses fread to read the size of T bytes from the file into the memory location pointed to by T.
ru: File se T bytes ki size parhne ke liye fread istemal karta hai T se pointed memory location mein.

en: On entry, store the node’s value and its entry time, then recursively visit all ⟦0⟧. After each child returns, XOR its subtree result into the current node’s accumulator. Finally, store the exit time. This yields both subtree XORs and a valid Euler tour interval for each node.
ru: Entry par, node ki value aur uska entry time store karta hai, phir sab ⟦0⟧ ko recursively visit karta hai. Har child wapas aane ke baad, uska subtree result current node ke accumulator mein XOR kar deta hai. Akhir mein, exit time store karta hai. Ye har node ke liye subtree XORs aur ek valid Euler tour interval dono deta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧<⟦1⟧> – each element is a line of text without the line‑break characters; empty lines are omitted.
ru: ⟦0⟧<⟦1⟧> – har element line-break characters ke bina text ki ek line hai; empty lines omit ki jati hain.

en: Iterate through the vector, maintaining a counter for consecutive positive ⟦0⟧. For each element, reset ⟦1⟧ to 0 if it's 0, otherwise increment it. Add ⟦1⟧ to a running ⟦2⟧ to get the final result.
ru: Vector ke through iterate karta hai, consecutive positive ⟦0⟧ ke liye ek counter maintain karte hue. Har element ke liye, ⟦1⟧ ko 0 par reset karta hai agar wo 0 ho, warna use increment karta hai. Final result hasil karne ke liye ⟦1⟧ ko ek running ⟦2⟧ mein add karta hai.

en: Use a sliding window with two counters for ‘T’ and ‘F’. Expand the right edge, increment the appropriate counter, and while the minority count exceeds k, shrink from the left, decrementing its counter. Track the maximum window size throughout.
ru: Sliding window use karta hai jismein ‘T’ aur ‘F’ ke liye do counters hote hain. Right edge ko expand karke relevant counter increment karta hai. Jab minority count k se zyada ho jaye to left side se window ko shrink karta hai aur uska counter decrement karta hai. Puri process ke dauran maximum window size ko track karta hai.

en: Determines if it's feasible to fix a specified number of cars within a given timeframe based on their ranks.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke cars ki ranks ke hisab se ek specified tadaad diye gaye timeframe ke andar fix karna feasible hai ya nahi.

en: Scan the string counting leading zeros and leading ⟦0⟧. Simultaneously set every character to '1'. If the original string wasn't all '1's, change the character immediately after the counted segment back to '0'. The result is the maximal binary string reachable with a single operation.
ru: String ko scan karke leading zeros aur leading ⟦0⟧ count karta hai. Sath sath har character ko '1' set karta hai. Agar original string sab '1's nahi thi, counted segment ke turant baad wale character ko wapas '0' kar deta hai. Result ek single operation se reachable maximal binary string hota hai.

en: Returns the number of nodes in a BST that are strictly smaller than a given value.
ru: Ek BST mein un nodes ki tadaad return karta hai jo di gayi value se strictly chote hon.

en: Determines whether the Voronoi cell defined by three sites has zero area.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke teen sites se define ki gayi Voronoi cell ka area zero hai ya nahi.

en: A vector<string> s containing the strings and an int n indicating how many elements to process.
ru: Ek vector<string> s jismein strings hoti hain aur ek int n jo batata hai ke kitne elements process karne hain.

en: Use a stack to track unmatched opening brackets. Each time a closing bracket is encountered, pop from the stack if not empty. The final result is half the size of the stack plus one.
ru: Unmatched opening brackets ko track karne ke liye ek stack istemal karta hai. Jab bhi closing bracket mile, agar stack empty na ho toh usmein se pop karta hai. Final result stack ki size ka aadha plus one hota hai.

en: Use a frequency array to count occurrences of each number. If any number's count exceeds 1, return it immediately.
ru: Har number ke occurrences count karne ke liye ek frequency array istemal karta hai. Agar kisi number ka count 1 se zyada ho jaye, turant use return kar deta hai.

en: int – index of key if present; ‑1 otherwise.
ru: int – key ka index agar mojood ho; warna –1.

en: Returns the area of the triangle as a ⟦0⟧.
ru: Triangle ka area ek ⟦0⟧ ke tor par return karta hai.

en: Allocate an output buffer of the same size as the input. If the scaling factor is non‑positive, fill the buffer with zeros; otherwise, multiply each sample by the factor. Return the resulting buffer.
ru: Input ke same size ka output buffer allocate karta hai. Agar scaling factor non-positive ho to buffer ko zeros se fill karta hai; warna har sample ko factor se multiply karta hai. Phir resulting buffer return karta hai.

en: Handles edge ⟦0⟧ then applies the classic recursive formula ⟦1⟧ = (n‑m)·⟦2⟧ + (m+1)·⟦3⟧. The recursion proceeds until reaching a base case.
ru: Edge ⟦0⟧ ko handle karta hai phir classic recursive formula ⟦1⟧ = (n-m)·⟦2⟧ + (m+1)·⟦3⟧ apply karta hai. Recursion tab tak proceed hoti hai jab tak ek base case tak na pahunche.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the value to store in the node's ⟦1⟧ member.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – node ke ⟦1⟧ member mein store karne wali value.

en: The function extracts the substring of ⟦0⟧ that has the same length as ⟦1⟧ using ⟦2⟧ and compares it to ⟦1⟧. If they are equal the function returns ⟦3⟧; otherwise it returns ⟦4⟧. Edge cases such as an empty prefix are naturally handled because the extracted substring will also be empty.
ru: Function ⟦0⟧ ka woh substring extract karta hai jiski length ⟦1⟧ ke barabar ho, ⟦2⟧ ko use karke, aur usay ⟦1⟧ ke sath compare karta hai. Agar dono equal hon to function ⟦3⟧ return karta hai, warna ⟦4⟧ return karta hai. Empty prefix jaisi edge cases naturally handle hoti hain kyun ke extracted substring bhi empty hogi.

en: A ⟦0⟧ object representing the GCD of the input polynomials.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ object jo input polynomials ke GCD ko represent karta hai.

en: Build an adjacency list, then run a Dijkstra‑like search on ⟦0⟧ using a min‑heap. For each popped state, if it reaches dst return its cost; otherwise relax outgoing edges, updating a DP table that stores the best known cost for each node with a given remaining stop count. The search stops when the heap is empty.
ru: Ek adjacency list build karta hai, phir ⟦0⟧ par min-heap istemal karke ek Dijkstra-jaisi search chalata hai. Har popped state ke liye, agar wo dst tak pahunch jaye toh uska cost return karta hai; warna outgoing edges ko relax karta hai, ek DP table update karte hue jo har node ke liye given remaining stop count ke sath best known cost store karta hai. Search tab rukti hai jab heap khali ho jaye.

en: ⟦0⟧ – pointer to the first node of the list.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – list ke pehle node ka pointer.

en: Extract the two bits and compare them; if they differ, build a mask with 1s at those positions and XOR the mask with x to flip both bits, achieving the swap.
ru: Do bits extract karta hai aur unhe compare karta hai; agar wo differ karein, un positions par 1s wala ek mask build karta hai aur dono bits flip karne ke liye mask ko x se XOR karta hai, is tarah swap hasil karte hue.

en: Computes the prefix‑minimum of a cost vector, turning each element into the smallest value seen up to that index.
ru: Ek cost vector ka prefix-minimum compute karta hai, har element ko us index tak dekhi gayi sabse choti value mein tabdeel karte hue.

en: Dynamic programming with two states – the best length ending with the element taken from nums1 or nums2 at the current column. For each column, both states are updated by considering whether the previous choice can be extended while preserving non‑decreasing order, and the global maximum is tracked.
ru: Do states ke sath dynamic programming – current column par nums1 ya nums2 se liye gaye element par khatam hone wali best length. Har column ke liye, dono states ko update kiya jata hai ye consider karte hue ke kya previous choice ko non-decreasing order preserve karte hue extend kiya ja sakta hai, aur global maximum track kiya jata hai.

en: Detects whether an undirected graph component contains a cycle using depth‑first search.
ru: Depth-first search (DFS) use karke check karta hai ke undirected graph ke component mein cycle mojood hai ya nahi.

en: ⟦0⟧ takes a ⟦1⟧ (by value); ⟦2⟧ takes a non‑const reference to ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ek ⟦1⟧ leta hai (by value); ⟦2⟧ ⟦1⟧ ka ek non-const reference leta hai.

en: To create a prism given six points in space.
ru: Space mein diye gaye 6 points ki madad se ek prism create karna.

en: Builds prefixes incrementally while iterating from the first character up to the penultimate one. For each prefix it extracts a suffix ⟦0⟧ equal length and compares them; on equality it outputs the prefix size. The original code mis‑calculates the suffix length and includes an extra leading space in the prefix.
ru: Pehle character se penultimate tak iterate karte hue incrementally prefixes build karta hai. Har prefix ke liye ye ⟦0⟧ equal length ka ek suffix extract karta hai aur unhe compare karta hai; equality par prefix size output karta hai. Original code suffix length ko mis-calculate karta hai aur prefix mein ek extra leading space shamil karta hai.

en: Collect all node values via an inorder traversal, sort the values, then perform a second traversal that overwrites each node with the next value from the sorted list, thereby achieving BST ordering without altering the tree shape.
ru: Ek inorder traversal ke zariye sab node values collect karta hai, values ko sort karta hai, phir ek doosri traversal perform karta hai jo har node ko sorted list ki next value se overwrite karti hai, is tarah tree shape ko change kiye baghair BST ordering hasil karta hai.

en: Iterate through the string. For each '0', add the count of '1's seen so far to the result and skip all subsequent '0's. For each '1', increment the count of '1's seen and move to the next character.
ru: String ke through iterate karta hai. Har '0' ke liye, ab tak dekhe gaye '1's ka count result mein add karta hai aur baad ke sab '0's skip kar deta hai. Har '1' ke liye, dekhe gaye '1's ka count increment karta hai aur agle character par move karta hai.

en: Median* unit – pointer to the Median instance to initialise; long size – number of elements to set; float value – initial value for all median entries.
ru: Median* unit – initialise karne wale Median instance ka pointer; long size – set karne wale elements ki tadaad; float value – tamam median entries ke liye initial value.

en: Fills ⟦0⟧ with the vertex ⟦1⟧, padding with 0.0 for missing dimensions.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko vertex ⟦1⟧ se fill karta hai, missing dimensions ke liye 0.0 se padding karte hue.

en: The node’s value is appended, then the function recursively processes the left child, inserting “null,” if the child is missing, and repeats the same steps for the right child.
ru: Node ki value append hoti hai, phir function left child ko recursively process karta hai, "null," insert karte hue agar child missing ho, aur right child ke liye wahi steps repeat karta hai.

en: Compute the exact floating‑point sum of two numbers and the rounding error.
ru: Do numbers ka exact floating-point sum aur rounding error compute karta hai.

en: Apply the closed‑form variance ⟦0⟧/12, using a 64‑bit integer for the intermediate numerator to reduce overflow risk, then cast to long double for the final division. Edge cases such as n ≤ 0 are not explicitly handled.
ru: Closed-form variance ⟦0⟧/12 apply karta hai. Intermediate numerator ke liye 64-bit integer use karta hai taake overflow ka risk kam ho, phir final division ke liye usay long double mein cast karta hai. n ≤ 0 jaisi edge cases ko explicitly handle nahi karta.

en: A union‑like ⟦0⟧ is used; its ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ fields are filled with the supplied words, then the union’s ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ is read and written to ⟦5⟧. This relies on the platform’s endianness and the layout of the union being compatible with the IEEE‑754 double representation.
ru: Ek union-jaisa ⟦0⟧ istemal hota hai; iske ⟦1⟧ aur ⟦2⟧ fields supplied words se fill kiye jate hain, phir union ka ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ parh kar ⟦5⟧ mein likh diya jata hai. Ye platform ki endianness aur union ke layout ke IEEE-754 double representation ke sath compatible hone par depend karta hai.

en: This function removes the Nth occurrence of a specified subsequence within a given range and copies the resulting sequence to another range.
ru: Ye function ek diye gaye range ke andar ek specified subsequence ka Nth occurrence remove karta hai aur resulting sequence ko doosri range mein copy kar deta hai.

en: Sort the array, then scan it while tracking how many duplicate ⟦0⟧ still need to be moved forward. For each gap between distinct numbers, fill as many pending duplicates as possible using the arithmetic‑series formula; any remaining duplicates are placed after the largest element. The accumulated sum of required increments is returned.
ru: Array ko sort karta hai, phir use scan karta hai ye track karte hue ke kitne duplicate ⟦0⟧ abhi bhi forward move karne zaroori hain. Distinct numbers ke darmiyan har gap ke liye, arithmetic-series formula istemal karke jitni ho sake pending duplicates fill karta hai; koi bhi bache hue duplicates sabse bare element ke baad rakhe jate hain. Zaroori increments ka accumulated sum return kiya jata hai.

en: To rotate the values of three variables cyclically.
ru: Teen variables ki values ko cyclically rotate karne ke liye.

en: Uses platform-specific methods to read memory usage. On Apple, uses ⟦0⟧. On other systems, reads ⟦1⟧ to find the ⟦2⟧.
ru: Memory usage read karne ke liye platform-specific methods istemal karta hai. Apple par, ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai. Doosre systems par, ⟦2⟧ dhoondne ke liye ⟦1⟧ read karta hai.

en: For every edge, temporarily treat it as a cut, run a depth‑first search from each side to obtain the longest path length in each resulting subtree, then keep the maximum product of the two lengths. The DFS returns the best combined path inside the subtree while updating the longest downward path via a reference parameter.
ru: Har edge ke liye, temporarily use ek cut ki tarah treat karta hai, har resulting subtree mein sabse lambi path length hasil karne ke liye har side se ek depth-first search run karta hai, phir dono lengths ka maximum product rakhta hai. DFS ek reference parameter ke zariye sabse lambi downward path update karte hue subtree ke andar best combined path return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – true if the pattern described above exists, false otherwise.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – true agar upar bataya gaya pattern mojood ho, warna false.

en: Returns the maximum k meeting the condition, or –1 if none exist.
ru: Condition ko poora karne wala maximum k return karta hai, ya –1 agar koi na mile.

en: Starting with mask = n, repeatedly right‑shift mask and XOR it into n. Each iteration eliminates the influence of the current highest set bit, effectively accumulating the Gray‑code distance from n to zero. The loop ends when mask becomes zero, leaving n as the answer.
ru: mask = n se shuru karke, baar baar mask ko right-shift karta hai aur use n mein XOR karta hai. Har iteration current highest set bit ka influence eliminate karta hai, effectively n se zero tak Gray-code distance accumulate karte hue. Loop tab khatam hota hai jab mask zero ho jaye, n ko answer chorte hue.

en: A vector of integers ⟦0⟧ representing the initial positions of the chips.
ru: Integers ka ek vector ⟦0⟧ jo chips ki initial positions represent karta hai.

en: Initialize a BFS queue with digits 1‑9. Repeatedly pop the smallest number, store it, and push three possible ⟦0⟧ while respecting digit bounds. After N pops, the last stored value is the answer.
ru: Digits 1-9 ke sath ek BFS queue initialize karta hai. Baar baar sabse chota number pop karta hai, use store karta hai, aur digit bounds ka khayal rakhte hue teen possible ⟦0⟧ push karta hai. N pops ke baad, last stored value hi answer hoti hai.

en: First scan records any node receiving two parents, storing both candidate edges. Then a Union‑Find builds the graph, skipping the later candidate edge; if a cycle appears, the earlier candidate is removed, otherwise the later candidate is the answer.
ru: Pehla scan un nodes ko record karta hai jinhe do parents mile hon, dono candidate edges store karte hue. Phir ek Union-Find graph build karta hai, baad wali candidate edge ko skip karte hue; agar cycle appear ho, pehli candidate remove ho jati hai, warna baad wali candidate hi answer hoti hai.

en: This struct represents a color in a bit-packed format that can hold either an RGB color, a terminal color, or an unset color.
ru: Ye struct ek color ko bit-packed format mein represent karta hai jo RGB color, terminal color, ya unset color hold kar sakta hai.

en: Recursively locate the node; handle three deletion cases—no left child, no right child, or two children. For the two‑child case, replace the node’s key with its inorder successor’s key and delete that successor recursively. The function returns updated subtree roots up the recursion stack.
ru: Node ko recursively locate karta hai; teen deletion cases handle karta hai—no left child, no right child, ya do children. Do-child case ke liye, node ki key ko uske inorder successor ki key se replace karta hai aur us successor ko recursively delete karta hai. Function recursion stack tak updated subtree roots return karta hai.

en: Determine whether Alice has a winning strategy in the described subtraction game.
ru: Check karta hai ke described subtraction game mein Alice ke jeetne ki strategy hai ya nahi.

en: Repeatedly subtracts 5 from n while it stays positive; if the loop ends with n equal to zero the original number was divisible by 5, otherwise it was not.
ru: n positive rehte hue baar baar usmein se 5 subtract karta hai; agar loop n zero ke barabar hone par khatam ho toh original number 5 se divisible tha, warna nahi tha.

en: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ if three odds appear consecutively, otherwise ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ agar teen odd numbers lagataar appear hon, warna ⟦2⟧.

en: int – the size of the smallest feasible value range after applying all ⟦0⟧.
ru: int – sab ⟦0⟧ apply karne ke baad sabse chote feasible value range ka size.

en: Compute lcm of a and b, then binary‑search the answer ⟦0⟧; at each mid compute how many multiples ≤ mid using inclusion‑exclusion, adjusting bounds until the minimal satisfying value is found.
ru: a aur b ka lcm compute karta hai, phir answer ⟦0⟧ ko binary-search karta hai; har mid par inclusion-exclusion istemal karke count karta hai ke kitne multiples ≤ mid hain, minimal satisfying value milne tak bounds adjust karte hue.

en: Provides an implicit conversion from the current object to a CGAL ⟦0⟧.
ru: Current object se ek CGAL ⟦0⟧ mein ek implicit conversion faraham karta hai.

en: Retrieve the collection of leaf edges via ⟦0⟧, then iterate over this collection with a range‑based for loop, invoking ⟦1⟧ for each edge. No parallelism or early termination is performed.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke zariye leaf edges ka collection retrieve karta hai, phir is collection par ek range-based for loop se iterate karta hai, har edge ke liye ⟦1⟧ invoke karte hue. Koi parallelism ya early termination perform nahi hoti.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a pointer to the current tree ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – current tree ⟦1⟧ ka ek pointer.

en: Constructs a multi‑line C‑string containing usage information, streams it to standard output, then calls ⟦0⟧ to end the process.
ru: Usage information wala ek multi-line C-string construct karta hai, use standard output mein stream karta hai, phir process khatam karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ call karta hai.

en: Compute the minimum total cost to reach the top of a staircase when you can start at step 0 or 1 and move 1 or 2 steps at a time.
ru: Ek staircase ke top tak pahunchne ka minimum total cost compute karta hai jab step 0 ya 1 se shuru kiya ja sake aur ek baar mein 1 ya 2 steps move kiye ja sakein.

en: It allocates memory for a new node, sets the node's data to the provided value, and initializes both left and right child pointers to ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ye ek naye node ke liye memory allocate karta hai, node ka data provided value set karta hai, aur left aur right child pointers dono ko ⟦0⟧ initialize kar deta hai.

en: Determines if a word is written in one of three valid capitalization styles.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek word teen valid capitalization styles mein se kisi ek mein likha hua hai ya nahi.

en: Utilizes an auxiliary function to compute the circumcenter and its weight based on the provided vertex coordinates and weights.
ru: Provided vertex coordinates aur weights ke hisab se circumcenter aur uska weight compute karne ke liye ek auxiliary function istemal karta hai.

en: Reverse the entire string, then reverse the first 'b' characters, and finally reverse the remaining characters.
ru: Puri string ko reverse karta hai, phir pehle ‘b’ characters ko reverse karta hai, aur aakhir mein baqi characters ko reverse karta hai.

en: Determine the smaller of the two buffer sizes, guard against zero‑length copies, invoke ⟦0⟧ for that many bytes, and return the count.
ru: Dono buffer sizes mein se chhoti size determine karta hai, zero-length copies ko handle karta hai, utne bytes ke liye ⟦0⟧ ko call karta hai aur count return karta hai.

en: Two 64‑bit signed integers ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ (treated as non‑negative).
ru: Do 64-bit signed integers ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ (non-negative treat kiye jate hain).

en: Two integers l and r defining the inclusive range to examine.
ru: Do integers l aur r jo examine karne wali inclusive range define karte hain.

en: Compute the total sum modulo ⟦0⟧. If target is 0, return 0. Using a hashmap of prefix‑sum modulo p values, scan the array while maintaining the current prefix sum. For each position, look for a previous prefix whose modulo equals ⟦1⟧; the distance gives a candidate subarray length. Keep the minimum such length and return it, or -1 if none found.
ru: Total sum modulo ⟦0⟧ compute karta hai. Agar target 0 ho, 0 return karta hai. Prefix-sum modulo p values ke ek hashmap istemal karke, current prefix sum maintain karte hue array scan karta hai. Har position ke liye, ek pichla prefix dhoondta hai jiska modulo ⟦1⟧ ke barabar ho; distance ek candidate subarray length deti hai. Aisi minimum length rakhta hai aur use return karta hai, ya -1 agar koi na mile.

en: A mutable vector<int>& nums containing the numbers and an int k defining the radius of the window.
ru: Ek mutable vector<int>& nums jismein numbers hote hain aur ek int k jo window ka radius define karta hai.

en: Both inputs are truncated to 16‑bit values, the sub‑language is shifted left by 10 bits, then combined with the primary language using bitwise OR, and finally cast back to unsigned long.
ru: Dono inputs ko 16-bit values tak truncate kiya jata hai, sub-language ko 10 bits left shift kiya jata hai, phir bitwise OR istemal karke primary language ke sath combine kiya jata hai, aur akhir mein unsigned long mein wapas cast kiya jata hai.

en: Triple‑nested loops walk the N‑H‑W dimensions, inner loop walks channels. For each element, the corresponding bias ⟦0⟧ is ⟦1⟧, then either added to or subtracted from the tensor element, and the result is written back to ⟦2⟧.
ru: Triple-nested loops N-H-W dimensions ke through chalte hain, inner loop channels ke through chalta hai. Har element ke liye, corresponding bias ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ hota hai, phir ya toh tensor element mein add hota hai ya subtract, aur result wapas ⟦2⟧ mein likh diya jata hai.

en: The modified dart descriptor d1 after performing the linking operations.
ru: Linking operations perform karne ke baad modified dart descriptor d1.

en: Takes a ⟦0⟧ (handle to a vertex) and a constant reference to a ⟦1⟧ (storage site).
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ (vertex ka handle) aur ek ⟦1⟧ (storage site) ka constant reference leta hai.

en: Returns true if B matches a subtree of A; otherwise false.
ru: Agar B, A ke ek subtree se match kare toh true return karta hai; warna false.

en: Utilizes ⟦0⟧'s ⟦1⟧ to locate the Nth occurrence of the search sequence and ⟦2⟧ to remove it from the input sequence.
ru: Search sequence ka Nth occurrence locate karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ ka ⟦1⟧ aur use input sequence se remove karne ke liye ⟦2⟧ istemal karta hai.

en: For each start position ⟦0⟧, it expands an end position ⟦1⟧, maintaining a counter that adds 1 for ‘a’ and subtracts 1 for ‘c’. Whenever the counter is positive, the current substring satisfies the condition, and the answer is incremented. The double loop examines all ⟦2⟧ substrings.
ru: Har start position ⟦0⟧ ke liye, ye ek end position ⟦1⟧ expand karta hai, ek counter maintain karte hue jo 'a' ke liye 1 add karta hai aur 'c' ke liye 1 subtract karta hai. Jab bhi counter positive ho, current substring condition satisfy karta hai, aur answer increment ho jata hai. Double loop sab ⟦2⟧ substrings examine karta hai.

en: A pointer to the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of a range of objects, and a ⟦2⟧.
ru: Objects ki range ke ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ka pointer, aur aik ⟦2⟧.

en: Iterate over every character of word, map it to an index by ch - 'a', and increment the corresponding entry in count. The code assumes all characters are lowercase a‑z and does not perform bounds checking.
ru: word ke har character par iterate karta hai, use ch - 'a' se ek index par map karta hai, aur count mein corresponding entry ko increment kar deta hai. Code ye assume karta hai ke tamam characters lowercase a-z hain aur bounds checking perform nahi karta.

en: Allocate a temporary result node, set its ⟦0⟧ to the arithmetic sum of the input nodes' ⟦0⟧ values, and return the result. This operation is ⟦1⟧ and assumes both inputs are valid nodes.
ru: Ek temporary result node allocate karta hai, iska ⟦0⟧ input nodes ke ⟦0⟧ values ke arithmetic sum par set karta hai, aur result return karta hai. Ye operation ⟦1⟧ hai aur assume karta hai ke dono inputs valid nodes hain.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a character representing a hex ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ek character jo ek hex ⟦1⟧ represent karta hai.

en: Determine whether a given number is an even perfect number.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke diya gaya number even perfect number hai ya nahi.

en: If the string length is at least 10 the answer is trivially true. Otherwise, iterate over every triple of cut ⟦0⟧ that define four consecutive substrings, generate those substrings with ⟦1⟧, and test all six pairwise inequality conditions; return true on the first successful split. If none succeed, return false.
ru: Agar string ki length kam az kam 10 ho toh answer trivially true hota hai. Warna, har us cut ⟦0⟧ triple par iterate karta hai jo char consecutive substrings define karte hon, un substrings ko ⟦1⟧ se generate karta hai, aur sab chhe pairwise inequality conditions test karta hai; pehli successful split par true return karta hai. Agar koi successful na ho, false return karta hai.

en: Sequentially checks the input against known alias groups using a chain of ⟦0⟧ statements; the first matching group yields its canonical name. If none match, the function falls back to the original value.
ru: ⟦0⟧ statements ki ek chain istemal karke input ko known alias groups ke khilaf sequentially check karta hai; pehla matching group apna canonical name deta hai. Agar koi match na ho, function original value par fall back kar deta hai.

en: Populate an original stack, copy it, then push an extra element onto the original. Convert both stacks to vectors and compare against pre‑computed expected sequences to ensure the copy remains unchanged.
ru: Ek original stack populate karta hai, use copy karta hai, phir original par ek extra element push karta hai. Dono stacks ko vectors mein convert karke pre-computed expected sequences se compare karta hai ye ensure karne ke liye ke copy unchanged rahi.

en: Cast each object to its ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ base types and invoke ⟦2⟧ on those subobjects, then swap the ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ members, and finally recompute derived bounds for both objects.
ru: Har object ko uske ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ base types mein cast karta hai aur un subobjects par ⟦2⟧ invoke karta hai, phir ⟦3⟧ aur ⟦4⟧ members ko swap karta hai, aur akhir mein dono objects ke liye derived bounds recompute kar deta hai.

en: float – the approximated natural logarithm of 1 + x.
ru: float – 1 + x ka approximated natural logarithm.

en: Compute the maximum value ⟦0⟧*(b‑1) for any two elements a, b in the array.
ru: Array mein kisi bhi do elements a, b ke liye maximum value ⟦0⟧*(b-1) compute karta hai.

en: Slide a fixed‑size window of length k across the array while maintaining a frequency table and a counter of duplicated values. When the window is full and contains no duplicates, update the result with the current window sum. Adjust the sum and frequencies as the window moves forward.
ru: Ek frequency table aur duplicated values ke counter ko maintain karte hue array ke across length k ki ek fixed-size window slide karta hai. Jab window bhar jaye aur usmein koi duplicates na hon, result ko current window sum se update karta hai. Window forward move karte hue sum aur frequencies adjust karta hai.

en: 'pw' is a pointer to an integer.
ru: 'pw' ek integer ka pointer hai.

en: The centroid is calculated as the average of the vertices' coordinates.
ru: Centroid vertices ke coordinates ka average calculate karke find kiya jata hai.

en: The function iterates through each possible middle member of the team and counts how many elements are smaller and larger than the current middle member on both sides. It then calculates the number of valid teams that can be formed with the current middle member and adds it to the total count.
ru: Ye function team ke har possible middle member par iterate karta hai aur count karta hai ke dono sides par current middle member se kitne elements chote aur bare hain. Phir ye current middle member ke sath ban sakne wali valid teams ki tadaad calculate karta hai aur use total count mein add kar deta hai.

en: The function uses dynamic programming to build up the solution. It leverages the fact that the number of 1 bits in an even number is the same as its half, and for an odd number, it is one more than its half.
ru: Ye function solution build karne ke liye dynamic programming istemal karta hai. Ye is fact ka faida uthata hai ke ek even number mein 1 bits ki tadaad uske aadhe ke barabar hoti hai, aur ek odd number ke liye, ye uske aadhe se ek zyada hoti hai.

en: This function checks if a given binary tree is a valid Binary Search ⟦0⟧.
ru: Yeh function check karta hai ke di gayi binary tree ek valid Binary Search ⟦0⟧ hai ya nahi.

en: A simple for‑loop runs from i = 1 to i = N, outputting each i and the literal string " ? ". After the loop a newline is emitted. No special handling for N ≤ 0 is provided, resulting in just a newline.
ru: Ek simple for-loop i = 1 se i = N tak chalta hai, har i aur literal string " ? " output karte hue. Loop ke baad ek newline emit hoti hai. N ≤ 0 ke liye koi special handling nahi hai, jisse sirf ek newline milti hai.

en: Uses a 2D DP table ⟦0⟧ where ⟦1⟧ represents the length of the longest Fibonacci-like subsequence ending at indices ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. Iterates through the array to fill the table based on the condition that ⟦4⟧ must exist before ⟦2⟧ in the array.
ru: Ek 2D DP table ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai jahan ⟦1⟧ indices ⟦2⟧ aur ⟦3⟧ par khatam hone wali sabse lambi Fibonacci-like subsequence ki length represent karta hai. Array ke through iterate karke table ko is condition ke hisab se fill karta hai ke ⟦4⟧ ko array mein ⟦2⟧ se pehle mojood hona chahiye.

en: Handle the trivial cases N = 1 and N = 2 directly. For each subsequent row ⟦0⟧, start with a row of 1s, then fill interior entries by summing the two adjacent entries from the previous ⟦1⟧. Append each completed row to the result and update the reference row for the next iteration.
ru: N = 1 aur N = 2 ke trivial cases ko directly handle karta hai. Har baad ki row ⟦0⟧ ke liye, 1s wali ek row se shuru karta hai, phir previous ⟦1⟧ se do adjacent entries sum karke interior entries fill karta hai. Har complete row ko result mein append karta hai aur agli iteration ke liye reference row update karta hai.

en: Uses placement new to construct an object of type T at the memory location pointed to by ⟦0⟧. Then, it increments the ⟦1⟧ variable.
ru: Placement new ka use karke ⟦0⟧ ke zariye point ki gayi memory location par type T ka object construct karta hai. Phir ⟦1⟧ variable ko increment karta hai.

en: Scan the permutation left‑to‑right, maintaining a bitmask ⟦0⟧ of already‑seen elements. For each element ⟦1⟧, compute how many smaller elements have already appeared using a popcount on ⟦2⟧. Update the rank ⟦3⟧ by multiplying by the current position index and adding that count, then set the bit for ⟦1⟧ in ⟦0⟧.
ru: Permutation ko left-to-right scan karta hai aur pehle se seen elements ka bitmask ⟦0⟧ maintain karta hai. Har element ⟦1⟧ ke liye, ⟦2⟧ par popcount use karke count karta hai ke us se chhote kitne elements pehle aa chuke hain. Phir rank ⟦3⟧ ko current position index se multiply karke us count ko add karta hai, aur ⟦1⟧ ke liye ⟦0⟧ mein bit set kar deta hai.

en: Perform DFS to explore all paths through the tree. For each node, calculate the maximum path sum that includes the node itself, the node plus its left child, the node plus its right child, and the node plus both its children. Update the global maximum path sum accordingly.
ru: Tree ke tamam paths explore karne ke liye DFS perform karta hai. Har node ke liye maximum path sum calculate karta hai jo sirf node ko, node ke sath left child ko, node ke sath right child ko, ya node ke sath dono children ko include karta hai. Phir global maximum path sum ko accordingly update karta hai.

en: Uses a sliding window ⟦0⟧ over ⟦1⟧; for each position it linearly compares up to ⟦2⟧ characters. On a full match it reports the index and jumps ahead by ⟦2⟧; on a partial match it skips the already‑matched prefix length, otherwise it moves one step. Edge cases such as an empty pattern cause an infinite loop in the original code.
ru: ⟦1⟧ par ek sliding window ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai; har position ke liye ⟦2⟧ tak characters ko linearly compare karta hai. Ek full match par index report karta hai aur ⟦2⟧ jitna aage jump karta hai; ek partial match par pehle se matched prefix length skip karta hai, warna ek step move karta hai. Empty pattern jese edge cases original code mein infinite loop cause karte hain.

en: Load sandwiches onto a stack in reverse to make the next sandwich accessible via top, and enqueue students in order. Iterate, serving a student if the front of the queue matches the top sandwich; otherwise rotate the student to the back. Stop when a full pass occurs without any serve, then return the queue size.
ru: Sandwiches ko reverse mein ek stack par load karta hai taake agla sandwich top ke zariye accessible ho, aur students ko order mein enqueue karta hai. Iterate karta hai, agar queue ka front top sandwich se match kare toh us student ko serve karta hai; warna student ko peeche rotate kar deta hai. Jab bina kisi serve ke ek full pass ho jaye toh ruk jata hai, phir queue size return kar deta hai.

ru: Inline assembly istemal karke ek 128-bit floating-point vector par ek weak opacification operation apply karta hai.

ru: String ko right se left iterate karta hai. '0's ko count karta hai aur jab bhi '1' mile is count ko result mein add kar deta hai.

ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek undirected graph mein Euler circuit possible hai ya nahi.

ru: ⟦0⟧ mein write karta hai; invalid input ke liye -1 print karta hai ya series “n ? … 1 ?” print karta hai.

ru: Linked ⟦0⟧ ke heads ko point karne wale do pointers.

ru: int – positive agar sequence p1→p2→p3 ek left turn banaye, negative right turn ke liye, zero agar collinear ho.

ru: ⟦0⟧ – original integer sequence.

en: long – the square of the minimal X satisfying the condition, or -1 if none exists.
ru: long – condition satisfy karne wale minimal X ka square, ya -1 agar koi na ho.

ru: Ek helper ko call karta hai us scalar parameter t1 ko hasil karne ke liye jahan pehli line doosri se milti hai; phir actual coordinates hasil karne ke liye p1 + t1 * v1 evaluate karta hai.

en: Compute the minimum number of coins needed to make a target sum N using given coin denominations.
ru: Di gayi coin denominations istemal karke ek target sum N banane ke liye zaroori minimum coins compute karta hai.

en: If N is less than 2, return N ⟦0⟧. Otherwise recursively compute ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ and sum them. This results in exponential time and deep recursion for large N.
ru: Agar N 2 se kam ho, N ⟦0⟧ return karta hai. Warna recursively ⟦1⟧ aur ⟦2⟧ compute karke unka sum leta hai. Ye bare N ke liye exponential time aur deep recursion deta hai.

en: Remove every node whose value is less than a node that appears later in the list.
ru: Har us node ko remove karta hai jiski value list mein baad mein aane wale kisi node se kam ho.

en: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ – iterators delimiting the primary range; ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ – iterators delimiting the subsequence to match; ⟦4⟧ – binary predicate used to compare elements.
ru: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ – primary range ko delimit karne wale iterators; ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ – match karne wali subsequence ko delimit karne wale iterators; ⟦4⟧ – elements compare karne ke liye istemal hone wala binary predicate.

en: prints an ⟦0⟧ representing the total ⟦1⟧.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ print karta hai jo total ⟦1⟧ represent karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧; side‑effects are the insertion of vertices and the application of the constraint.
ru: ⟦0⟧; side-effects vertices ka insertion aur constraint ka application hain.

en: Determines if a binary tree follows a specific sequence of node values as specified in an array.
ru: Determine karta hai ke ek binary tree array mein specify ki gayi node values ki ek specific sequence follow karta hai ya nahi.

en: To merge consecutive segments of a linked list where each segment ends with a node containing zero, replacing each segment with a single node that contains the sum of the segment's values.
ru: Ek linked list ke consecutive segments ko merge karne ke liye jahan har segment zero wale node par khatam hota hai, har segment ko ek single node se replace karte hue jo us segment ki values ka sum rakhta hai.

en: Iterate through ⟦0⟧, compute each key's press duration as the difference from the previous timestamp, track the maximum duration and corresponding key, updating on ties by comparing characters. Return the recorded key after processing all entries.
ru: ⟦0⟧ par iterate karta hai, har key ki press duration ko previous timestamp se farq nikal ke compute karta hai, maximum duration aur corresponding key track karta hai, aur ties par characters compare karke update kar deta hai. Sab entries process hone ke baad recorded key return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a list of lowercase alphabetic strings.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – lowercase alphabetic strings ki ek list.

en: Process the array backwards, initializing ⟦0⟧ with the result of a direct jump when possible. Then sweep forward from each i, updating later positions if the current path offers a smaller jump count, stopping early when no further improvement is possible. The final answer is stored in ⟦1⟧.
ru: Array ko backwards process karta hai, ⟦0⟧ ko jahan possible ho direct jump ke result se initialize karte hue. Phir har i se forward sweep karta hai, baad ki positions ko update karte hue agar current path chota jump count deta ho, jaldi ruk jata hai jab koi further improvement possible na ho. Final answer ⟦1⟧ mein store hota hai.

en: ⟦0⟧& – the same stream passed in, now containing the formatted data.
ru: ⟦0⟧& – wahi stream jo pass kiya gaya tha, ab formatted data ke sath.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the list of integers (will be modified in‑place; ⟦1⟧ – the divisor.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – integers ki list (in-place modify hogi); ⟦1⟧ – divisor.

en: Iterates through the input array, clamping each value between the lower and upper thresholds, and stores it in the output array.
ru: Input array ke through iterate karta hai, har value ko lower aur upper thresholds ke darmiyan clamp karte hue, aur use output array mein store kar deta hai.

en: The function creates a null pointer to ⟦0⟧ and then writes to the address it points to, causing a null‑pointer dereference. This is done intentionally to break the program.
ru: Ye function ⟦0⟧ ke liye ek null pointer create karta hai aur phir us address par likhta hai jise wo point karta hai, ek null-pointer dereference cause karte hue. Ye jaan boojh kar program ko break karne ke liye kiya jata hai.

en: The implementation brute‑forces all index pairs, checking the ramp condition and tracking the maximum distance. This runs in ⟦0⟧ time and ⟦1⟧ extra space.
ru: Implementation sab index pairs ko brute-force karta hai, ramp condition check karte hue aur maximum distance track karte hue. Ye ⟦0⟧ time aur ⟦1⟧ extra space mein chalta hai.

en: Determine whether a given “letter” can be assembled using characters from a “magazine”.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke di gayi ek "letter" ko ek "magazine" ke characters se assemble kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi.

en: Create mutable copies of both strings, convert each character to lower‑case using ⟦0⟧, then use ⟦1⟧::find to test for a match. Empty needle yields true because find returns position 0.
ru: Dono strings ki mutable copies banata hai, ⟦0⟧ istemal karke har character ko lower-case mein convert karta hai, phir match test karne ke liye ⟦1⟧::find istemal karta hai. Empty needle true deta hai kyunke find position 0 return karta hai.

en: const strings A and B of length N, and an integer N indicating their length.
ru: Length N ki const strings A aur B, aur ek integer N jo unki length batata hai.

en: Determines whether a decimal string represents a valid IPv4 octet without leading zeros.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek decimal string bina leading zeros ke ek valid IPv4 octet represent karta hai ya nahi.

en: int – the earliest ⟦0⟧ where the population peaks.
ru: int – woh sab se pehla ⟦0⟧ jahan population maximum hoti hai.

en: Convert inputs to 64‑bit, determine result sign, handle division‑by‑zero, zero numerator, and divisor‑one shortcuts, otherwise compute the quotient using exp(⟦0⟧-⟦1⟧).
ru: Inputs ko 64-bit mein convert karta hai, result ka sign determine karta hai, division-by-zero, zero numerator, aur divisor-one shortcuts handle karta hai, warna exp(⟦0⟧-⟦1⟧) istemal karke quotient compute kar deta hai.

en: Retrieve the group's record from the map, assign the new configuration, then verify whether the current leader is still part of that configuration; if not, reset the leader to an empty state.
ru: Map se group ka record retrieve karta hai, naya configuration assign karta hai, phir verify karta hai ke current leader ab bhi us configuration ka hissa hai ya nahi; agar nahi, leader ko ek empty state par reset kar deta hai.

en: This function prints the configuration details used for training.
ru: Ye function training ke liye istemal ki gayi configuration details print karta hai.

en: Count character frequencies and verify palindrome ⟦0⟧. Attempt to match target’s left half while consuming counts; if successful, build the full palindrome and compare to target. If not greater, backtrack by incrementally replacing the rightmost left‑half character with the next larger feasible character, filling the remainder with the smallest possible characters, and return the first palindrome that exceeds target.
ru: Character frequencies count karta hai aur palindrome ⟦0⟧ verify karta hai. Counts consume karte hue target ke left half ko match karne ki koshish karta hai; agar successful ho, full palindrome build karke target se compare karta hai. Agar zyada na ho, rightmost left-half character ko agle bare feasible character se incrementally replace karke backtrack karta hai, baaki ko sabse chote possible characters se fill karte hue, aur pehla palindrome return karta hai jo target se zyada ho.

en: Uses DFS to traverse the tree, updating the maximum sum when a deeper path is found or when at the same depth but with a higher sum.
ru: Tree traverse karne ke liye DFS istemal karta hai, maximum sum ko update karte hue jab ek gehra path mile ya jab wahi depth par ho lekin zyada sum ke sath.

en: A vector<vector<int>> where each inner vector is a distinct permutation of list.
ru: Ek vector<vector<int>> jahan har inner vector list ka ek distinct permutation hai.

en: Scan the array once, maintaining a running count of identical adjacent elements; when a change is detected, emit the previous value and its count, then reset the counter. After the loop, output the count for the last run.
ru: Array ko ek dafa scan karta hai, identical adjacent elements ka running count maintain karte hue; jab change detect ho, previous value aur uska count emit karta hai, phir counter reset kar deta hai. Loop ke baad, last run ke liye count output karta hai.

en: Reconstruct a binary tree from preorder and inorder traversal data.
ru: Preorder aur inorder traversal data se ek binary tree reconstruct karta hai.

en: Compute the original ⟦0⟧, then divide it by 2 raised to the power fold (⟦1⟧., area / 2^fold). The division uses pow to handle non‑integer fold counts.
ru: Original ⟦0⟧ calculate karta hai, phir usay 2 ki power fold (⟦1⟧., area / 2^fold) se divide karta hai. Division ke liye pow use karta hai taake non-integer fold counts ko bhi handle kiya ja sake.

en: ⟦0⟧ representing the product; "0" if either input is empty or the product is zero.
ru: ⟦0⟧ jo product represent karta hai; "0" agar koi bhi input empty ho ya product zero ho.

en: For each number in the input vector, calculate its number of digits using logarithm base 10. If the number of digits is even, increment the result counter.
ru: Input vector ke har number ke liye, logarithm base 10 istemal karke uski digits ki tadaad calculate karta hai. Agar digits ki tadaad even ho, result counter increment kar deta hai.

en: Remove a specific edge from the border structure.
ru: Border structure se ek specific edge remove karta hai.

en: Compute each object's ⟦0⟧ and compare the two ratios, returning the result of the comparison. Edge cases such as zero weight are not handled and will cause division by zero.
ru: Har object ka ⟦0⟧ calculate karta hai aur dono ratios ko compare karta hai, phir comparison ka result return karta hai. Zero weight jaisi edge cases handle nahi ki jati aur is se division by zero ho sakta hai.

en: Handles the empty vector as a special case. Then performs a binary‑search‑style loop comparing ⟦0⟧ with mid + ⟦1⟧ to locate the smallest index where the inequality fails. Finally returns the value at that index together with a simple arithmetic expression based on the vector’s endpoints.
ru: Empty vector ko special case ke tor par handle karta hai. Phir binary-search style loop perform karta hai jahan ⟦0⟧ ko mid + ⟦1⟧ ke sath compare karke woh sab se chota index find karta hai jahan inequality fail hoti hai. Aakhir mein us index ki value ko vector ke endpoints par based simple arithmetic expression ke sath return karta hai.

en: Determines if two strings are anagrams.
ru: Check karta hai ke dono strings anagrams hain ya nahi.

en: Compute the minimum ⟦0⟧ between two given words in a list.
ru: Ek list mein diye gaye do words ke darmiyan minimum ⟦0⟧ compute karta hai.

en: Finds all n‑digit Armstrong numbers and prints their cumulative XOR and OR.
ru: Sab n-digit Armstrong numbers dhoondta hai aur unka cumulative XOR aur OR print karta hai.

ru: ⟦0⟧ recursion ke zariye greatest common divisor find karta hai. ⟦1⟧ target number ko GCD se successive integers ke sath baar baar divide karta hai jab tak residual 1 na ho jaye, jisse wo minimal n milta hai jahan n! mein x shamil ho. ⟦2⟧ y aur x ke in n values ka farq return karta hai.

en: Starting from the reported size N, the function walks backwards while the current last element equals zero, decrementing N. The final N is the effective word count.
ru: Reported size N se shuru karke, function backwards chalta hai jab tak current last element zero ke barabar ho, N ko decrement karte hue. Final N hi effective word count hota hai.

en: ⟦0⟧; side‑effects include deallocating memory and adjusting the parent’s buffer counters.
ru: ⟦0⟧; side-effects mein memory deallocate karna aur parent ke buffer counters adjust karna shamil hai.

en: void – prints each permutation to ⟦0⟧, one per line.
ru: void – har permutation ko ⟦0⟧ par print karta hai, ek line mein ek.

en: An ⟦0⟧ where each key is a unique substring from ⟦1⟧ and its corresponding value is the number of times it appears.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ jahan har key ⟦1⟧ se ek unique substring hai aur uski corresponding value uske appear hone ki tadaad hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ is the number of nodes, ⟦1⟧ is a list of undirected edges represented as pairs of integers.
ru: ⟦0⟧ nodes ki tadaad hai, ⟦1⟧ ek list hai jo undirected edges ko integers ke pairs ki tarah represent karti hai.

en: Writes to standard output the numbers 1 through N, each followed by " ?", and ends with a newline.
ru: 1 se N tak numbers standard output par likhta hai, har ek ke baad " ?" lagate hue, aur ek newline se khatam karta hai.

en: For each segment, compute the motion direction from consecutive positions, compare its angle to the yaw at the start of the segment, and flip the speed sign if the angular difference exceeds 45°. Fill the profile accordingly and zero‑out the last element.
ru: Har segment ke liye, consecutive positions se motion direction compute karta hai, iske angle ko segment ke start ke yaw se compare karta hai, aur speed sign flip kar deta hai agar angular difference 45° se zyada ho. Us hisab se profile fill karta hai aur last element ko zero kar deta hai.

en: The code iteratively swaps each element into its “correct” ⟦0⟧ while staying within the array bounds. After this placement phase, a linear scan identifies the first index where the value does not match the expected 1‑based index; that index is the answer, otherwise the answer is ⟦1⟧.
ru: Code array bounds ke andar rehte hue har element ko iteratively uski "correct" ⟦0⟧ mein swap karta hai. Is placement phase ke baad, ek linear scan pehla wo index identify karta hai jahan value expected 1-based index se match na kare; wo index hi answer hota hai, warna answer ⟦1⟧ hota hai.

en: Scan N from the most‑significant to the least‑significant bit, counting consecutive zeros. When a 1‑bit is found, check that the preceding zero count meets ⟦0⟧, then reset the counter. If any gap is too small, return false; otherwise return true after the full scan.
ru: N ko most-significant se least-significant bit tak scan karta hai, consecutive zeros count karte hue. Jab ek 1-bit mile, check karta hai ke preceding zero count ⟦0⟧ ko poora karta hai, phir counter reset kar deta hai. Agar koi gap bahut chota ho, false return karta hai; warna full scan ke baad true return karta hai.

en: Convert each character to its integer value, collect all odd values, sort them, and if at least two are present combine the two ⟦0⟧; otherwise return -1.
ru: Har character ko uski integer value mein convert karta hai, sab odd values collect karta hai, unhe sort karta hai, aur agar kam az kam do mojood hon toh dono ⟦0⟧ combine kar deta hai; warna -1 return karta hai.

en: Checks if the input is greater than or equal to the maximum ⟦0⟧ value; if so, returns max ⟦0⟧. Otherwise, casts the double to ⟦0⟧.
ru: Check karta hai ke input maximum ⟦0⟧ value se zyada ya barabar hai ya nahi; agar ho, max ⟦0⟧ return karta hai. Warna, double ko ⟦0⟧ mein cast kar deta hai.

en: The function iterates over the triangle points of the given face, calculates the cross product of two vectors, multiplies it by the third vector, sums up these values, and divides by 6.0 to get the signed volume.
ru: Function given face ke triangle points par iterate karta hai, do vectors ka cross product calculate karta hai, usay teesre vector se multiply karta hai, in values ko sum karta hai aur 6.0 se divide karke signed volume hasil karta hai.

en: Calculate the stack depth by subtracting the base address of the stack from the current stack pointer. Compare this depth against the maximum allowed stack size stored in ⟦0⟧. Return true if the depth is less than the maximum size.
ru: Stack ke base address ko current stack pointer se subtract karke stack depth calculate karta hai. Is depth ko ⟦0⟧ mein stored maximum allowed stack size se compare karta hai. Agar depth maximum size se kam ho, true return karta hai.

en: Returns ⟦0⟧ if a cycle is reachable from u, otherwise ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ return karta hai agar u se koi cycle reachable ho, warna ⟦1⟧.

en: Finds the first ⟦0⟧ in a sorted vector whose GCD exceeds a threshold.
ru: Ek sorted vector mein pehla ⟦0⟧ dhoondta hai jiska GCD ek threshold se zyada ho.

en: Determine n modulo 6, then select the appropriate expression (a, b, b‑a, –a, –b, or –(b‑a)) based on that residue. The sequence repeats every six positions.
ru: n ko 6 se modulo karta hai, phir us remainder ke mutabiq appropriate expression (a, b, b-a, –a, –b, ya –(b-a)) select karta hai. Yeh sequence har 6 positions ke baad repeat hoti hai.

en: Calls another overload of ⟦0⟧ with a default functor.
ru: Default functor ke sath ⟦0⟧ ke doosre overload ko call karta hai.

ru: Do ⟦0⟧ objects, ⟦1⟧ aur ⟦2⟧.

en: To link two halfedges as previous and next in their shared face cycle.
ru: Do halfedges ko unki shared face cycle mein previous aur next ke taur par link karna.

en: Compute LCM = (A·B)/⟦0⟧. Iterate i from 1 to n, ⟦1⟧ divided by ⟦2⟧ to the running total, then return the total. Edge cases: If A or B is zero the LCM is zero, causing division‑by‑zero.
ru: LCM = (A·B)/⟦0⟧ compute karta hai. i ko 1 se n tak iterate karta hai, ⟦1⟧ ko ⟦2⟧ se divide karke running total mein add karta hai, phir total return kar deta hai. Edge cases: Agar A ya B zero ho toh LCM zero hoti hai, jisse division-by-zero hota hai.

en: Calculates the total sum of node indices in a perfect binary tree of height l assuming each level repeats the last‑level sum.
ru: Ye assume karte hue ke har level last-level sum repeat karta hai, height l ke ek perfect binary tree mein node indices ka total sum calculate karta hai.

en: The function returns void; the side‑effect is that set contains all values from the visited subtree.
ru: Function void return karta hai; side-effect ye hai ke set mein visited subtree ki sab values hoti hain.

en: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ if all non‑zero occurrence counts are distinct; otherwise ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ agar sab non-zero occurrence counts distinct hon; warna ⟦2⟧.

en: Iterates through each element in the matrix, using the difference between its row and column indices as a key in an unordered map. If a value is encountered that does not match the expected value for its diagonal, returns false. If no mismatches are found, returns true.
ru: Matrix ke har element par iterate karta hai, uske row aur column indices ke darmiyan farq ko ek unordered map mein key ki tarah istemal karte hue. Agar koi aisi value mile jo uske diagonal ki expected value se match na kare, false return karta hai. Agar koi mismatch na mile, true return karta hai.

en: This function sends a "done" reply containing a command name and an integer value.
ru: Yeh function command name aur integer value ko contain karne wala "done" reply send karta hai.

en: Initialise ⟦0⟧ with the first height, then iterate from 1 to n‑1, setting each entry to the larger of the previous prefix maximum and the current height. Return the resulting array.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko pehli height ke sath initialize karta hai, phir 1 se n-1 tak iterate karta hai aur har entry ko previous prefix maximum aur current height mein se bari value ke barabar set karta hai. Aakhir mein resulting array return karta hai.

en: Perform a depth‑first search from node ⟦0⟧, marking nodes visited. Initialise each node’s result with its own quietness. After processing each child, propagate the child’s result upward if it has a lower quietness, ensuring ⟦1⟧ always reflects the minimum quiet value in its subtree.
ru: Node ⟦0⟧ se depth-first search (DFS) perform karta hai aur visited nodes ko mark karta hai. Har node ke result ko uski apni quietness se initialize karta hai. Har child ko process karne ke baad, agar child ka result kam quietness wala ho to us result ko parent ki taraf propagate karta hai, taake ⟦1⟧ hamesha uske subtree mein minimum quietness value ko reflect kare.

en: Allocate an empty string, call the existing three‑parameter overload to populate it with hex digits, then return the ⟦0⟧. Handles empty ranges by producing an empty string.
ru: Empty string allocate karta hai, phir existing three-parameter overload ko call karke us mein hex digits fill karta hai, aur ⟦0⟧ return karta hai. Agar range empty ho to empty string produce karta hai.

en: Compares days first; if equal, compares time of day.
ru: Pehle days compare karta hai; agar equal hon, time of day compare karta hai.

en: Computes an inverse quadratic interpolation estimate for the root of a function using three known points.
ru: Teen known points istemal karke ek function ke root ke liye ek inverse quadratic interpolation estimate compute karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – iterator to the first element of the scanline; ⟦1⟧ – iterator to test; ⟦2⟧ – (unused) property map for points; ⟦3⟧ – map from points to their scanline IDs; ⟦4⟧ – indicates no fallback behavior.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – scanline ke pehle element ka iterator; ⟦1⟧ – test karne wala iterator; ⟦2⟧ – points ke liye (unused) property map; ⟦3⟧ – points se unke scanline IDs tak ka map; ⟦4⟧ – no fallback behavior indicate karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - Pointer to the new head of the reversed list.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - Reversed list ke naye head ka pointer.

en: Compute the number of subsequence masks as 2^(n‑1). For each mask, scan the string left‑to‑right, output each character, and after a character output " ? " if the corresponding bit in the mask is set. End each mask with a newline.
ru: Subsequence masks ki tadaad 2^(n-1) ke tor par compute karta hai. Har mask ke liye, string ko left-to-right scan karta hai, har character output karta hai, aur ek character ke baad " ? " output karta hai agar mask mein corresponding bit set ho. Har mask ko ek newline se khatam karta hai.

en: Subtract p1 from p2 to get the segment direction, rotate that direction by 90° (swap components and negate one), and finally compute the barycenter of the two endpoints.
ru: Segment direction hasil karne ke liye p2 mein se p1 subtract karta hai, us direction ko 90° rotate karta hai (components swap karke aur ek negate karke), aur akhir mein dono endpoints ka barycenter compute kar deta hai.

en: Returns an ⟦0⟧ equal to the number of edges on the longest path between any two nodes.
ru: Aik ⟦0⟧ return karta hai jo kisi bhi do nodes ke darmiyan sab se lambi path mein edges ki tadaad ke barabar hota hai.

en: Minimum achievable sum from ⟦0⟧ to the last row, stored in ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ se last row tak minimum achievable sum, ⟦1⟧ mein stored.

en: ⟦0⟧ pos – a stream position object whose native representation is needed.
ru: ⟦0⟧ pos – ek stream position object jiska native representation zaroori hai.

en: Insert each child of every parent from ⟦0⟧ into a stack keyed by the parent. Then iterate the edges of ⟦1⟧; for each edge, the expected mirrored child must be at the top of the corresponding stack. If all edges match, the trees are mirrors.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke har parent ke har child ko parent se keyed ek stack mein insert karta hai. Phir ⟦1⟧ ke edges par iterate karta hai; har edge ke liye, expected mirrored child corresponding stack ke top par hona chahiye. Agar sab edges match karein, trees mirrors hain.

en: Prints a phrase indicating whether m^n is greater than, less than, or equal to n^m.
ru: Ek phrase print karta hai jo batata hai ke m^n, n^m se zyada hai, kam hai, ya barabar hai.

en: The function tests N % 3; if zero it outputs a line with “1” placeholders and appends N‑2, otherwise it outputs a line with “2” placeholders and appends N‑3. The logic is a simple conditional branch with constant‑time work.
ru: Ye function N % 3 test karta hai; agar zero ho toh "1" placeholders wali ek line output karke N-2 append karta hai, warna "2" placeholders wali ek line output karke N-3 append karta hai. Logic constant-time work wala ek simple conditional branch hai.

en: To remove trailing whitespace ⟦0⟧ from a given C-style string.
ru: Diye gaye C-style string se trailing whitespace ⟦0⟧ remove karne ke liye.

en: Compute the global maximum, then slide a two‑pointer window across the array, maintaining the count of maximums inside the window. Whenever the window has ≥ k maximums, all extensions of the right end produce valid subarrays, which are added to the result; then the left pointer is advanced to explore smaller windows.
ru: Global maximum calculate karta hai, phir array par two-pointer window slide karta hai aur window ke andar maximum values ki count maintain karta hai. Jab window mein ≥ k maximum values hon to right end ki tamam extensions valid subarrays hoti hain, jinhein result mein add karta hai. Phir left pointer ko aage barhata hai taake choti windows ko explore kiya ja sake.

en: Log the start, create a Point for the center, invoke ⟦0⟧ with the given density and radius, then log completion.
ru: Start ko log karta hai, center ke liye ek Point create karta hai, di gayi density aur radius ke sath ⟦0⟧ invoke karta hai, phir completion log karta hai.

en: Calculates a pseudo‑volume ⟦0⟧. If ⟦1⟧ is less than half that volume, it evaluates ⟦2⟧ and takes ⟦3⟧. Otherwise it mirrors ⟦1⟧ (⟦4⟧), computes ⟦5⟧, and takes ⟦3⟧. Finally, it converts the radian result to degrees.
ru: Ek pseudo-volume ⟦0⟧ calculate karta hai. Agar ⟦1⟧ us volume ke aadhe se kam ho, toh ⟦2⟧ evaluate karta hai aur ⟦3⟧ leta hai. Warna ⟦1⟧ ko mirror karta hai (⟦4⟧), ⟦5⟧ compute karta hai, aur ⟦3⟧ leta hai. Akhir mein, radian result ko degrees mein convert kar deta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ if such a triplet exists, otherwise ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ agar aisi triplet mojood ho, warna ⟦2⟧.
