en: Scan once, keeping a running total of net ⟦0⟧ to check overall feasibility, and a temporary ⟦1⟧ to test candidate starts; when total drops to ≤0, move the candidate start forward and reset total. If the overall net fuel is non‑negative, the last recorded start index is valid.
ru: Ek dafa scan karta hai, overall feasibility check karne ke liye net ⟦0⟧ ka ek running total rakhte hue, aur candidate starts test karne ke liye ek temporary ⟦1⟧. Jab total ≤0 ho jaye, candidate start ko forward move karta hai aur total reset kar deta hai. Agar overall net fuel non-negative ho, last recorded start index valid hota hai.

en: Returns the root ⟦0⟧ of the reconstructed tree; ⟦1⟧ outputs node data in inorder order.
ru: Reconstructed tree ka root ⟦0⟧ return karta hai; ⟦1⟧ inorder order mein node data output karta hai.

en: The function sums the corresponding coordinates of the three points and then divides each sum by 3 to find the centroid's coordinates.
ru: Function teen points ke corresponding coordinates ko add karta hai aur phir har sum ko 3 se divide karta hai taake centroid ke coordinates find kiye ja saken.

en: Inserts the node ⟦0⟧ into the destination list at the appropriate position according to the comparison predicate ⟦1⟧, then erases ⟦0⟧ from the source list and updates the rebalance information.
ru: Comparison predicate ⟦1⟧ ke mutabiq node ⟦0⟧ ko destination list mein munasib position par insert karta hai, phir ⟦0⟧ ko source list se erase karta hai aur rebalance information ko update karta hai.

en: Returns a reference to the modified output ⟦0⟧.
ru: Modified output ⟦0⟧ ka reference return karta hai.

en: Repeatedly check if one number is at least twice the other; if so, replace it with its remainder modulo twice the smaller number. The loop ends when both are zero or when neither dominates the other, then the results are printed.
ru: Repeatedly check karta hai ke aik number doosre number se kam az kam do guna hai ya nahi. Agar hai, to us number ko doosre chhote number ke do guna se modulo karke replace karta hai. Loop tab khatam hota hai jab dono numbers zero ho jayein ya koi bhi number doosre par dominate na kare, phir results print karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the binary string; ⟦1⟧ – the fixed number of positions flipped per operation.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – binary string; ⟦1⟧ – per operation flip hone wale positions ki fixed tadaad.

en: Iterate temperatures higher than t, use binary ⟦0⟧ on each temperature’s sorted day list to locate the first day after ⟦1⟧, and keep the minimum such day across all temperatures. If no day is found, return -1.
ru: t se zyada temperatures par iterate karta hai, har temperature ki sorted day list par binary ⟦0⟧ istemal karke ⟦1⟧ ke baad pehla din locate karta hai, aur sab temperatures mein se minimum aisa din rakhta hai. Agar koi din na mile, -1 return karta hai.

en: Recursively builds combinations by appending a candidate ⟦0⟧ (starting from ⟦1⟧) to the partial list, recursing with ⟦2⟧ as the new offset, and backtracking after each call. The loop guard ⟦3⟧ prunes branches that cannot possibly reach size k.
ru: Ek candidate ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧ se shuru hote hue) ko partial list mein append karke combinations recursively build karta hai, ⟦2⟧ ko naya offset lete hue recurse karta hai, aur har call ke baad backtrack karta hai. Loop guard ⟦3⟧ un branches ko prune kar deta hai jo size k tak nahi pahunch sakte.

en: Dynamic programming where ⟦0⟧ holds the best sum for the prefix ending at i. For each i, examine all feasible partition lengths ⟦1⟧, track the maximum element within the last k elements, and update ⟦0⟧ with the best combination of previous optimal sum and the current partition contribution.
ru: Dynamic programming use karta hai jahan ⟦0⟧ mein i par end hone wale prefix ka best sum store hota hai. Har i ke liye tamam possible partition lengths ⟦1⟧ ko check karta hai, last k elements mein maximum element track karta hai, aur ⟦0⟧ ko previous optimal sum aur current partition ke contribution ke best combination se update karta hai.

en: Recursively traverse the list, double each digit, update the current node's value, and propagate any carry to the next node.
ru: List ko recursively traverse karta hai, har digit ko double karta hai, current node ki value update karta hai, aur koi bhi carry agle node tak propagate kar deta hai.

en: A pointer to a constant character string representing the abbreviated month name. If the input is out of the valid ⟦0⟧, it returns "???".
ru: Ek pointer ek constant character string ki taraf jo abbreviated month name represent karti hai. Agar input valid ⟦0⟧ se bahar ho, toh "???" return karta hai.

en: Allocate a node, set its data, link its next to the current ⟦0⟧, then update the head pointer to the new node. This runs in ⟦1⟧ time and works for empty or non‑empty lists.
ru: Ek node allocate karta hai, iska data set karta hai, iske next ko current ⟦0⟧ se link karta hai, phir head pointer ko naye node par update kar deta hai. Ye ⟦1⟧ time mein chalta hai aur empty ya non-empty lists dono ke liye kaam karta hai.

en: First compare the internal ⟦0⟧ members; if they differ, return ⟦1⟧. If the targets match, cast each executor to its ⟦2⟧ base and compare those subobjects, returning the result of that comparison.
ru: Pehle internal ⟦0⟧ members compare karta hai; agar wo differ karein toh ⟦1⟧ return karta hai. Agar targets match karein, toh har executor ko uske ⟦2⟧ base mein cast karta hai aur un subobjects ko compare karta hai, us comparison ka result return karte hue.

en: Perform a layered BFS that simultaneously expands ⟦0⟧ and the person’s reachable ⟦1⟧. Each iteration processes the current frontier, checks for the destination, and generates the next frontier respecting obstacles and water spread. The first time the destination is dequeued, the elapsed seconds are returned.
ru: Ek layered BFS perform karta hai jo simultaneously ⟦0⟧ aur person ke reachable ⟦1⟧ ko expand karta hai. Har iteration current frontier ko process karta hai, destination ke liye check karta hai, aur obstacles aur water spread ka khayal rakhte hue next frontier generate karta hai. Jis waqt destination pehli baar dequeue ho, elapsed seconds return kiye jate hain.

en: ⟦0⟧ – pointer to the root of ⟦1⟧tree; ⟦2⟧ – value to insert.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ tree ke root ka pointer; ⟦2⟧ – insert karne wali value.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a reference to a ⟦1⟧ that dereferences to a ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ek ⟦1⟧ ka reference jo ⟦2⟧ mein dereference hota hai.

en: The function iterates through each character of the strings, counting the number of positions where the characters differ. If more than one difference is encountered, it returns false immediately. Finally, it returns true if exactly one difference is found, otherwise false.
ru: Ye function strings ke har character par iterate karta hai, un positions ko count karte hue jahan characters differ karte hon. Agar ek se zyada difference mile, turant false return kar deta hai. Akhir mein, agar exactly ek difference mile toh true return karta hai, warna false.

en: Compute non‑overlapping intervals with their total paint thickness from a list of painted segments.
ru: Painted segments ki ek list se unke total paint thickness ke sath non-overlapping intervals compute karta hai.

en: First checks if the whole string is a palindrome; if so, it counts runs of identical characters from the centre outward. Otherwise it finds the first mismatching pair, tests removing either side of that pair, and counts extensions of equal characters adjacent to the removed block. The process stops after handling the first mismatch.
ru: Pehle check karta hai ke pura string palindrome hai ya nahi; agar hai, centre se bahar ki taraf identical characters ke runs count karta hai. Warna pehla mismatching pair dhoondta hai, us pair ke kisi bhi side ko remove karke test karta hai, aur removed block ke adjacent equal characters ki extensions count karta hai. Pehla mismatch handle hone ke baad process ruk jata hai.

en: For each class, calculate the marginal increase in ratio if one more student is added and store these in a max‑heap. Repeatedly pop the class with the greatest marginal gain, add a student, recompute its gain, and push it back. Finally, sum the ratios of all classes and divide by the number of classes.
ru: Har class ke liye, agar ek aur student add ho toh ratio mein marginal increase calculate karta hai aur inhe ek max-heap mein store karta hai. Baar baar sabse zyada marginal gain wali class pop karta hai, ek student add karta hai, uska gain recompute karta hai, aur use wapas push karta hai. Akhir mein, sab classes ke ratios ka sum leta hai aur classes ki tadaad se divide kar deta hai.

en: Verify x%99; compute diff = x/99; iterate i and j from 1 to 9, increment answer by 10 for each pair where i‑j equals diff.
ru: x%99 verify karta hai; diff = x/99 compute karta hai; i aur j ko 1 se 9 tak iterate karta hai, har us pair ke liye answer mein 10 increment karta hai jahan i-j, diff ke barabar ho.

en: Finds the index of the smallest character in a sorted vector that is strictly greater than a given target, or returns the vector size if none exists.
ru: Ek sorted vector mein us sabse chote character ka index dhoondta hai jo diye gaye target se strictly zyada ho, ya vector size return karta hai agar koi na mile.

en: Uses a stack to track unmatched '('. Marks excess ')' as ⟦0⟧. Removes '*' in final pass to construct valid string.
ru: Unmatched ‘(’ ko track karne ke liye stack ka use karta hai. Extra ‘)’ ko ⟦0⟧ ke taur par mark karta hai. Final pass mein ‘*’ ko remove karke valid string construct karta hai.

en: Scan the string left‑to‑right, counting matches of ch. When the counter reaches N, return the current index; otherwise, after the loop return -1.
ru: String ko left-to-right scan karta hai, ch ke matches count karte hue. Jab counter N tak pahunch jaye, current index return karta hai; warna, loop ke baad -1 return karta hai.

en: Unit‑test that ⟦0⟧ correctly handles out‑of‑range grades and duplicate courses.
ru: Ek unit-test ke ⟦0⟧ out-of-range grades aur duplicate courses ko sahi tarah handle karta hai.

en: Compute the minimum number of increment operations required to make any k elements of the array equal.
ru: Array ke kisi bhi k elements ko equal banane ke liye zaroori minimum increment operations compute karta hai.

en: Iterate through the source range, swapping each element with the corresponding element in the destination range using ADL-based move swap. Return the iterator pointing to the end of the destination range.
ru: Source range ke through iterate karta hai aur har element ko destination range ke corresponding element ke sath ADL-based move swap ka use karke swap karta hai. Phir destination range ke end ki taraf point karne wala iterator return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the larger of the counts of positive and negative elements.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – positive aur negative elements ke counts mein se bara wala.

en: The function first checks for a null ⟦0⟧. If the current nodes match, it uses ⟦1⟧ to compare the entire subtrees. If not, it recursively searches A’s left and right children for a matching subtree.
ru: Function sab se pehle null ⟦0⟧ ko check karta hai. Agar current nodes match karte hon to ⟦1⟧ use karke dono complete subtrees ko compare karta hai. Agar match na karein to A ke left aur right children mein recursively matching subtree search karta hai.

en: Scan the string, tracking positions of consecutive '0's with two temporary indices. When a non‑consecutive '0' is found, reset tracking and increment the operation count. After the scan, add extra operations for any remaining unpaired '0's.
ru: String ko scan karta hai, do temporary indices ke sath consecutive '0's ki positions track karte hue. Jab ek non-consecutive '0' mile, tracking reset karta hai aur operation count increment karta hai. Scan ke baad, kisi bhi remaining unpaired '0's ke liye extra operations add karta hai.

en: Implements the Sieve of Eratosthenes on a boolean array of size n+1, marking non‑primes by iterating p from 2 up to √n. After sieving, it scans the array backward from n to 2, outputting numbers that remain marked true.
ru: Sieve of Eratosthenes ko n+1 size ke boolean array par implement karta hai. p ko 2 se √n tak iterate karke non-prime numbers ko mark karta hai. Sieving ke baad array ko n se 2 tak reverse order mein scan karta hai aur jo numbers true marked reh jayein unhein output karta hai.

en: For each integer i from 2 up to √num, the code counts how many times i divides num by testing successive powers of i. If the count is odd, it is decremented to become even; the product of i raised to that even exponent is accumulated into the result. The final product is the largest square factor.
ru: 2 se √num tak har integer i ke liye, code i ke successive powers test karke count karta hai ke i kitni baar num ko divide karta hai. Agar count odd ho, use even banane ke liye decrement kiya jata hai; i ka us even exponent tak power ka product result mein accumulate hota hai. Final product sabse bara square factor hota hai.

en: To provide a formatted string representation of a Self object for easy printing.
ru: Self object ki formatted string representation provide karta hai taake usay asani se print kiya ja sake.

en: Compute the array’s mean. If the size is odd, perform a binary search for the ⟦0⟧. If even, use a two‑pointer scan from both ends, comparing the pairwise average to the mean, moving pointers based on comparison.
ru: Array ka mean compute karta hai. Agar size odd ho, ⟦0⟧ ke liye ek binary search perform karta hai. Agar even ho, dono ends se ek two-pointer scan istemal karta hai, pairwise average ko mean se compare karte hue, comparison ke hisab se pointers move karte hue.

en: Handle trivial ⟦0⟧. Otherwise locate the rightmost 0‑bit by finding the rightmost set bit of the bitwise complement, then set that bit in the original value.
ru: Trivial ⟦0⟧ handle karta hai. Warna bitwise complement ka rightmost set bit dhoond kar rightmost 0-bit locate karta hai, phir us bit ko original value mein set kar deta hai.

en: Convert ⟦0⟧ to a word ⟦1⟧ and a bit ⟦2⟧. If the word index is outside ⟦3⟧, return false. Otherwise, shift the selected word right by the offset and mask the lowest bit to determine its value.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko ek word ⟦1⟧ aur ek bit ⟦2⟧ mein convert karta hai. Agar word index ⟦3⟧ se bahar ho, false return karta hai. Warna, selected word ko offset se right shift karta hai aur lowest bit ko mask karke uski value determine karta hai.

en: Initialize a segment tree for range‑add/point‑query. Iterate over updates, performing a range addition on the tree. Finally, query each index to build the result vector. This runs in O((length + |updates|) log length) time.
ru: Range-add/point-query ke liye ek segment tree initialize karta hai. Updates par iterate karta hai, tree par ek range addition perform karte hue. Akhir mein, result vector build karne ke liye har index ko query karta hai. Ye O((length + |updates|) log length) time mein chalta hai.

en: Compute the integer power of a base raised to a non‑negative exponent.
ru: Ek base ki non-negative exponent tak integer power compute karta hai.

en: Implements the QuickSort algorithm to sort an array in‑place.
ru: Ek array ko in-place sort karne ke liye QuickSort algorithm implement karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a vector of distinct integers representing shooter skill levels.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – distinct integers ka ek vector jo shooter skill levels represent karta hai.

en: Compute and print Gould's sequence – the count of odd binomial coefficients in each row of Pascal's triangle up to n.
ru: Gould ki sequence compute aur print karta hai – n tak Pascal's triangle ki har row mein odd binomial coefficients ka count.

en: a ⟦0⟧ s containing '(' and ')' characters.
ru: ek ⟦0⟧ s jismein '(' aur ')' characters hote hain.

en: Prints the sequence of moves to solve the Tower of Hanoi puzzle for n disks.
ru: n disks ke liye Tower of Hanoi puzzle solve karne ke moves ki sequence print karta hai.

en: References to three ⟦0⟧ that will receive the cache sizes in kilobytes.
ru: Teen ⟦0⟧ ke references jo kilobytes mein cache sizes receive karenge.

en: Compute and output a modular exponentiation result with a special case for N = 1.
ru: Modular exponentiation ka result calculate aur output karta hai, aur N = 1 ke liye special case handle karta hai.

en: A pointer to the head of the new linked list where even nodes precede odd nodes.
ru: Ek naye linked list ke head ka pointer jahan even nodes odd nodes se pehle aate hain.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the maximal score achievable.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – hasil hone wala maximal score.

en: Perform a post‑order traversal of a binary tree, collecting node values.
ru: Ek binary tree ki post-order traversal perform karta hai, node values collect karte hue.

en: Uses backtracking to generate all possible strings and stores them in a list. Returns the k-th string if it exists.
ru: Sab possible strings generate karne ke liye backtracking istemal karta hai aur unhe ek list mein store karta hai. Agar mojood ho toh k-th string return karta hai.

en: This function calculates the barycenter of two points in 3D space based on their coordinates and weights.
ru: Ye function 3D space mein do points ka barycenter calculate karta hai unke coordinates aur weights ke hisab se.

en: Removes a range of vertices from a graph.
ru: Ek graph se vertices ki ek range remove karta hai.

en: For each row in res, iterate over its strings, outputting each followed by a space. After finishing a row, output a newline. This yields a space‑separated view of the matrix.
ru: res ki har row ke liye, uski strings par iterate karta hai, har ek ko ek space ke sath output karte hue. Row khatam hone ke baad, ek newline output karta hai. Ye matrix ka ek space-separated view deta hai.

en: Two nested loops traverse the matrix in row‑major order, reading each element, applying ⟦0⟧, and writing the result back in place. The function ignores the ⟦1⟧ parameter.
ru: Do nested loops matrix ko row-major order mein traverse karte hain, har element parhte hue, ⟦0⟧ apply karte hue, aur result ko place mein wapas likhte hue. Function ⟦1⟧ parameter ko ignore karta hai.

en: Count sub‑arrays whose element sum does not exceed a threshold t.
ru: Un sub-arrays ko count karta hai jinka element sum threshold t se zyada na ho.

en: Build a prefix‑count matrix ⟦0⟧ storing cumulative occurrences of each alphabet letter. For each query, compute the number of letters with odd frequency in the substring; the minimal replacements needed is half that count. Compare this value with k to decide the answer.
ru: Ek prefix-count matrix ⟦0⟧ build karta hai jo har alphabet letter ki cumulative occurrences store karti hai. Har query ke liye, substring mein odd frequency wale letters ki tadaad compute karta hai; minimal replacements zaroori us count ka aadha hoti hai. Answer decide karne ke liye is value ko k se compare karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - A pointer to a hashed index node.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - Hashed index node ka pointer.

en: Compute the minimum number of operations needed to reduce a non‑negative integer to zero, where each operation flips a single bit and optionally its neighboring bit.
ru: Ek non-negative integer ko zero tak reduce karne ke liye minimum operations compute karta hai, jahan har operation ek single bit aur optionally uska neighboring bit flip karta hai.

en: Use a frequency ⟦0⟧ to track how many times each value has been seen. While scanning nums, the current frequency determines the target row; if this frequency equals the current number of rows, a new row is created. The number is then appended to that row and its frequency is incremented. Handles empty input gracefully.
ru: Har value kitni baar dekhi gayi hai track karne ke liye ek frequency ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai. nums scan karte hue, current frequency target row determine karti hai; agar ye frequency current rows ki tadaad ke barabar ho, ek nayi row create hoti hai. Number phir us row mein append hota hai aur uski frequency increment ho jati hai. Empty input ko gracefully handle karta hai.

en: Compute the required raw size for the given dimensions; if the input vector is smaller, abort with error 84. Otherwise, invoke the pointer‑based ⟦0⟧ overload, passing a null pointer when the input is empty and a pointer to the first element otherwise.
ru: Di gayi dimensions ke liye zaroori raw size compute karta hai; agar input vector chota ho, error 84 ke sath abort kar deta hai. Warna, pointer-based ⟦0⟧ overload invoke karta hai, agar input empty ho toh ek null pointer pass karte hue aur warna pehle element ka pointer.

en: If either input is empty, return the other. Update node metadata via ⟦0⟧. Ensure ⟦1⟧ has the smaller weight; otherwise swap roots. Recursively merge ⟦2⟧ into ⟦1⟧'s right subtree, assign the result to ⟦3⟧, then swap ⟦4⟧ with this new right child, yielding a correctly merged tree.
ru: Agar dono mein se koi input empty ho to doosra return karta hai. ⟦0⟧ ke zariye node ka metadata update karta hai. Ensure karta hai ke ⟦1⟧ ka weight chhota ho; warna roots ko swap karta hai. Phir recursively ⟦2⟧ ko ⟦1⟧ ke right subtree ke sath merge karta hai, result ko ⟦3⟧ mein assign karta hai, aur ⟦4⟧ ko naye right child ke sath swap karta hai, jis se correctly merged tree hasil hota hai.

en: Prints an int (via cout) representing the number of containers that overflowed.
ru: Un containers ki tadaad represent karta ek int (cout ke zariye) print karta hai jo overflow hue.

en: Utilizes two hash maps to track element counts in the left and right subarrays. Iterates through the array, updating these counts and checking if the current element's count multiplied by 2 exceeds the size of its respective subarray.
ru: Left aur right subarrays mein element counts track karne ke liye do hash maps istemal karta hai. Array ke through iterate karta hai, in counts ko update karta hai aur check karta hai ke current element ka count 2 se multiply hokar uske respective subarray ke size se zyada hota hai ya nahi.

en: Provides access to the underlying bool array data, but is deliberately disabled for the bool specialization.
ru: Underlying bool array data tak access faraham karta hai, lekin bool specialization ke liye jaan boojh kar disable kiya gaya hai.

en: For positive ⟦0⟧, compute the number of decimal digits and a mask for the most‑significant digit. Repeatedly compare the outermost digits, stripping them after each comparison, until all digit pairs are checked. Zero is a palindrome; negatives immediately return false.
ru: Positive ⟦0⟧ ke liye decimal digits ki tadaad aur most-significant digit ka mask calculate karta hai. Phir repeatedly outermost digits ko compare karta hai aur har comparison ke baad un digits ko remove karta hai, jab tak tamam digit pairs check na ho jayein. Zero palindrome hai; negative numbers ke liye foran false return karta hai.

en: Returns 0 for n < 5 as a special case. Otherwise computes 2.4·n^{1/3}·(log n)^{2/3} − 5 using double‑precision math, then casts the result to unsigned int.
ru: n < 5 ke liye ek special case ke tor par 0 return karta hai. Warna double-precision math istemal karke 2.4·n^{1/3}·(log n)^{2/3} − 5 compute karta hai, phir result ko unsigned int mein cast kar deta hai.

en: Constructs and prints a ⟦0⟧ that satisfies given node count n, diameter d, and height h, or reports impossibility.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ construct aur print karta hai jo di gayi node count n, diameter d, aur height h satisfy kare, ya impossibility report karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the minimal step count for the segment.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – segment ke liye minimum steps ki count.

en: Multiplies corresponding elements from each row of the first matrix with corresponding elements from each column of the second matrix and sums them up to get the elements of the resulting matrix.
ru: Pehli matrix ki har row ke corresponding elements ko doosri matrix ke har column ke corresponding elements se multiply karta hai aur resulting matrix ke elements hasil karne ke liye unhe sum karta hai.

en: int n – the integer to test or factor.
ru: int n – wo integer jise test ya factor karna hai.

en: The function multiplies each component by itself and adds the four products. No square‑root is taken, so the result is the norm squared, which is faster and sufficient for comparisons.
ru: Ye function har component ko khud se multiply karta hai aur chaar products add karta hai. Koi square-root nahi liya jata, isliye result norm squared hota hai, jo comparisons ke liye faster aur sufficient hai.

en: Counts how many strings in a list begin with a specified prefix.
ru: Ek list mein kitni strings ek specified prefix se shuru hoti hain, ye count karta hai.

en: For each i from 1 to n, compute its divisor count using a naïve ⟦0⟧ scan; if the count equals nine, increment a tally. The divisor count itself loops from 1 to the number, checking divisibility.
ru: 1 se n tak har i ke liye, ek naive ⟦0⟧ scan istemal karke iska divisor count compute karta hai; agar count nau ke barabar ho, ek tally increment kar deta hai. Divisor count khud 1 se number tak loop karta hai, divisibility check karte hue.

en: To determine the maximum number of boxes that can be stored in a warehouse given their heights and the warehouse's height levels.
ru: Boxes ki heights aur warehouse ke height levels diye jane par warehouse mein store ki ja sakne wali maximum boxes ki tadaad determine karne ke liye.

en: Handles n = 0 and n = 1 directly by checking the LSB of a or b. For larger n, the parity of a and b dictates a periodic pattern with period 3; the function returns true unless ⟦0⟧ falls on a multiple of 3 according to that pattern.
ru: n = 0 aur n = 1 ko directly a ya b ke LSB check karke handle karta hai. Bare n ke liye, a aur b ki parity period 3 wale ek periodic pattern ko dictate karti hai; function true return karta hai jab tak us pattern ke hisab se ⟦0⟧, 3 ke multiple par na ho.

en: After handling the empty case, the envelopes are sorted lexicographically. A DP array stores the longest chain ending at each envelope; for each envelope we scan all previous ones and extend the chain when both dimensions are larger. The final answer is the maximum DP value.
ru: Empty case handle karne ke baad envelopes ko lexicographically sort karta hai. DP array mein har envelope par end hone wali longest chain store karta hai. Har envelope ke liye previous envelopes ko scan karta hai aur jab dono dimensions larger hon to chain ko extend karta hai. Aakhir mein maximum DP value final answer hoti hai.

en: Initialize ⟦0⟧=0, ⟦1⟧=1 (if n≥1). Iterate i from 2 to n, filling ⟦2⟧ using the recurrence ⟦3⟧=⟦2⟧ and ⟦4⟧=⟦2⟧+⟦5⟧; simultaneously track the maximum value encountered. Return that maximum.
ru: ⟦0⟧=0, ⟦1⟧=1 initialize karta hai (agar n≥1). i ko 2 se n tak iterate karta hai, recurrence ⟦3⟧=⟦2⟧ aur ⟦4⟧=⟦2⟧+⟦5⟧ istemal karke ⟦2⟧ fill karte hue; sath sath mili hui maximum value track karta hai. Wo maximum return karta hai.

en: This function removes an item from the collection using its key.
ru: Ye function ek item ko uski key istemal karke collection se remove karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - The inverse of the input index.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - Input index ki inverse.

en: bool – true if every ⟦0⟧ > ⟦1⟧ for a < i ≤ b, otherwise false.
ru: bool – true agar har ⟦0⟧ > ⟦1⟧ ho a < i ≤ b ke liye, warna false.

en: The function appends the start and end points of the Self object, its time, and its collinearity status to the output stream.
ru: Function Self object ke start aur end points, us ka time, aur collinearity status output stream mein append karta hai.

en: Maps an integer ⟦0⟧ into the interval [lo, hi] using wrap‑around and linear interpolation.
ru: Ek integer ⟦0⟧ ko interval [lo, hi] mein map karta hai wrap-around aur linear interpolation istemal karte hue.

en: Iterates through the string, tracking the counts of consecutive '0's and '1's. When a different character is encountered, it updates the counts and checks if the current segment can form balanced substrings with previous segments.
ru: String ke through iterate karta hai, consecutive '0's aur '1's ke counts track karte hue. Jab ek different character mile, counts update karta hai aur check karta hai ke current segment pichle segments ke sath balanced substrings form kar sakta hai ya nahi.

en: An integer indicating the number of rectangles whose maximal square side equals the overall maximum.
ru: Ek integer jo un rectangles ki tadaad indicate karta hai jinka maximal square side overall maximum ke barabar ho.

en: Dynamic programming fills an array where each entry i holds the optimal count using previously computed results. For each i, iterate over all squares ≤ i, updating the count via the recurrence ⟦0⟧ = ⟦1⟧. The answer is ⟦2⟧.
ru: Dynamic programming ek array fill karta hai jahan har entry i pehle se compute kiye gaye results ka istemal karke optimal count rakhta hai. Har i ke liye, ≤ i wale sab squares par iterate karta hai, recurrence ⟦0⟧ = ⟦1⟧ ke zariye count update karte hue. Answer ⟦2⟧ hota hai.

en: If N ≤ K, the answer is the base value 1. Otherwise, initialise the first K terms to 1, set ⟦0⟧-th term to K, then iteratively compute each subsequent term using the recurrence ⟦1⟧ = sum – ⟦2⟧ + ⟦3⟧, where sum holds the previous term's cumulative value. The final term ⟦4⟧ is printed.
ru: Agar N ≤ K ho, answer base value 1 hota hai. Warna, pehle K terms ko 1 par initialise karta hai, ⟦0⟧-th term ko K set karta hai, phir recurrence ⟦1⟧ = sum – ⟦2⟧ + ⟦3⟧ istemal karke har subsequent term iteratively compute karta hai, jahan sum previous term ki cumulative value rakhta hai. Final term ⟦4⟧ print kiya jata hai.

en: First calculate the total ⟦0⟧. Then iterate from the second element onward, progressively moving one element from the suffix to the prefix while updating both sums and tracking the maximum of the current prefix, suffix, and the best seen so far.
ru: Sab se pehle total ⟦0⟧ calculate karta hai. Phir second element se start karke har step par aik element ko suffix se prefix mein move karta hai, dono sums ko update karta hai aur current prefix, suffix aur ab tak ke best result mein se maximum ko track karta hai.

en: Compute the frequency of each whitespace‑separated token in a string.
ru: Ek string mein har whitespace-separated token ki frequency compute karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – total count of items; ⟦1⟧ – cost per item; N – number of items to buy; M – number of free items per promotion.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – items ka total count; ⟦1⟧ – har item ka cost; N – khareedne wale items ki tadaad; M – har promotion mein free items ki tadaad.

en: To perform an exact division of two BigInt numbers, ensuring no remainder.
ru: Do BigInt numbers ko is tarah exact divide karna ke koi remainder na bache.

en: Iterate over each gap, performing an insertion sort on elements spaced by that gap. For each element, shift larger gap‑spaced elements forward until the correct position for the element is found, then insert it. The process repeats with progressively smaller gaps, ending with gap = 1 for a final insertion sort pass.
ru: Har gap ke liye insertion sort perform karta hai, jahan elements us gap ke distance par hote hain. Har element ke liye larger gap-spaced elements ko aage shift karta hai jab tak element ki correct position na mil jaye, phir usay insert karta hai. Yeh process gradually chote gaps ke sath repeat hota hai aur akhir mein gap = 1 par final insertion sort pass perform hota hai.

en: int – always returns 0 (function prints the string to standard output).
ru: int – hamesha 0 return karta hai (function string ko standard output par print karta hai).

en: Uses nested loops to compare each character of 'needle' against characters in 'haystack'. If a mismatch is found, it breaks out of the inner loop and continues with the next character in 'haystack'. If 'needle' is fully matched, returns the current index in 'haystack'.
ru: Nested loops ka use karke ‘needle’ ke har character ko ‘haystack’ ke characters ke sath compare karta hai. Agar mismatch milay, to inner loop se bahar nikal jata hai aur ‘haystack’ ke next character ke sath continue karta hai. Agar ‘needle’ completely match ho jaye, to ‘haystack’ mein current index return karta hai.

en: an integer representing the minimum number of white blocks that must be recolored inside any length‑k window.
ru: Ek integer jo kisi bhi length-k window ke andar recolor karne zaroori minimum white blocks represent karta hai.

en: Optionally fixes an incorrect ⟦0⟧ on PyPy builds, allocates the object via ⟦1⟧, casts it to the C++ instance type, allocates the internal layout, marks the instance as owned, and returns the Python object pointer.
ru: PyPy builds par ek ghalat ⟦0⟧ ko optionally fix karta hai, ⟦1⟧ ke zariye object allocate karta hai, use C++ instance type mein cast karta hai, internal layout allocate karta hai, instance ko owned mark karta hai, aur Python object pointer return karta hai.

en: Compute the maximum number of boxes that can be placed in a warehouse under height constraints.
ru: Height constraints ko follow karte hue warehouse mein rakhe ja sakne wale boxes ki maximum number calculate karta hai.

en: Iterate through each element in the ⟦0⟧. For each element, check if it is equal to the element diagonally above and to the left. If any such pair does not match, return false. If all pairs match, return true.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke har element ke through iterate karta hai. Har element ke liye check karta hai ke kya woh diagonally upar aur left wale element ke barabar hai. Agar koi bhi aisa pair match na kare to false return karta hai. Agar tamam pairs match karein to true return karta hai.

en: Iterate with a right pointer j, maintaining a running sum. When the window exceeds k, accumulate the leftmost elements in “trail”; if this trail becomes negative, subtract it from the sum and reset, effectively dropping a detrimental prefix. Update the result after each step.
ru: Ek right pointer j ke sath iterate karta hai, ek running sum maintain karte hue. Jab window k se zyada ho jaye, leftmost elements ko "trail" mein accumulate karta hai; agar ye trail negative ho jaye, use sum se subtract karta hai aur reset kar deta hai, effectively ek nuqsaandeh prefix drop karte hue. Har step ke baad result update karta hai.

en: Iterates through the string to fill the LPS array. For each character, it checks if the current prefix can be extended by the next character. If so, it extends the prefix; otherwise, it uses previously computed values in the LPS array to find the longest possible prefix that is also a suffix.
ru: String ke har character par iterate karta hai taake LPS array ko fill kiya ja sake. Har character ke liye yeh check karta hai ke kya current prefix ko next character ke zariye extend kiya ja sakta hai. Agar ho sakta ho, to yeh prefix ko extend karta hai; warna LPS array mein pehle se calculate ki gayi values ko use karke sab se lamba possible prefix find karta hai jo suffix bhi ho.

en: The position is losing for the player to move ⟦0⟧ mod 6 == 0; otherwise it is winning. The function checks this condition and prints the corresponding result.
ru: Position us player ke liye losing hoti hai jise ⟦0⟧ mod 6 == 0 par move karna ho; warna ye winning hoti hai. Function ye condition check karta hai aur corresponding result print karta hai.

en: Initializes result to 1 and iteratively multiplies it by decreasing values of n while n is positive. The loop exits when n reaches 0, yielding n!. No overflow or negative‑n handling beyond returning 1.
ru: Result ko 1 se initialize karta hai aur iteratively n ki decreasing values se multiply karta hai jab tak n positive ho. Loop tab exit hota hai jab n 0 tak pahunch jaye, jisse n! milta hai. 1 return karne ke ilawa koi overflow ya negative-n handling nahi hai.

en: Perform a depth‑first traversal; when a leaf is reached, add its value only if it arrived via a left edge. For internal nodes, recursively aggregate the sums from the left and right subtrees, marking the left recursion as “left child” and the right as not.
ru: Ek depth-first traversal perform karta hai; jab ek leaf mile, uski value sirf tab add karta hai agar wo left edge ke zariye pahunchi ho. Internal nodes ke liye, left aur right subtrees se sums ko recursively aggregate karta hai, left recursion ko "left child" mark karte hue aur right ko nahi.

en: Iterate over all possible split positions ⟦0⟧. For each i, take the first i characters of S as a prefix and the last |T|‑i characters of S as a suffix; if their concatenation equals T, set possible and stop. Finally return the appropriate response string.
ru: Sab possible split positions ⟦0⟧ par iterate karta hai. Har i ke liye, S ke pehle i characters ko prefix ki tarah aur S ke last |T|-i characters ko suffix ki tarah leta hai; agar inka concatenation T ke barabar ho, possible set karke ruk jata hai. Akhir mein appropriate response string return karta hai.

en: If k does not divide m, answer is 0; if m = k, answer is 2 (0 and m). Otherwise compute n = m/k and return Euler’s totient φ(n), which counts integers ≤ n coprime to n. φ is calculated by factorising n, collecting distinct primes, and applying φ(n)=n·∏(1‑1/p).
ru: Agar k, m ko divide na kare to answer 0 hota hai. Agar m = k ho to answer 2 hota hai (0 aur m). Warna n = m/k calculate karta hai aur Euler’s totient φ(n) return karta hai, jo n ke saath coprime integers ki tadaad hoti hai. φ ko n ki prime factorization karke, distinct primes collect karke aur unke basis par totient formula apply karke calculate kiya jata hai.

en: Determines whether the sum of digits in odd ⟦0⟧ of an integer n is divisible by k.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek integer n ke odd ⟦0⟧ mein digits ka sum k se divisible hai ya nahi.

en: Build a boolean map of characters present in ⟦0⟧. For each list entry, count how many distinct characters from the map appear, clearing map entries as they are used to avoid double‑counting. If the count equals the word length, the entry is printed; finally, the map is restored for the next entry.
ru: ⟦0⟧ mein mojood characters ka ek boolean map build karta hai. Har list entry ke liye, count karta hai ke map se kitne distinct characters appear hote hain, double-counting se bachne ke liye istemal hote hi map entries clear karte hue. Agar count word length ke barabar ho, entry print hoti hai; akhir mein, agli entry ke liye map restore kar diya jata hai.

en: If ⟦0⟧ is defined, use the Windows‑specific ⟦1⟧ to fill a fixed‑size buffer and check the returned size; otherwise fall back to ⟦2⟧, checking for a nullptr result. In both cases, wrap the found C‑string in a ⟦3⟧ and return it inside an optional.
ru: Agar ⟦0⟧ defined ho, toh Windows-specific ⟦1⟧ istemal karta hai ek fixed-size buffer fill karne ke liye aur returned size check karta hai; warna ⟦2⟧ par fall back karta hai, nullptr result check karte hue. Dono cases mein, mile hue C-string ko ⟦3⟧ mein wrap karta hai aur ise ek optional ke andar return kar deta hai.

en: Sequentially invoke ⟦0⟧ on f1, then f2, then f3; if any call throws, subsequent waits are skipped, propagating the exception to the caller.
ru: f1 par ⟦0⟧ invoke karta hai, phir f2, phir f3, sequentially; agar koi call throw kare, baad ke waits skip ho jate hain, exception ko caller tak propagate karte hue.

en: Iterates over a list of property keys and calls a helper function to remove each property.
ru: Property keys ki ek list par iterate karta hai aur har property ko remove karne ke liye ek helper function call karta hai.

en: Extracts the points at the ends of the edge from the PEdge object and its associated triangle. Prints the edge's priority and the coordinates of the two points.
ru: PEdge object aur us se associated triangle se edge ke ends par mojood points ko extract karta hai. Edge ki priority aur dono points ke coordinates print karta hai.

en: str – the source string; n – desired substring ⟦0⟧.
ru: str – source string; n – desired substring ⟦0⟧.

en: Convert three RGB integer ⟦0⟧ into a formatted hexadecimal colour string.
ru: Teen RGB integer ⟦0⟧ ko ek formatted hexadecimal colour string mein convert karta hai.

en: The function recurses forward, evaluating two choices at each ⟦0⟧, and uses the stored results in dp to avoid repeated work, returning the best achievable difference.
ru: Ye function forward recurse karta hai, har ⟦0⟧ par do choices evaluate karte hue, aur repeated work se bachne ke liye dp mein stored results istemal karta hai, best achievable difference return karte hue.

en: Implements a generic ⟦0⟧ over a range of elements.
ru: Elements ki ek range par ek generic ⟦0⟧ implement karta hai.

en: X is filled with A ± B for each channel.
ru: X ko har channel ke liye A ± B se fill kiya jata hai.

en: string – the modified text where every vowel is shifted forward cyclically.
ru: string – modified text jahan har vowel cyclically forward shift ho jata hai.

en: Compute the string length n, then iterate i from 0 while i < n and i < x, comparing ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧. On a mismatch, output false and return; if the loop finishes, output true.
ru: String length n compute karta hai, phir i ko 0 se iterate karta hai jab tak i < n aur i < x ho, ⟦0⟧ ko ⟦1⟧ se compare karte hue. Mismatch par, false output karke return kar deta hai; agar loop khatam ho jaye, true output karta hai.

en: To find the k-th smallest element in the union of two sorted arrays.
ru: Do sorted arrays ke union mein k-th smallest element dhoondne ke liye.

en: A sieve marks primes up to N. For N ≥ 4 the answer equals 1 (for element 1) plus the count of primes strictly greater than N/2, because any such prime cannot share a factor with another number in the range. Small ⟦0⟧ are handled explicitly.
ru: Sieve ke zariye N tak prime numbers mark karta hai. N ≥ 4 ke liye answer 1 (element 1 ke liye) plus un primes ki count ke barabar hota hai jo N/2 se strictly greater hon, kyun ke aise primes range ke kisi doosre number ke sath common factor share nahi kar sakte. Chhote ⟦0⟧ ko separately handle kiya jata hai.

en: The function compares the input Handle with a null Handle. If they are not equal, it means the Handle is not null, and the function returns true; otherwise, it returns false.
ru: Ye function input Handle ko ek null Handle se compare karta hai. Agar wo barabar na hon, iska matlab hai ke Handle null nahi hai, aur function true return karta hai; warna false return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ rounds the cube root of a number and checks if cubing the rounded value reproduces the original; ⟦1⟧ evaluates this predicate for N+K and N‑K, using short‑circuit OR to decide which message to print.
ru: ⟦0⟧ kisi number ke cube root ko round karta hai aur check karta hai ke rounded value ko cube karne se original wapas milta hai ya nahi; ⟦1⟧ ye predicate N+K aur N-K ke liye evaluate karta hai, aur short-circuit OR istemal karke decide karta hai ke kaun sa message print karna hai.

en: Starting from the second row, skip rows that are completely equal to the first. For each remaining row, scan columns; if any element matches the first row’s element at the same column, return ⟦0⟧ immediately. If the scan finishes without matches, return ⟦1⟧.
ru: Doosri row se start karta hai aur un rows ko skip karta hai jo pehli row ke bilkul equal hon. Har remaining row ke liye columns ko scan karta hai; agar kisi column ka element pehli row ke usi column ke element se match kare to foran ⟦0⟧ return karta hai. Agar scan bina kisi match ke complete ho jaye to ⟦1⟧ return karta hai.

en: Returns a vector of vectors, where each inner vector represents a unique quadruplet that sums up to the target.
ru: Vectors ke vectors ka ek vector return karta hai, jahan har inner vector ek unique quadruplet ko represent karta hai jo target ke barabar sum hota hai.

en: vector – same length as nums, each entry holding the product of all elements except the one at the same index.
ru: vector – nums jitni hi length, har entry us index ke elements ke ilawa sab elements ka product rakhti hai.

en: Convert each percentage to a multiplicative ⟦0⟧, multiply the three factors to get the combined scaling, subtract 1 to isolate the net increase, then multiply by 100 to express it as a percentage.
ru: Har percentage ko multiplicative ⟦0⟧ mein convert karta hai, phir teenon factors ko multiply karke combined scaling hasil karta hai. Net increase ko alag karne ke liye 1 subtract karta hai, phir percentage mein express karne ke liye 100 se multiply karta hai.

en: Compute the 1‑based ⟦0⟧ of a given key in an order‑statistics tree.
ru: Ek order-statistics tree mein di gayi key ka 1-based ⟦0⟧ compute karta hai.

en: Generates all permutations of a given integer vector.
ru: Di hui integer vector ki tamam permutations generate karta hai.

en: Loop over all i < j, check equality of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, then test if (i*j) % k == 0. Increment a counter for each pair that satisfies both conditions.
ru: Har i < j pair par loop karta hai, ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ki equality check karta hai, phir test karta hai ke (i*j) % k == 0 hai ya nahi. Jo pair dono conditions satisfy kare, uske liye counter increment karta hai.

en: Determines whether two CPubKey objects represent the same public key.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke do CPubKey objects wahi public key represent karte hain ya nahi.

en: Traverse the input once, appending non‑‘#’ characters to a temporary buffer. When a ‘#’ is encountered, remove the last character from the buffer if it isn’t empty. The buffer is returned as the final string.
ru: Input ko ek dafa traverse karta hai, non-'#' characters ko ek temporary buffer mein append karte hue. Jab '#' mile toh buffer ka aakhri character remove kar deta hai agar buffer empty na ho. Buffer ko final string ke tor par return kiya jata hai.

en: Dynamic programming fills a table ⟦0⟧ where ⟦1⟧ stores the best solution for amount ⟦2⟧. For each amount, the algorithm iterates over all coin types, checks if the coin can be used, and updates ⟦1⟧ with the smallest feasible count. The final answer is ⟦3⟧.
ru: Dynamic programming ek table ⟦0⟧ fill karta hai jahan ⟦1⟧ amount ⟦2⟧ ke liye best solution store karta hai. Har amount ke liye, algorithm tamam coin types par iterate karta hai, check karta hai ke coin use ho sakta hai ya nahi, aur ⟦1⟧ ko sabse chhote feasible count se update kar deta hai. Final answer ⟦3⟧ hota hai.

en: A min‑heap of size at most k is built while scanning nums. Elements are pushed until the heap reaches size k; thereafter, any element larger than the heap’s minimum replaces it. The heap’s root finally holds the k‑th largest value.
ru: nums ko scan karte hue zyada se zyada size k wala ek min-heap build kiya jata hai. Elements tab tak push kiye jate hain jab tak heap size k tak na pahunche; uske baad, jo bhi element heap ke minimum se bara ho use replace kar deta hai. Heap ka root akhir mein k-th sabse bari value rakhta hai.

en: Insert the first n points into a set for fast lookup. For each unordered ⟦0⟧ compute the coordinate sums; if both sums are even, the midpoint is integer. Look up this midpoint in the set and increment the counter when found.
ru: Pehle n points ko fast lookup ke liye ek set mein insert karta hai. Har unordered ⟦0⟧ ke liye coordinate sums compute karta hai; agar dono sums even hon, midpoint integer hota hai. Is midpoint ko set mein dhoondta hai aur milne par counter increment kar deta hai.

en: int – the pivot value p if it exists; otherwise -1.
ru: int – pivot value p agar mojood ho; warna -1.

en: int – the unique ⟦0⟧.
ru: int – unique ⟦0⟧.

en: Finds the length of the longest ⟦0⟧ parentheses substring in a given string.
ru: Ek diye gaye string mein sabse lambi ⟦0⟧ (well-formed) parentheses substring ki length dhoondta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ uses recursion with a base case for N = 0 or 1; ⟦1⟧ calls ⟦2⟧, multiplies ⟦3⟧, and divides by 2, relying on integer arithmetic.
ru: ⟦0⟧ N = 0 ya 1 ke base case ke sath recursion istemal karta hai; ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ call karta hai, ⟦3⟧ se multiply karta hai, aur integer arithmetic par relying karte hue 2 se divide karta hai.

en: Subtract ⟦0⟧ from ⟦1⟧, assign the result to ⟦2⟧, and indicate success with a constant true.
ru: ⟦1⟧ mein se ⟦0⟧ ko subtract karta hai, result ⟦2⟧ mein assign kar deta hai, aur success ko constant true se indicate karta hai.

en: Calls accessor functions for numerator, denominator, and integer part on both operands and compares each pair using logical AND, leveraging short‑circuit evaluation to stop at the first inequality.
ru: Dono operands par numerator, denominator, aur integer part ke liye accessor functions call karta hai aur logical AND istemal karke har pair compare karta hai, short-circuit evaluation ka faida uthate hue pehli inequality par ruk jata hai.

en: Starting at the root, repeatedly compare the values of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ with the current node. If both are smaller, the LCA must be in the left subtree; if both are larger, it must be in the right subtree. When the values ⟦2⟧, the current node is the LCA, and the loop terminates.
ru: Root se shuru karke, baar baar ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ki values ko current node se compare karta hai. Agar dono chote hon, LCA left subtree mein hona chahiye; agar dono bare hon, wo right subtree mein hona chahiye. Jab values ⟦2⟧ hon, current node hi LCA hota hai, aur loop khatam ho jata hai.

en: Compute the greatest power of k not exceeding n and the next higher power of k.
ru: k ki wo sabse bari power compute karta hai jo n se zyada na ho, sath hi k ki agli higher power bhi.

en: ⟦0⟧ – Z‑array where ⟦1⟧ is the match length for position ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – Z-array jahan ⟦1⟧ position ⟦2⟧ ke liye match length hai.

en: A ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ containing the text to process.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ jismein process karne wala text hota hai.

en: Factor k into its prime powers. For each prime p with exponent e in k, use Legendre’s formula to find the exponent of p in n!. The exponent of k is limited by the smallest ⟦0⟧ across all prime factors.
ru: k ko uske prime powers mein factor karta hai. k mein exponent e wale har prime p ke liye, n! mein p ka exponent dhoondne ke liye Legendre's formula istemal karta hai. k ka exponent sab prime factors mein sabse chote ⟦0⟧ se limit hota hai.

en: Inverts a binary tree by swapping left and right children of every node.
ru: Binary tree ko invert karta hai, yani har node ke left aur right children ko swap karta hai.

en: Use dynamic programming to keep track of the maximum sum up to each element without including adjacent elements.
ru: Adjacent elements shamil kiye baghair har element tak maximum sum track rakhne ke liye dynamic programming istemal karta hai.

en: bool – true if n is brilliant, false otherwise.
ru: bool – true agar n brilliant ho, warna false.

en: Converts a ⟦0⟧ object to its string representation, handling both local file URLs and remote URLs.
ru: ⟦0⟧ object ko uski string representation mein convert karta hai, aur local file URLs aur remote URLs dono ko handle karta hai.

en: For each x from 1 to z, binary‑search y in the fixed ⟦0⟧; when ⟦1⟧ matches z, record the pair and continue to the next x. Monotonicity of f guarantees at most one y per x.
ru: 1 se z tak har x ke liye, fixed ⟦0⟧ mein y ko binary-search karta hai; jab ⟦1⟧ z se match kare, pair record karta hai aur agle x ki taraf continue karta hai. f ki monotonicity guarantee karti hai ke har x ke liye zyada se zyada ek y ho.

en: Compute the minimum number of copy‑and‑paste operations to produce exactly n 'A's.
ru: Exactly n 'A's produce karne ke liye minimum copy-and-paste operations compute karta hai.

en: Iterate through the array, counting positions where the element’s parity does not match the expected ⟦0⟧. The count of mismatches for one parity pattern is ⟦1⟧; the opposite pattern requires ⟦2⟧ changes. Return the smaller of the two counts.
ru: Array ke through iterate karta hai aur un positions ko count karta hai jahan element ki parity expected ⟦0⟧ se match nahi karti. Aik parity pattern ke liye mismatches ki count ⟦1⟧ hoti hai, jabke opposite pattern ke liye ⟦2⟧ changes chahiye hote hain. Dono counts mein se choti value return karta hai.

en: Recursively traverse the left subtree, assign the next vector element to the current node, increment the index, then recursively traverse the right subtree, thereby replacing values following the in‑order sequence.
ru: Recursively left subtree ko traverse karta hai, next vector element ko current node mein assign karta hai, index ko increment karta hai, phir recursively right subtree ko traverse karta hai. Is tarah values in-order sequence ke mutabiq replace hoti hain.

en: Maintains a sliding window with two pointers l and r and a frequency array f for the 26 lowercase letters. The window expands right while the next character is unseen; each expansion adds the number of new distinct substrings ending at r. When a repeat would occur, the window contracts from the left, decreasing the frequency of the leftmost character. The process continues until l traverses the whole string.
ru: Do pointers l aur r aur 26 lowercase letters ke liye ek frequency array f ke sath ek sliding window maintain karta hai. Window right ki taraf expand hoti hai jab tak agla character unseen ho; har expansion r par khatam hone wale nayi distinct substrings ki tadaad add karta hai. Jab ek repeat hone wala ho, window left se contract hoti hai, leftmost character ki frequency kam karte hue. Process tab tak continue hota hai jab tak l pura string traverse na kar le.

en: Compute the widest vertical gap between any two points when projected onto the x‑axis.
ru: x-axis par project hone par kisi bhi do points ke darmiyan sabse chaura vertical gap compute karta hai.

en: No return value; prints each node’s ⟦0⟧ field in pre‑order sequence.
ru: Koi return value nahi; har node ka ⟦0⟧ field pre-order sequence mein print karta hai.

en: Iterate once with a sliding window, tracking indices of recent ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. When a decreasing step follows an ascent, shrink the window past negative elements before the peak. When an increasing step follows a descent, record the current window sum. Equality resets the window. The maximum sum encountered is returned.
ru: Ek sliding window ke sath ek dafa iterate karta hai, recent ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke indices track karte hue. Jab ek decreasing step ek ascent ke baad aaye, window ko peak se pehle negative elements ke aage shrink karta hai. Jab ek increasing step ek descent ke baad aaye, current window sum record karta hai. Equality window ko reset kar deti hai. Mila hua maximum sum return kiya jata hai.

en: If the root is null, return an empty vector. Otherwise, start a result vector with the root’s value, then recursively obtain each child’s pre‑order list and append it to the result. The recursion builds the final traversal depth‑first.
ru: Agar root null ho, ek empty vector return karta hai. Warna, root ki value se ek result vector shuru karta hai, phir har child ki pre-order list recursively hasil karke result mein append karta hai. Recursion final traversal ko depth-first build karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the numbers to process; ⟦1⟧ – the number of elements (should equal ⟦2⟧).
ru: ⟦0⟧ – process karne wale numbers; ⟦1⟧ – elements ki tadaad (⟦2⟧ ke barabar honi chahiye).

en: Use a sliding window with two pointers. A decreasing deque maintains the index of the maximum charge time in ⟦0⟧. ⟦1⟧ holds the sum of running costs in the window. Expand the right pointer, then while the combined ⟦2⟧ exceeds the budget, shrink from the left, updating the deque and sum accordingly. The window size after the loop is the answer.
ru: Do pointers ke sath ek sliding window istemal karta hai. Ek decreasing deque ⟦0⟧ mein maximum charge time ka index maintain karta hai. ⟦1⟧ window mein running costs ka sum rakhta hai. Right pointer ko expand karta hai, phir jab tak combined ⟦2⟧ budget se zyada ho, left se shrink karta hai, deque aur sum ko us hisab se update karte hue. Loop ke baad window ka size hi answer hota hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a new string containing only the first occurrence of each character in the original order.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ek naya string jismein original order mein har character ka sirf pehla occurrence hota hai.

en: const ⟦0⟧& in – the source string to be transformed.
ru: const ⟦0⟧& in – transform karne wala source string.

en: Rotates three values cyclically so that a←b, b←c, c←original a.
ru: Teen values ko cyclically rotate karta hai taake a←b, b←c, c←original a ho.

en: The function checks if 'a' is less than zero. If true, it multiplies 'a' by 'b' and returns the result. If false, it simply returns 'a'.
ru: Ye function check karta hai ke 'a' zero se kam hai ya nahi. Agar true ho, 'a' ko 'b' se multiply karke result return karta hai. Agar false ho, sirf 'a' return kar deta hai.

en: Insert all projects into a min‑heap keyed by required capital. Repeatedly transfer all projects whose capital requirement ≤ current capital into a max‑heap keyed by profit, then pop the most profitable project, add its profit to the capital, and decrement k. Stop when no affordable profitable project remains or k reaches zero.
ru: Sab projects ko required capital se keyed ek min-heap mein insert karta hai. Baar baar un sab projects ko jinki capital requirement current capital se kam ya barabar ho profit se keyed ek max-heap mein transfer karta hai, phir sabse profitable project pop karta hai, uska profit capital mein add karta hai, aur k decrement karta hai. Jab koi affordable profitable project na bache ya k zero tak pahunch jaye toh ruk jata hai.

en: Walk through A, skipping consecutive duplicate ⟦0⟧. For each unique element, perform a linear search in B; if found, append it to the result. The method is ⟦1⟧ in the worst case.
ru: A se guzarta hai, consecutive duplicate ⟦0⟧ ko skip karte hue. Har unique element ke liye, B mein ek linear search perform karta hai; agar mil jaye, use result mein append kar deta hai. Worst case mein ye method ⟦1⟧ hai.

en: Returns a unit‑length version of the current quaternion without modifying it.
ru: Current quaternion ka unit-length version return karta hai aur original quaternion ko modify nahi karta.

en: Starts with a base count of 1, then multiplies it by a factor determined by the equality of adjacent ⟦0⟧. Handles the first, interior, and last positions separately, using the pattern of equal/unequal neighboring characters to adjust the count.
ru: 1 ke base count se shuru karta hai, phir use adjacent ⟦0⟧ ki equality se determine hone wale ek factor se multiply karta hai. Pehli, interior, aur last positions ko separately handle karta hai, equal/unequal neighboring characters ka pattern istemal karke count adjust karte hue.

en: If the current pointer is non‑null, output its value, then recursively visit the left child followed by the right child, thereby visiting nodes in root‑left‑right order. The recursion naturally terminates when a null child is encountered.
ru: Agar current pointer non-null ho, iski value output karta hai, phir left child ko recursively visit karta hai uske baad right child ko, is tarah nodes ko root-left-right order mein visit karte hue. Recursion naturally tab khatam hoti hai jab null child mile.

en: ⟦0⟧ counts set bits of ⟦1⟧ by repeatedly masking the LSB and shifting right; it then returns 2 raised to that count. ⟦2⟧ loops from 0 to n‑1, calling ⟦0⟧ and printing the result.
ru: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ ke set bits ko count karta hai; LSB ko repeatedly mask karke aur right shift karta hai, phir 2 ki us count wali power return karta hai. ⟦2⟧, 0 se n-1 tak loop karta hai, ⟦0⟧ ko call karta hai aur result print karta hai.

en: This function calculates the maximum score difference between two players in a game where players take turns picking stones from either end of an array. The player who picks last wins the game.
ru: Yeh function do players ke darmiyan maximum score difference calculate karta hai ek aisi game mein jahan players bari bari array ke dono ends mein se stones pick karte hain. Jo player sab se aakhir mein stone pick karta hai, woh game jeet jata hai.

en: To add an edge to a polyhedron overlay by modifying existing halfedges.
ru: Polyhedron overlay mein existing halfedges ko modify karke aik edge add karta hai.

en: Build a DP array ⟦0⟧ where ⟦1⟧ stores the sum of energies starting at ⟦2⟧ and then jumping by ⟦3⟧. Fill ⟦0⟧ right‑to‑left so future values are already known. Finally return the maximum value in ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ek DP array ⟦0⟧ build karta hai jahan ⟦1⟧ un energies ka sum store karta hai jo ⟦2⟧ se shuru hoti hain aur phir ⟦3⟧ se jump karti hain. ⟦0⟧ ko right-to-left fill karta hai taake future values pehle se maloom hon. Akhir mein ⟦0⟧ mein maximum value return karta hai.

en: int – the level whose width matches k, or ‑1 if none exists.
ru: int – woh level jiski width k ke barabar ho, ya agar koi na mile to -1.

en: Iterate through the array to find the two largest numbers. Decrement each by 1 and then calculate their product.
ru: Do sabse bare numbers dhoondne ke liye array ke through iterate karta hai. Har ek ko 1 se decrement karta hai aur phir unka product calculate karta hai.

en: a ⟦0⟧ containing the text to expand.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ jismein expand karne wala text hota hai.

en: Scan the array while maintaining a map from each value to its most recent index. For each element, look up the index of the value that would precede ⟦0⟧ and, if found, update the DP length for the current position. Finally, return the maximum DP value.
ru: Array ko scan karta hai har value ka uske most recent index se ek map maintain karte hue. Har element ke liye, us value ka index dekhta hai jo ⟦0⟧ se pehle aata hoga aur, agar mile, current position ke liye DP length update kar deta hai. Akhir mein, maximum DP value return kar deta hai.

en: To construct a combinatorial hexahedron by linking various dart descriptors through involution operations.
ru: Involution operations ke zariye mukhtalif dart descriptors ko link karke ek combinatorial hexahedron construct karne ke liye.

en: Uses the Extended Euclidean Algorithm to compute the GCD of 'x' and 'n' and finds 't' such that 'x*t ≡ 1 (mod n)'.
ru: Extended Euclidean Algorithm use karke x aur n ka GCD calculate karta hai aur t find karta hai jahan x*t ≡ 1 (mod n) ho.

en: Checks if the input value is outside the valid range. If so, it adjusts the value by subtracting or adding the upper limit as necessary. If the adjusted value still falls outside the range, it wraps it back within the range. If the input is already within the range, it returns the value unchanged. If the loop flag is not set and the input is out of bounds, it marks the loop as done and returns the boundary value.
ru: Check karta hai ke input value valid range se bahar hai ya nahi. Agar ho, zaroorat ke mutabiq upper limit subtract ya add karke value adjust karta hai. Agar adjusted value phir bhi range se bahar ho, use range ke andar wapas wrap kar deta hai. Agar input pehle se range ke andar ho, value bina change kiye return kar deta hai. Agar loop flag set na ho aur input bounds se bahar ho, loop ko done mark karta hai aur boundary value return karta hai.

en: Sort the vector so identical values become consecutive. Then iterate over the sorted data in steps of two, comparing each element with its predecessor; any mismatch means a valid pairing is impossible. If all adjacent pairs match, return true.
ru: Vector ko sort karta hai taake same values aik doosre ke sath consecutive ho jayein. Phir sorted data mein do ke steps se iterate karta hai aur har element ko uske previous element ke sath compare karta hai. Agar koi mismatch mile to valid pairing possible nahi hoti. Agar tamam adjacent pairs match karein to true return karta hai.

en: Writes the formatted line to ⟦0⟧; no return value.
ru: Formatted line ko ⟦0⟧ mein likhta hai; koi return value nahi.

en: Compute the maximum possible sum of up to ⟦0⟧ values while using each label at most ⟦1⟧ times.
ru: ⟦0⟧ values tak ka maximum possible sum calculate karta hai, jahan har label ko zyada se zyada ⟦1⟧ dafa use kiya ja sakta hai.

en: Determines whether every character in the string matches the character two positions ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke string mein har character do positions ⟦0⟧ wale character se match karta hai ya nahi.

en: The graph is colored bipartitely using BFS from vertex 0, assigning alternating 0/1 labels. Because any bipartite graph’s shortest path parity equals the parity of the endpoint colors, the query checks whether the two vertices share the same color. If the graph is disconnected, uncolored vertices stay -1, leading to undefined parity.
ru: Graph ko BFS ke zariye vertex 0 se bipartite colors mein color karta hai aur 0/1 labels alternate assign karta hai. Bipartite graph mein shortest path ki parity endpoints ke colors ki parity ke barabar hoti hai, is liye query check karti hai ke dono vertices ka color same hai ya nahi. Agar graph disconnected ho to uncolored vertices -1 rehte hain, jis se parity undefined ho jati hai.

en: Build a mask by left‑shifting 1 by i positions and negating it, then AND the mask with n. This zeroes the targeted bit while preserving the rest.
ru: 1 ko i positions se left-shift karke aur use negate karke ek mask build karta hai, phir mask ko n se AND karta hai. Ye baaki ko preserve karte hue targeted bit ko zero kar deta hai.

en: Digits are extracted from right to left and stored in two stacks separating even and odd digits. The stacks are then merged by repeatedly taking the smaller top digit, ensuring the smallest lexicographic order, and finally appending any remaining digits from either stack.
ru: Digits right se left extract kiye jate hain aur even aur odd digits ko separate karne wale do stacks mein store kiye jate hain. Stacks ko phir baar baar chota top digit lekar merge kiya jata hai, sabse chota lexicographic order ensure karte hue, aur akhir mein kisi bhi stack se koi bhi remaining digits append kiye jate hain.

en: The function initializes pointers for the input and output arrays. It then iterates through the wavetable, summing each pair of consecutive elements and storing the result in the next position of the signal array.
ru: Ye function input aur output arrays ke liye pointers initialize karta hai. Phir ye wavetable ke through iterate karta hai, har consecutive elements ke pair ka sum karke result ko signal array ki next position mein store karte hue.

en: Build column‑wise prefix sums to obtain ⟦0⟧ sum queries for any vertical strip. For each pair of ⟦1⟧ treat the strip as a 1‑D array of column sums and use a hashmap to count subarrays with sum = target, accumulating the total count.
ru: Kisi bhi vertical strip ke liye ⟦0⟧ sum queries hasil karne ke liye column-wise prefix sums build karta hai. ⟦1⟧ ke har pair ke liye strip ko column sums ki 1-D array ki tarah treat karta hai aur sum = target wale subarrays count karne ke liye hashmap istemal karta hai, total count accumulate karte hue.

en: Count total ‘1’s; if not divisible by 3 return 0. If there are no ‘1’s, the answer is “choose any two cut positions” combinatorial formula. Otherwise, while scanning the string, count positions where the cumulative ‘1’s equal one‑third and two‑thirds of the total; the product of these counts yields the total splits.
ru: Total ‘1’s ko count karta hai; agar yeh 3 se divisible na hon to 0 return karta hai. Agar koi ‘1’ na ho to “kisi bhi do cut positions choose karne” wala combinatorial formula use karta hai. Warna string ko scan karte hue un positions ko count karta hai jahan cumulative ‘1’s total ke one-third aur two-thirds ke barabar hon. In dono counts ka product total valid splits deta hai.

en: Uses a switch statement to compare the character against the two accepted separators; returns true for matches and false for all other values.
ru: Character ko do accepted separators ke khilaf compare karne ke liye ek switch statement istemal karta hai; matches ke liye true aur baaki sab values ke liye false return karta hai.

en: An int indicating the minimal swaps; 0 if already balanced.
ru: Ek int jo minimal swaps indicate karta hai; 0 agar pehle se balanced ho.

en: To conditionally add or remove a key from a set within a given structure.
ru: Ek diye gaye structure ke andar set se conditionally ek key add ya remove karne ke liye.

en: Uses recursion to find the root and applies path compression to flatten the structure, optimizing future operations.
ru: Root find karne ke liye recursion istemal karta hai aur structure ko flatten karne ke liye path compression apply karta hai, future operations ko optimize karte hue.

en: Determines whether n can be reached from m by adding a fixed step ⟦0⟧ repeatedly.
ru: Check karta hai ke n ko m se fixed step ⟦0⟧ ko repeatedly add karke hasil kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi.

en: Traverse the list while storing each element in an ⟦0⟧. For each node, check if it divides the target and whether the complementary factor is already in the set; if so, report and return true. If the traversal finishes without a match, return false.
ru: List ko traverse karta hai har element ko ek ⟦0⟧ mein store karte hue. Har node ke liye, check karta hai ke ye target ko divide karta hai aur kya complementary factor pehle se set mein hai; agar ho, report karke true return karta hai. Agar traversal bina match ke khatam ho jaye, false return karta hai.

en: int – the largest distance j‑i that forms a valid ramp, or 0 if none exists.
ru: int – sab se bara distance j-i jo valid ramp banata ho, ya agar koi valid ramp na ho to 0.

en: An integer representing the data value of the intersection node, or 0 if there is no intersection.
ru: Ek integer jo intersection node ki data value ko represent karta hai, ya 0 agar koi intersection na ho.

en: Integer count of possible ⟦0⟧.
ru: Possible ⟦0⟧ ki integer count.

en: Iterate through both strings simultaneously. If characters match, move to the next character in ⟦0⟧. Regardless, always move to the next character in ⟦1⟧. If at the end, all characters of ⟦0⟧ have been matched, return true; otherwise, return false.
ru: Dono strings par simultaneously iterate karta hai. Agar characters match karein, ⟦0⟧ ke agle character par move karta hai. Kaisi bhi surat mein, hamesha ⟦1⟧ ke agle character par move karta hai. Agar end mein, ⟦0⟧ ke sab characters match ho chuke hon, true return karta hai; warna, false return karta hai.

en: Checks if the handle is null; if not, converts the edge to a string; otherwise, returns a specific null handle string.
ru: Check karta hai ke handle null hai ya nahi; agar nahi, edge ko string mein convert karta hai; warna, ek specific null handle string return karta hai.

en: Constructs a bitmask with ones from l to r using shift and XOR, ANDs it with n, and checks if the result is zero.
ru: Shift aur XOR istemal karke l se r tak ones wala ek bitmask construct karta hai, use n ke sath AND karta hai, aur check karta hai ke result zero hai ya nahi.

en: Determines whether a null‑terminated C‑string consists solely of decimal digit characters.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek null-terminated C-string sirf decimal digit characters se bana hai ya nahi.

en: Compute the time needed for a signal sent from node k to reach all n nodes in a directed, weighted graph.
ru: Node k se bheja gaya signal ek directed, weighted graph mein sab n nodes tak pahunchne ke liye zaroori time compute karta hai.

en: Iterate with an increasing gift size starting at 1, assigning each gift to the next person in a round‑robin fashion; each step gives the lesser of the intended gift size and the remaining candies, updates the recipient’s total, and subtracts the gifted amount until no candies remain.
ru: 1 se shuru hone wale ek increasing gift size ke sath iterate karta hai, har gift ko ek round-robin fashion mein agle person ko assign karte hue; har step intended gift size aur remaining candies mein se chota deta hai, recipient ka total update karta hai, aur koi candies na bachne tak gifted amount subtract karta hai.

en: The function creates a ⟦0⟧ with ⟦1⟧, clears its ⟦2⟧ flag, zero‑initialises the 26 child pointers, assigns a placeholder character, and returns the pointer.
ru: Ye function ⟦1⟧ ke sath ek ⟦0⟧ create karta hai, iski ⟦2⟧ flag clear karta hai, 26 child pointers ko zero-initialise karta hai, ek placeholder character assign karta hai, aur pointer return kar deta hai.

en: First checks if both objects are ⟦0⟧ and returns true in that case. If not, it performs a member‑wise comparison of all significant fields, including the vector of outputs, relying on their own equality operators.
ru: Pehle check karta hai ke dono objects ⟦0⟧ hain, us case mein true return karta hai. Agar nahi, sab significant fields ka ek member-wise comparison perform karta hai, outputs ke vector samet, unke apne equality operators par relying karte hue.

en: The function iterates through each column starting from the most significant bit. It counts how many rows match the first row's value in each column. The score is then updated by adding the maximum of the count of 1s and 0s for each column multiplied by its respective power of 2.
ru: Ye function most significant bit se shuru hone wale har column par iterate karta hai. Ye count karta hai ke har column mein kitni rows first row ki value se match karti hain. Phir score ko har column ke 1s aur 0s ke count mein se maximum ko uski respective power of 2 se multiply karke add kiya jata hai.

en: Translate a TIM peripheral base address to its 1‑based timer identifier.
ru: Ek TIM peripheral base address ko uske 1-based timer identifier mein translate karta hai.

en: Checks whether auxiliary data is continuous across an edge’s two incident vertices.
ru: Check karta hai ke ek edge ke do incident vertices ke darmiyan auxiliary data continuous hai ya nahi.

en: int – the corresponding decimal ⟦0⟧.
ru: int – corresponding decimal ⟦0⟧.

en: Provides a globally shared high‑precision constant value.
ru: Ek globally shared high-precision constant value faraham karta hai.

en: Computes the total sum of series contributions for each element in an array over a ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ ke over array ke har element ke liye series contributions ka total sum compute karta hai.

en: Determines whether a Unicode code point is a combining character.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek Unicode code point ek combining character hai ya nahi.

en: Create a temporary Type initialized with the two values, call its ⟦0⟧ method to simplify the ⟦1⟧, then return the normalized object.
ru: Do values se initialize kiya gaya ek temporary Type banata hai, ⟦1⟧ ko simplify karne ke liye uska ⟦0⟧ method call karta hai, phir normalized object return kar deta hai.

en: Uses the Sieve of Eratosthenes to mark primes up to n, then iterates through each prime, computes its digit reversal, and if the reversal is a different prime within the range, prints the pair and marks the reversed number to avoid duplication.
ru: n tak primes mark karne ke liye Sieve of Eratosthenes istemal karta hai, phir har prime par iterate karta hai, uska digit reversal compute karta hai, aur agar reversal range ke andar ek alag prime ho, pair print karta hai aur duplication se bachne ke liye reversed number ko mark kar deta hai.

en: Determine whether tree B appears as a subtree of tree A.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke tree B, tree A ke subtree ke tor par mojood hai ya nahi.

en: Computes a recursively defined value based on 2‑D coordinates and a scaling factor.
ru: 2-D coordinates aur ek scaling factor ke hisab se ek recursively defined value compute karta hai.

en: Two indices start at the beginning and end of the string, moving inward. Non‑alphanumeric characters are skipped. The remaining characters are compared case‑insensitively; any mismatch aborts with false. If the indices cross without mismatches, the function returns true.
ru: Do indices string ke start aur end se start hote hain aur andar ki taraf move karte hain. Non-alphanumeric characters ko skip kiya jata hai. Baqi characters ko case-insensitively compare kiya jata hai; agar koi mismatch mile to foran false return hota hai. Agar indices bina kisi mismatch ke cross kar jayein to function true return karta hai.

en: T& x – reference to the value to be clamped; T min – lower bound; T max – upper bound.
ru: T& x – clamp ki jane wali value ka reference; T min – lower bound; T max – upper bound.

en: ⟦0⟧ – binary string prefixed by “0.”, or the literal “ERROR” if more than 7 bits are required.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – "0." se prefixed binary string, ya literal "ERROR" agar 7 se zyada bits zaroori hon.

en: Return false immediately for odd len. Count frequencies of each lowercase letter in the first len characters, then scan the frequency table for a count equal to len/2. If found, return true; otherwise false.
ru: Odd len ke liye turant false return kar deta hai. Pehle len characters mein har lowercase letter ki frequency count karta hai, phir frequency table mein len/2 ke barabar koi count scan karta hai. Agar mil jaye, true return karta hai; warna false.

en: const char* ⟦0⟧ – a null‑terminated character array containing the text to split.
ru: const char* ⟦0⟧ – ek null-terminated character array jismein split karne wala text hota hai.

en: Defines eight points forming a box with missing corners. Iterates over these points, drawing line segments between consecutive points using the ⟦0⟧ function.
ru: Aath points define karta hai jo missing corners wala ek box banate hain. In points par iterate karta hai, ⟦0⟧ function istemal karke consecutive points ke darmiyan line segments draw karte hue.

en: Two floats l and b representing the rectangle's side lengths.
ru: Do floats l aur b jo rectangle ki side lengths represent karte hain.

en: Recursively split the current preorder segment at the index of the next greater element, creating a node for the first element, then building left and right subtrees from the left and right partitions respectively. Base cases handle empty and single‑element segments.
ru: Current preorder segment ko agle greater element ke index par recursively split karta hai, pehle element ke liye ek node banate hue, phir left aur right partitions se left aur right subtrees banate hue. Base cases empty aur single-element segments ko handle karte hain.

en: Counts the maximum number of contiguous binary ⟦0⟧ whose integer values are non‑zero and divisible by K, or reports impossibility.
ru: Contiguous binary ⟦0⟧ ki maximum number count karta hai jinki integer values non-zero aur K se divisible hoti hain, ya phir agar possible na ho to impossibility report karta hai.

en: Atomically increments the integer pointed to by ⟦0⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ se pointed integer ko atomically increment karta hai.

en: Finds two integers whose sum equals N and satisfy a linear relation with A and B.
ru: Do integers dhoondta hai jinka sum N ke barabar ho aur jo A aur B ke sath ek linear relation satisfy karein.

en: An int representing the total moves required.
ru: Ek int jo total zaroori moves represent karta hai.

en: Iterate through the string tracking the previous character. When a ‘1’ is followed by a ‘0’, skip all successive ‘0’s; if the next character after the zero run is a ‘1’, increment the counter. Continue until the end of the string.
ru: Previous character track karte hue string ke through iterate karta hai. Jab '1' ke baad '0' aaye, sab successive '0's ko skip kar deta hai; agar zero run ke baad wala character '1' ho, counter increment kar deta hai. String ke end tak continue karta hai.

en: Uses bitwise operations to generate each subset by iterating through all possible masks from 0 to 2^n - 1. For each mask, it checks which bits are set and includes the corresponding elements from ⟦0⟧ in the current subset.
ru: 0 se 2^n - 1 tak sab possible masks par iterate karke har subset generate karne ke liye bitwise operations istemal karta hai. Har mask ke liye, ye check karta hai ke konsi bits set hain aur ⟦0⟧ se corresponding elements ko current subset mein shamil karta hai.
