en: The function uses the ⟦0⟧ algorithm to find the first occurrence of 1 and 0 in the vector. It then calculates the counts of elements greater than or equal to 1 and elements less than or equal to 0, and returns the maximum of these two counts.
ru: Ye function vector mein 1 aur 0 ka pehla occurrence dhoondne ke liye ⟦0⟧ algorithm istemal karta hai. Phir ye 1 se zyada ya barabar wale elements aur 0 se kam ya barabar wale elements ke counts calculate karta hai, aur in dono counts mein se maximum return karta hai.

en: Walk the string with an index starting at 1 while tracking the length of the current character run. When the run ends or the end of the string is reached, append the run length and character to the result and reset the counter. Handles empty strings gracefully.
ru: String ko 1 se shuru hone wale index ke sath chalta hai, current character run ki length track karte hue. Jab run khatam ho ya string ka end aa jaye, run length aur character ko result mein append karta hai aur counter reset kar deta hai. Empty strings ko gracefully handle karta hai.

en: const vector& nums – the array to search; int index – position whose preceding different element is sought.
ru: const vector& nums – search karne wala array; int index – wo position jiska preceding different element dhoonda ja raha hai.

en: The code builds a mask that has all bits set to 1 from the most‑significant set bit down to the least‑significant bit by repeatedly OR‑ing shifted versions of n. XOR‑ing the original value with this mask leaves 1s exactly where n had 0s, and ⟦0⟧ tallies those bits.
ru: Code ek mask banata hai jismein most-significant set bit se least-significant bit tak sab bits 1 set hoti hain, n ke shifted versions ko baar baar OR karke. Is mask ko original value ke sath XOR karne se wahin 1s bachti hain jahan n mein 0s thay, aur ⟦0⟧ un bits ko count karta hai.

en: Scan the string left‑to‑right, pushing the index of each '[' onto a stack. When a ']' is encountered and the stack isn’t empty, pop the matching '[' index, compute the inner substring length, extract it, and output it. Unmatched delimiters are silently ignored.
ru: String ko left-to-right scan karta hai, har '[' ka index ek stack par push karte hue. Jab ']' mile aur stack empty na ho, matching '[' ka index pop karta hai, inner substring ki length compute karta hai, use extract karta hai, aur output kar deta hai. Unmatched delimiters ko silently ignore kar diya jata hai.

en: Initializes a new ⟦0⟧ object and sets its members to the input parameters before returning it.
ru: Ek naya ⟦0⟧ object initialize karta hai aur return karne se pehle iske members ko input parameters set kar deta hai.

en: Node* node – pointer to the root of the ⟦0⟧.
ru: Node* node – ⟦0⟧ ke root ka pointer.

en: Multiply 'a' and 'b'. If 'b' is negative, return 0; otherwise, return the product.
ru: ‘a’ aur ‘b’ ko multiply karta hai. Agar ‘b’ negative ho, to 0 return karta hai; warna product return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the minimal total operation count.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – minimal total operation count.

en: Copies a range while inserting a formatting range at the start of the last N elements.
ru: Ek range ko copy karta hai sath hi last N elements ke start par ek formatting range insert karte hue.

en: Build a map that assigns a unique integer index to every distinct string appearing in the input pairs.
ru: Ek map build karta hai jo input pairs mein appear hone wali har distinct string ko ek unique integer index assign karta hai.

en: A depth‑first search computes each subtree’s sum and records frequencies in a map. The map is then scanned to find the maximum frequency, and all sums with that frequency are collected into the result vector.
ru: Ek depth-first search har subtree ka sum compute karta hai aur frequencies ko ek map mein record karta hai. Map ko phir maximum frequency dhoondne ke liye scan kiya jata hai, aur us frequency wale sab sums ko result vector mein collect kiya jata hai.

en: Populate an ⟦0⟧ with the eight vertices of an infinite ⟦1⟧ centered at the origin.
ru: Origin par centered ek infinite ⟦1⟧ ke aath vertices ke sath ek ⟦0⟧ populate karta hai.

en: Counts how many prime numbers are less than a given integer n.
ru: Ye count karta hai ke diye gaye integer n se kam kitne prime numbers hain.

en: Compare b with the interval’s right endpoint; if b is larger, return true. Otherwise compare with the left endpoint; if b is smaller, return false. If neither test succeeds, the interval spans b and the result is indeterminate.
ru: b ko interval ke right endpoint ke sath compare karta hai; agar b bara ho to true return karta hai. Warna left endpoint ke sath compare karta hai; agar b chota ho to false return karta hai. Agar dono mein se koi test successful na ho to interval b ko cover karta hai aur result indeterminate hota hai.

en: Computes a one‑at‑a‑time hash of an array of int32 values using Thomas Wang’s integer hash as the mixing step.
ru: Thomas Wang ke integer hash ko mixing step ki tarah istemal karke int32 values ke ek array ka one-at-a-time hash compute karta hai.

en: While the low index does not surpass the high index, scan the current window to find the minimum and maximum values and their positions. Swap the minimum into the low slot and the maximum into the high ⟦0⟧. Then shrink the window from both sides and repeat.
ru: Jab tak low index, high index se aage na jaye, current window ko scan karke minimum aur maximum values aur unki positions dhoondta hai. Minimum ko low slot mein aur maximum ko high ⟦0⟧ mein swap karta hai. Phir window ko dono sides se shrink karta hai aur repeat karta hai.

en: To perform a depth-first search on a graph to compute the XOR value of each subtree rooted at each node.
ru: Graph par depth-first search (DFS) perform karta hai taake har node se rooted subtree ki XOR value calculate ki ja sake.

en: int m – number of digits; int n – divisor.
ru: int m – digits ki tadaad; int n – divisor.

en: Compute, for each element, the sum of absolute differences to all other ⟦0⟧.
ru: Har element ke liye, baaki sab ⟦0⟧ ke sath absolute differences ka sum compute karta hai.

en: Compute a k‑th discrete root of a modulo prime p (solve x^k ≡ ⟦0⟧).
ru: Modulo prime p ka ek k-th discrete root compute karta hai (x^k ≡ ⟦0⟧ solve karta hai).

en: This function calculates the total number of flower beds in a grid where each row alternates between having an odd and even number of beds.
ru: Ye function ek grid mein flower beds ki total tadaad calculate karta hai jahan har row odd aur even beds ki tadaad ke darmiyan alternate karti hai.

en: Dynamic programming table to store the minimum coins needed for each sub-amount up to the target amount.
ru: Target amount tak har sub-amount ke liye zaroori minimum coins store karne ke liye ek dynamic programming table.

en: First, record the indices of each character in separate buckets. Then, for each character, sum the ⟦0⟧ between consecutive indices, which equals the swaps needed to bring those characters together.
ru: Sab se pehle har character ke indices ko separate buckets mein store karta hai. Phir har character ke liye consecutive indices ke darmiyan ⟦0⟧ ko sum karta hai, jo un characters ko aik sath lane ke liye required swaps ke barabar hota hai.

en: This function calculates the area of a triangle in 3D space given its vertices.
ru: Ye function 3D space mein ek triangle ka area calculate karta hai uske vertices diye jane par.

en: Compute b - a using the existing ⟦0⟧‑double subtraction, then negate the internal representation to reverse the order, yielding the desired a - b.
ru: Existing ⟦0⟧-double subtraction istemal karke b - a compute karta hai, phir order reverse karne ke liye internal representation ko negate karta hai, desired a - b dete hue.

en: Compute a prefix‑sum array so that any sub‑array sum can be obtained in ⟦0⟧. Then iterate over each index, comparing the left ⟦1⟧ with the right ⟦2⟧. Return the first matching index or -1.
ru: Ek prefix-sum array compute karta hai taake koi bhi sub-array sum ⟦0⟧ mein hasil ho sake. Phir har index par iterate karta hai, left ⟦1⟧ ko right ⟦2⟧ se compare karte hue. Pehla matching index ya -1 return karta hai.

en: This function adds an event to the list of split events associated with a specific vertex in a graph structure.
ru: Yeh function graph structure mein kisi specific vertex se associated split events ki list mein aik event add karta hai.

en: Compute the maximum ⟦0⟧ as a double, compare f to that threshold, and return either the max ⟦1⟧ or the truncated cast of f.
ru: Maximum ⟦0⟧ ko ek double ki tarah compute karta hai, f ko us threshold se compare karta hai, aur ya toh max ⟦1⟧ ya f ki truncated cast return karta hai.

en: To divide an array into subarrays of size at most 3, ensuring that each subarray's elements differ by no more than k.
ru: Ek array ko zyada se zyada size 3 wale subarrays mein divide karne ke liye, ye ensure karte hue ke har subarray ke elements ka farq k se zyada na ho.

en: Finds the first index of an element in a sorted vector that is ≥ target.
ru: Ek sorted vector mein us pehle element ka index dhoondta hai jo target se ≥ ho.

en: Uses depth‑first recursion with memoization. Base cases handle empty or impossible states. It first tries a minimal “gap” configuration, then iterates over admissible group ⟦0⟧ that respect the ⟦1⟧ limit, accumulating results from sub‑problems. Results are cached in dp to achieve ⟦2⟧ time.
ru: Memoization ke sath depth-first recursion istemal karta hai. Base cases empty ya impossible states handle karte hain. Ye pehle ek minimal "gap" configuration try karta hai, phir admissible group ⟦0⟧ par iterate karta hai jo ⟦1⟧ limit respect karte hon, sub-problems se results accumulate karte hue. Results ⟦2⟧ time hasil karne ke liye dp mein cache kiye jate hain.

en: Find the missing integer in the ⟦0⟧ given a vector containing n distinct numbers from that range.
ru: Us range se n distinct numbers wale ek vector diye jane par ⟦0⟧ mein missing integer dhoondta hai.

en: Prints a vertex identifier prefixed by a character indicating its time status.
ru: Ek vertex identifier print karta hai jiske aage ek character laga hota hai jo uski time status batata hai.

en: Compute factorials of all integers from 0 up to a given bound, each taken modulo mod.
ru: 0 se ek di gayi bound tak sab integers ke factorials compute karta hai, har ek modulo mod leta hue.

en: Calculates the area of the bounding box containing all cells with value 1 in a 2D grid.
ru: Ek 2D grid mein value 1 wale sab cells ko shamil karne wale bounding box ka area calculate karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a vector containing each element whose frequency exceeds n/3 (order undefined).
ru: ⟦0⟧ – aik vector jismein har woh element hota hai jiski frequency n/3 se zyada ho, order undefined hai.

en: Convert degree inputs to radians, evaluate the haversine expression a = ⟦0⟧+cosφ₁·cosφ₂·⟦1⟧, compute the angular distance c = 2·⟦2⟧, and multiply by the Earth's radius to obtain the linear distance.
ru: Degree inputs ko radians mein convert karta hai, haversine expression a = ⟦0⟧+cosφ₁·cosφ₂·⟦1⟧ evaluate karta hai, angular distance c = 2·⟦2⟧ compute karta hai, aur linear distance hasil karne ke liye Earth ke radius se multiply kar deta hai.

en: Serializes an object to an OpenCV file storage.
ru: Object ko OpenCV file storage mein serialize karta hai.

en: Checks if the type is EDGE; if not, throws an error. Uses conditional compilation to decide how to access the Edge value stored in the object.
ru: Check karta hai ke type EDGE hai ya nahi; agar nahi ho to error throw karta hai. Conditional compilation ka use karke yeh decide karta hai ke object mein stored Edge value ko kis tarah access karna hai.

en: Computes the probability of reaching a target vertex in exactly t steps on an undirected graph when each step moves uniformly to a non‑parent neighbour.
ru: Ek undirected graph par exactly t steps mein ek target vertex tak pahunchne ki probability compute karta hai jab har step uniformly ek non-parent neighbour ki taraf move kare.

en: Constructs a MatrixGame with a fixed game type, supplies identical action labels for both players, and initializes the payoff matrices with hard‑coded values representing the classic dilemma. The constructed object is wrapped in a ⟦0⟧ for managed lifetime.
ru: Ek fixed game type ke sath MatrixGame construct karta hai, dono players ke liye identical action labels supply karta hai, aur payoff matrices ko hard-coded values se initialize karta hai jo classic dilemma represent karti hain. Managed lifetime ke liye constructed object ko ek ⟦0⟧ mein wrap kiya jata hai.

en: Double‑loop over all unordered ⟦0⟧, calculate their GCD with ⟦1⟧, and keep the largest result in ⟦2⟧. The outer loop runs from 1 to n‑1, the inner loop from i+1 to n, yielding ⟦3⟧ time.
ru: Tamam unordered ⟦0⟧ paron par double-loop karta hai, unka GCD ⟦1⟧ ke sath calculate karta hai aur sab se bara result ⟦2⟧ mein store karta hai. Outer loop 1 se n-1 tak aur inner loop i+1 se n tak chalta hai, jis se ⟦3⟧ time complexity hoti hai.

en: Compute a specific XOR‑related value for certain integer inputs.
ru: Kuch integer inputs ke liye ek specific XOR-related value compute karta hai.

en: Call ⟦0⟧ to obtain a base value, shift left by 23 bits, XOR with another ⟦0⟧ result, shift left again, and XOR with a third ⟦0⟧. The shifts create space for each new chunk, and XOR mixes the bits, yielding a 64‑bit value.
ru: Ek base value hasil karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ call karta hai, 23 bits left shift karta hai, doosre ⟦0⟧ result se XOR karta hai, phir se left shift karta hai, aur teesre ⟦0⟧ se XOR karta hai. Shifts har naye chunk ke liye jagah banati hain, aur XOR bits ko mix karta hai, ek 64-bit value dete hue.

en: An int representing the maximum length of a substring of s with all unique characters.
ru: Ek int jo s ki us substring ki maximum length represent karta hai jismein sab unique characters hon.

en: Uses a 32‑bit integer as a bitmask, mapping each character to a bit ⟦0⟧. While scanning, it checks if the bit is already set; if so, it returns false immediately, otherwise it sets the bit. After processing all characters, it returns true.
ru: 32-bit integer ko bitmask ke tor par use karta hai, jahan har character ko aik bit ⟦0⟧ se map karta hai. Scan karte waqt check karta hai ke bit pehle se set hai ya nahi. Agar set ho to foran false return karta hai, warna bit ko set kar deta hai. Tamam characters process karne ke baad true return karta hai.

en: Asserts the validity of the iterator and returns the ⟦0⟧ member of the iterator's pointed-to element.
ru: Iterator ki validity assert karta hai aur iterator ke pointed-to element ka ⟦0⟧ member return karta hai.

en: Uses dynamic programming; ⟦0⟧ stores the result for length i, with base cases for 0, 1, 2 and recurrence ⟦0⟧=⟦1⟧+⟦2⟧ for i≥3. The final answer is ⟦3⟧.
ru: Dynamic programming use karta hai; ⟦0⟧ mein length i ka result store hota hai, jismein 0, 1 aur 2 ke base cases hote hain aur i ≥ 3 ke liye recurrence ⟦0⟧ = ⟦1⟧ + ⟦2⟧ use hoti hai. Final answer ⟦3⟧ hota hai.

en: Checks for the error condition, then applies the formula R = ((h·r·√2) / (h + √2·r)) / 2, which stems from simplifying the geometry of a sphere segment.
ru: Error condition ke liye check karta hai, phir formula R = ((h·r·√2) / (h + √2·r)) / 2 apply karta hai, jo ek sphere segment ki geometry ko simplify karne se aati hai.

en: Outputs the elapsed time of the StopWatch object in milliseconds to the provided output stream.
ru: StopWatch object ka elapsed time milliseconds mein diye gaye output stream par output karta hai.

en: A 2‑D DP table ⟦0⟧[i] stores the longest subsequence ending at index i with sum remainder mod. Iterate over all pairs (j,i) (j < i), compute the new remainder, and update dp and the global maximum. The result is the largest entry in the DP table.
ru: Ek 2-D DP table ⟦0⟧[i] index i par khatam hone wali sabse lambi subsequence store karta hai jiska sum remainder mod ho. Sab pairs (j,i) (j < i) par iterate karta hai, naya remainder compute karta hai, aur dp aur global maximum update karta hai. Result DP table ki sabse bari entry hoti hai.

en: Generates a specific sequence of numbers and a final computed value when N is divisible by 4, otherwise signals failure.
ru: Jab N 4 se divisible ho toh numbers ki ek specific sequence aur ek final computed value generate karta hai, warna failure signal karta hai.

en: Count chips on even and odd positions; moving chips within the same parity costs 0, so only chips of the minority parity need to be moved, costing one per chip. Return the smaller of the two counts.
ru: Even aur odd positions par chips count karta hai; same parity ke andar chips move karna 0 cost karta hai, isliye sirf minority parity ke chips move karne zaroori hain, har chip ek cost karte hue. In dono counts mein se chota wala return karta hai.

en: An iterator range [begin, end) and a handle h.
ru: Ek iterator range [begin, end) aur ek handle h.

en: Scan the string, counting each contiguous sequence of '0's as a removal. Track whether any '1' appears. After the scan, if no '1' was found, return 1. If the string begins and ends with '0', the first and last zero blocks merge, so decrement the count by one.
ru: String ko scan karta hai, '0's ki har contiguous sequence ko ek removal ke tor par count karte hue. Track karta hai ke koi '1' appear hota hai ya nahi. Scan ke baad, agar koi '1' na mila ho, 1 return karta hai. Agar string '0' se shuru aur khatam hoti ho, pehla aur akhri zero blocks merge ho jate hain, isliye count mein se ek kam kar deta hai.

en: Dynamic programming fills an array dp where ⟦0⟧ is the optimal step count for i. For each i from 0 to N, the code iterates over its decimal digits, updating ⟦0⟧ with the best value achievable by subtracting any ⟦1⟧. The final answer is ⟦2⟧.
ru: Dynamic programming ek array dp fill karta hai jahan ⟦0⟧ i ke liye optimal step count hota hai. 0 se N tak har i ke liye, code uske decimal digits par iterate karta hai, kisi bhi ⟦1⟧ subtract karke hasil hone wali best value se ⟦0⟧ update karte hue. Final answer ⟦2⟧ hota hai.

en: Iterate over every feasible count of the first ⟦0⟧. For each, compute the remaining budget and determine how many second‑item ⟦1⟧ fit, adding that quantity to the result. The loop runs total / cost1 + 1 times, giving ⟦2⟧ time.
ru: Pehle ⟦0⟧ ke har feasible count par iterate karta hai. Har ek ke liye, remaining budget compute karta hai aur determine karta hai ke kitne second-item ⟦1⟧ fit hote hain, us quantity ko result mein add karte hue. Loop total / cost1 + 1 baar chalta hai, jisse ⟦2⟧ time milta hai.

en: A matrix of size ⟦0⟧ containing the same elements in row‑major order, or the original matrix if reshaping is impossible.
ru: Size ⟦0⟧ ka ek matrix jismein wahi elements row-major order mein hote hain, ya agar reshape karna possible na ho toh original matrix hi return ho jati hai.

en: For each offset within the word length, split s into word‑sized blocks. Using a sliding window with two pointers, maintain a frequency map of words seen and a count of fully satisfied words. When all words are satisfied, record the current start index. The window slides forward, shrinking when an excess or invalid word is encountered.
ru: Word length ke andar har offset ke liye, s ko word-sized blocks mein split karta hai. Do pointers wali ek sliding window istemal karke, dekhe gaye words ka ek frequency map aur fully satisfied words ka ek count maintain karta hai. Jab sab words satisfy ho jayein, current start index record karta hai. Window forward slide hoti hai, ek excess ya invalid word milne par shrink hote hue.

en: A non‑empty vector<int>& nums where each element represents the amount of money in a house.
ru: Ek non-empty vector<int>& nums jahan har element ek ghar mein rakhi hui rakam represent karta hai.

en: None. The function returns void.
ru: Kuch nahi. Function void return karta hai.

en: Triggers a breakpoint interrupt for debugging.
ru: Debugging ke liye ek breakpoint interrupt trigger karta hai.

en: Build a Disjoint Set ⟦0⟧ for ⟦1⟧ vertices. Iterate edges in order; for each edge ⟦2⟧, if ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ already belong to the same DSU set, that edge closes a cycle and is returned; otherwise union the two sets. The DSU operations run in near‑constant amortized time, giving overall O(n α(n)) complexity.
ru: ⟦1⟧ vertices ke liye ek Disjoint Set ⟦0⟧ build karta hai. Edges par order mein iterate karta hai; har edge ⟦2⟧ ke liye, agar ⟦3⟧ aur ⟦4⟧ pehle se same DSU set ke hon, wo edge ek cycle close karta hai aur return kar diya jata hai; warna dono sets union kar deta hai. DSU operations near-constant amortized time mein chalte hain, overall O(n α(n)) complexity dete hue.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a reference to a vector containing only 0s and 1s.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ek vector ka reference jismein sirf 0s aur 1s hote hain.

en: ⟦0⟧, multiplies by N*0.5 to get the average contribution of N trials, adds P, and writes the result to standard output.
ru: ⟦0⟧ compute karta hai, N trials ki average contribution hasil karne ke liye N*0.5 se multiply karta hai, P add karta hai, aur result ko standard output par likh deta hai.

en: A ⟦0⟧ containing the OR of every achievable subsequence sum.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ jismein har achievable subsequence sum ka OR hota hai.

en: Check whether p is a bundle; if so, build a ReceivedBundle wrapper and stream it, otherwise build a ReceivedMessage wrapper and stream it. In both cases a newline is appended, then the stream is returned.
ru: Check karta hai ke p ek bundle hai ya nahi; agar ho, ek ReceivedBundle wrapper build karke stream karta hai, warna ek ReceivedMessage wrapper build karke stream karta hai. Dono cases mein ek newline append hoti hai, phir stream return kiya jata hai.

en: Build per‑letter prefix counts to answer “does this letter appear outside a given segment?” in ⟦0⟧. Compress ⟦1⟧ into run ⟦2⟧ and their prefix ⟦3⟧. Initialise the answer with the longest original run, then ⟦4⟧ three‑run patterns where a single‑character run can be merged with equal outer runs, ⟦5⟧ each run individually to see if an external identical character can be appended. The best value found is returned.
ru: "Kya ye letter di gayi segment ke bahar appear hoti hai?" ka jawab ⟦0⟧ mein dene ke liye per-letter prefix counts build karta hai. ⟦1⟧ ko runs ⟦2⟧ aur unke prefix ⟦3⟧ mein compress karta hai. Answer ko longest original run se initialize karta hai, phir un three-run patterns ko ⟦4⟧ karta hai jahan ek single-character run ko equal outer runs ke sath merge kiya ja sake, aur har run ko individually ⟦5⟧ karta hai ye dekhne ke liye ke koi external identical character append ho sakta hai ya nahi. Best value mili hui return hoti hai.

en: Performs DFS from ⟦0⟧, marking vertices visited and storing their parents. When it encounters an already‑visited neighbor that isn’t the parent, it back‑tracks via ⟦1⟧ to assemble the cycle nodes, then aborts the recursion. If the search finishes without such a back‑edge, it returns ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ se DFS perform karta hai, vertices ko visited mark karta hai aur unke parents ko store karta hai. Jab yeh aise neighbor ko dekhta hai jo pehle se visited ho aur parent na ho, to ⟦1⟧ ke zariye back-track karke cycle ke nodes ko assemble karta hai aur phir recursion ko rok deta hai. Agar search aisi back-edge ke baghair complete ho jaye, to ⟦2⟧ return karta hai.

en: int – the maximum number of positions between two consecutive 1‑bits; 0 if fewer than two 1‑bits exist.
ru: int – do consecutive 1-bits ke darmiyan maximum positions ki tadaad; 0 agar do se kam 1-bits mojood hon.

en: Compute the reciprocal of each element, store them, sort the reciprocals, then check that the difference between successive elements is identical throughout the array.
ru: Har element ka reciprocal calculate karke unhein store karta hai, phir reciprocals ko sort karta hai. Uske baad check karta hai ke successive elements ke darmiyan difference poori array mein same hai ya nahi.

en: None; the function modifies the input ⟦0⟧ object in place.
ru: Koi nahi; function input ⟦0⟧ object ko place mein modify kar deta hai.

en: Starting with step size 1, repeatedly add the current step size to a running index i until i exceeds N. After each addition, record the larger of the current maximum and the step size, then increment the step size. The final recorded maximum is returned.
ru: Step size 1 se shuru karke, baar baar current step size ko ek running index i mein add karta hai jab tak i, N se zyada na ho jaye. Har addition ke baad, current maximum aur step size mein se bara wala record karta hai, phir step size increment kar deta hai. Final recorded maximum return kiya jata hai.

en: First, count all nodes in the tree. Then, recursively compute the size of each subtree; if any subtree size equals total‑size minus itself, a flag is set. The function returns the flag after the traversal.
ru: Pehle, tree ke sab nodes count karta hai. Phir, recursively har subtree ka size compute karta hai; agar kisi subtree ka size total-size minus khud ke barabar ho, ek flag set ho jati hai. Function traversal ke baad flag return karta hai.

en: If maxv is large enough to provide a strictly decreasing sequence of length n, apply the arithmetic‑series formula directly. Otherwise, sum the decreasing part from maxv down to 1 (using n1 = maxv terms) and add 1 for each remaining position.
ru: Agar maxv itna bara ho ke n length ki strictly decreasing sequence ban sake to arithmetic-series formula directly apply karta hai. Warna maxv se 1 tak decreasing part ka sum calculate karta hai, jismein n1 = maxv terms hoti hain, aur baqi har position ke liye 1 add karta hai.

en: Ensure the first operand is the shorter string, reverse both to start from the least‑significant digit, then perform digit‑wise addition with carry propagation. After processing all digits, any remaining carry is appended, and the result string is reversed to obtain the final sum.
ru: Ensure karta hai ke pehla operand chota string ho, dono ko least-significant digit se shuru karne ke liye reverse karta hai, phir carry propagation ke sath digit-wise addition perform karta hai. Sab digits process hone ke baad, koi bhi remaining carry append kiya jata hai, aur final sum hasil karne ke liye result string ko reverse kar diya jata hai.

en: The sieve marks non‑prime numbers up to n by eliminating multiples of each prime ≤ √n. Then ⟦0⟧ scans i from 0 to n‑1, checking if both i and n‑i are prime, and outputs the first such pair.
ru: Sieve √n se kam ya barabar har prime ke multiples eliminate karke n tak non-prime numbers mark karta hai. Phir ⟦0⟧ i ko 0 se n-1 tak scan karta hai, check karte hue ke dono i aur n-i prime hain ya nahi, aur pehla aisa pair output karta hai.

en: Determines whether string B is a rotation of string A.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke string B, string A ka rotation hai ya nahi.

en: To safely copy a specified number of characters from one string to another, ensuring that the destination string is properly null-terminated.
ru: Ek string se doosri string mein specified number of characters ko safely copy karne ke liye, aur yeh ensure karta hai ke destination string properly null-terminated ho.

en: Scan the string from right to left, counting encountered '1's. Each time a '0' is found, add the current count of '1's to the ⟦0⟧. Stop after counting k zeros; if fewer zeros exist, return -1.
ru: String ko right se left scan karta hai, mile hue '1's ko count karte hue. Jab bhi '0' mile, current count of '1's ko ⟦0⟧ mein add kar deta hai. k zeros count karne ke baad ruk jata hai; agar us se kam zeros hon, -1 return karta hai.

en: Returns a Facet object constructed from the current object's properties.
ru: Current object ki properties se ek Facet object construct karke return karta hai.

en: Returns true if every character in ⟦0⟧ appears exactly once; otherwise false.
ru: True return karta hai agar ⟦0⟧ ka har character exactly ek baar appear ho; warna false.

en: The function forwards the string to ⟦0⟧ with the “%i” format, letting the C library parse the integer and store it in a local variable, which is then returned. No validation or overflow handling is performed.
ru: Ye function string ko "%i" format ke sath ⟦0⟧ ko forward karta hai, C library ko integer parse karne aur use ek local variable mein store karne dete hue, jo phir return kiya jata hai. Koi validation ya overflow handling perform nahi ki jati.

en: Build an adjacency list and run a BFS from the ⟦0⟧ to determine the shortest distance to each node. For each node, calculate the time its last reply reaches the server based on its round‑trip distance and patience interval, tracking the maximum such time. Return one second after this maximum.
ru: Ek adjacency list build karta hai aur har node ka shortest distance determine karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ se ek BFS run karta hai. Har node ke liye, uski round-trip distance aur patience interval ke hisab se uska last reply server tak pahunchne ka time calculate karta hai, maximum aisa time track karte hue. Is maximum ke ek second baad return karta hai.

en: Depending on the platform, it uses either ⟦0⟧ for POSIX systems or ⟦1⟧ for ⟦2⟧ to fetch the current time.
ru: Platform ke hisab se, ye current time fetch karne ke liye POSIX systems ke liye ⟦0⟧ ya ⟦2⟧ ke liye ⟦1⟧ istemal karta hai.

en: Creates and returns a fresh trie node with all child links cleared.
ru: Ek naya trie node create karta hai aur return karta hai jismein sab child links cleared hon.

en: Repeatedly scan the unsorted prefix, swapping adjacent out‑of‑order pairs; after each outer iteration the largest remaining element is positioned at the end. The implementation performs n‑1 passes without early‑termination, yielding ⟦0⟧ time and ⟦1⟧ extra space.
ru: Unsorted prefix ko repeatedly scan karta hai aur adjacent out-of-order pairs ko swap karta hai. Har outer iteration ke baad sab se bara remaining element end par place ho jata hai. Implementation n-1 passes perform karti hai aur early termination use nahi karti, jis se ⟦0⟧ time complexity aur ⟦1⟧ extra space complexity hoti hai.

en: Compute the reciprocal of alpha once, then multiply each of the four components by this reciprocal to produce the result, avoiding multiple division operations.
ru: Alpha ka reciprocal aik dafa calculate karta hai, phir result hasil karne ke liye charon components ko is reciprocal se multiply karta hai, jis se multiple division operations se bach jata hai.

en: Convert n to a bit string, scan left‑to‑right counting lengths of '1' runs. When a zero separates runs, compare the just‑finished run with the previous one; if any run is shorter, abort early. After the scan, ensure the last run does not violate the non‑decreasing condition, then return the result.
ru: n ko ek bit string mein convert karta hai, '1' runs ki lengths count karte hue left-to-right scan karta hai. Jab ek zero runs ko separate kare, abhi khatam hone wale run ko pichle se compare karta hai; agar koi run chota ho, jaldi abort kar deta hai. Scan ke baad, ensure karta hai ke last run non-decreasing condition violate na kare, phir result return karta hai.

en: For each word, sort its characters to obtain a canonical key and insert the original word into a map keyed by that sorted string. Afterwards, iterate over the map and print all words in each bucket.
ru: Har word ke liye, ek canonical key hasil karne ke liye iske characters sort karta hai aur original word ko us sorted string se keyed ek map mein insert kar deta hai. Uske baad, map par iterate karta hai aur har bucket ke sab words print karta hai.

en: Uses DFS to traverse both grids simultaneously. Marks visited cells in ⟦0⟧. Returns false if any cell in ⟦0⟧ contains water where there is land in ⟦1⟧.
ru: Dono grids ko simultaneously traverse karne ke liye DFS istemal karta hai. ⟦0⟧ mein visited cells mark karta hai. Agar ⟦0⟧ ke kisi cell mein water ho jahan ⟦1⟧ mein land ho, false return karta hai.

en: Count rooks per row and per column, then for each count vector compute the cumulative surplus/deficit of rooks and sum the absolute balances, which equals the moves needed; the answer is the sum for rows and columns.
ru: Har row aur har column ke rooks count karta hai, phir har count vector ke liye rooks ka cumulative surplus/deficit compute karta hai aur absolute balances ka sum leta hai, jo zaroori moves ke barabar hota hai; answer rows aur columns ka sum hota hai.

en: Iterates through each number in the range, converts it to a string, checks if the number of digits is even, then compares the sum of the first half of the digits with the sum of the second half. If they match, the number is counted as symmetric.
ru: Range ke har number par iterate karta hai, use ek string mein convert karta hai, check karta hai ke digits ki tadaad even hai ya nahi, phir digits ke pehle half ke sum ko doosre half ke sum se compare karta hai. Agar wo match karein, number ko symmetric count kiya jata hai.

en: Prints a CGAL warning message when a given condition fails.
ru: Jab ek di gayi condition fail ho toh ek CGAL warning message print karta hai.

en: Allocate an empty string, invoke the existing overload that writes the hex data into this string, then return the filled string to the caller.
ru: Ek empty string allocate karta hai, existing overload invoke karta hai jo hex data ko is string mein likhta hai, phir filled string ko caller ko return kar deta hai.

en: The function brute recursively chooses the left element i for each pair, bounded by the previous left ⟦0⟧ and half of ⟦1⟧ to avoid symmetric duplicates. It checks that the right ⟦2⟧ does not exceed the previous right ⟦3⟧. On reaching the ⟦4⟧ the constructed array is printed and the program terminates.
ru: Function brute recursively har pair ke liye left element i choose karta hai, jo previous left ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke half tak limited hota hai taake symmetric duplicates se bacha ja sake. Yeh check karta hai ke right ⟦2⟧ previous right ⟦3⟧ se zyada na ho. ⟦4⟧ tak pohanchne par banaya gaya array print karta hai aur program terminate ho jata hai.

en: Seed a min‑heap with the sum of each of the first ⟦0⟧ elements of nums1 paired with ⟦1⟧. Repeatedly pop the smallest sum, record it, and push the next sum that uses the same nums1 element but the next element of nums2, until k sums are collected or no candidates remain.
ru: nums1 ke pehle ⟦0⟧ elements ke sum ko ⟦1⟧ ke sath pair karke ek min-heap seed karta hai. Baar baar sabse chota sum pop karta hai, use record karta hai, aur agla sum push karta hai jo wahi nums1 element lekin nums2 ka agla element istemal karta hai, jab tak k sums collect na ho jayein ya koi candidate na bache.

en: Record indices of each ⟦0⟧ in vectors. For each character and each possible left boundary ⟦1⟧, binary‑search the first occurrence at or after ⟦1⟧; if found, all substrings extending to the end that include this occurrence contribute ⟦2⟧ to the total. Accumulate these contributions to obtain the final sum.
ru: Har ⟦0⟧ ke indices ko vectors mein store karta hai. Har character aur har possible left boundary ⟦1⟧ ke liye binary search karke ⟦1⟧ par ya uske baad pehli occurrence find karta hai. Agar occurrence mil jaye to end tak extend hone wali tamam substrings jo is occurrence ko include karti hain, total mein ⟦2⟧ contribute karti hain. In contributions ko add karke final sum hasil karta hai.

en: Copy xs to result. While result begins with token, replace result with the suffix that starts after the token. Return the final result.
ru: xs ko result mein copy karta hai. Jab tak result, token se shuru ho, result ko us suffix se replace karta hai jo token ke baad shuru hoti hai. Final result return karta hai.

en: Sorts a singly-linked list using insertion sort.
ru: Insertion sort ko use karte hue singly-linked list ko sort karta hai.

en: The ⟦0⟧ is divided into n equal sub‑intervals of ⟦1⟧/n. For each sub‑interval, Simpson's ⟦2⟧*(⟦3⟧+4f((a+b)/2)+⟦4⟧) is applied and accumulated. The sum is returned as the integral approximation.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko n equal sub-intervals mein divide karta hai, jinki length ⟦1⟧/n hoti hai. Har sub-interval ke liye Simpson's ⟦2⟧*(⟦3⟧+4f((a+b)/2)+⟦4⟧) formula apply karta hai aur results ko add karta jata hai. Aakhir mein sum ko integral ki approximation ke tor par return karta hai.

en: An integer representing the length of the longest ramp.
ru: Aik integer jo longest ramp ki length ko represent karta hai.

en: Iterate over each character, map it to 1‑26, multiply by ⟦0⟧ (with ⟦1⟧), add to a running total modulo ⟦2⟧, and update the power for the next position. The final modulo ensures a non‑negative hash.
ru: Har character par iterate karta hai, use 1-26 par map karta hai, ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧ ke sath) se multiply karta hai, ek running total modulo ⟦2⟧ mein add karta hai, aur next position ke liye power update karta hai. Final modulo ek non-negative hash ensure karta hai.

en: Repeatedly test n for odd/⟦0⟧. If odd, compute 3*n+1; if even, halve n. Continue until n becomes 1, outputting each intermediate value.
ru: n ko baar baar odd/⟦0⟧ ke liye test karta hai. Agar odd ho, 3*n+1 compute karta hai; agar even ho, n ko halve kar deta hai. n ke 1 hone tak continue karta hai, har intermediate value output karte hue.

en: Separate nums into odd and even lists, sort each in descending order, and build prefix sums for ⟦0⟧ range sums. Iterate over all feasible even counts of odd ⟦1⟧, compute the needed even count, and keep the maximum sum using the prefix sums.
ru: nums ko odd aur even lists mein separate karta hai, har ek ko descending order mein sort karta hai, aur ⟦0⟧ range sums ke liye prefix sums build karta hai. Odd ⟦1⟧ ke sab feasible even counts par iterate karta hai, zaroori even count compute karta hai, aur prefix sums istemal karke maximum sum rakhta hai.

en: Perform a post‑order ⟦0⟧ that returns a pair containing the best loot when the node is taken and when it is skipped; then return the larger of the two values. An early check handles the empty‑tree edge case.
ru: Ek post-order ⟦0⟧ perform karta hai jo ek pair return karta hai jismein best loot hota hai jab node liya jaye aur jab skip kiya jaye; phir in dono values mein se bara wala return karta hai. Ek early check empty-tree edge case handle karta hai.

en: The function uses ⟦0⟧ to allocate memory for a new object of type T and then constructs the object in that memory using the arguments passed to the function, employing perfect forwarding to preserve the value category of the arguments.
ru: Function ⟦0⟧ ka use karke type T ke naye object ke liye memory allocate karta hai aur phir function ko diye gaye arguments ko use karke us memory mein object construct karta hai. Is mein perfect forwarding ka use kiya jata hai taake arguments ki value category preserve rahe.

en: Uses a hash map to store each number and its index as we iterate through the vector. For each element, it checks if the difference between the target and the current element exists in the map. If it does, it means we have found our pair.
ru: Vector par iterate karte hue har number aur uska index store karne ke liye ek hash map istemal karta hai. Har element ke liye, check karta hai ke target aur current element ke darmiyan farq map mein mojood hai ya nahi. Agar ho, iska matlab hai ke pair mil gaya hai.

en: Compute the number of decimal ⟦0⟧, then sum each digit raised to that power using a recursive power function; finally compare the sum to the original number. Edge cases such as N = 0 are ⟦1⟧. The power function redundantly recomputes sub‑problems, leading to exponential time.
ru: Decimal ⟦0⟧ ki tadaad compute karta hai, phir ek recursive power function istemal karke har digit ko us power tak raise karke sum karta hai; akhir mein sum ko original number se compare karta hai. N = 0 jese edge cases ⟦1⟧ hain. Power function sub-problems ko redundantly recompute karta hai, jisse exponential time lagta hai.

en: A digit‑DP computes, for a given bound string, the number of ways to choose digits producing each possible sum while respecting the prefix‑tight constraint. The function f evaluates this DP for the upper bound and ⟦0⟧ (obtained by dec). The final answer is the difference modulo MOD.
ru: Ek digit-DP, ek di gayi bound string ke liye, digits choose karne ke tareeqon ki tadaad compute karta hai jo har possible sum produce karein jabke prefix-tight constraint respect kiya jaye. Function f is DP ko upper bound aur ⟦0⟧ (dec se hasil) ke liye evaluate karta hai. Final answer difference modulo MOD hota hai.

en: Convert a single wide character digit to its integer value in the given radix, or signal failure.
ru: Diye gaye radix mein aik single wide character digit ko integer value mein convert karta hai, ya agar conversion fail ho to failure signal karta hai.

en: First, initialize local containers with the vertices and faces reachable from bhd. Then forward these containers along with the original arguments to the overloaded parameterize that performs the actual UV mapping.
ru: Pehle, bhd se reachable vertices aur faces ke sath local containers initialize karta hai. Phir in containers ko original arguments ke sath overloaded parameterize ko forward karta hai jo actual UV mapping perform karta hai.

en: Compute the minimum number of intervals that must be removed so each index i is covered by at least ⟦0⟧ active intervals, or report impossibility.
ru: Un minimum intervals ki tadaad compute karta hai jo remove karne zaroori hain taake har index i kam az kam ⟦0⟧ active intervals se cover ho, ya impossibility report karta hai.

en: The function compares each corresponding coordinate of the two points. If all three coordinates match exactly, it returns true; otherwise, it returns false.
ru: Ye function do points ke har corresponding coordinate ko compare karta hai. Agar sab teen coordinates exactly match karein, true return karta hai; warna false return karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the initial positive integer to be tested.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – wo initial positive integer jise test karna hai.

en: s1 and s2 – the two strings to compare.
ru: s1 aur s2 – compare karne wali do strings.

en: Restores the mesh state by updating all facets and cells in the given ranges.
ru: Given ranges mein tamam facets aur cells ko update karke mesh ki state restore karta hai.

en: Pre‑compute the squared radius. For each point, compute the squared distance using integer arithmetic, compare it to the squared radius, and add the boolean ⟦0⟧ to the running total.
ru: Squared radius pehle se compute karta hai. Har point ke liye, integer arithmetic istemal karke squared distance compute karta hai, use squared radius se compare karta hai, aur boolean ⟦0⟧ ko running total mein add kar deta hai.

en: Checks if the grain's counter is less than or equal to zero. If so, it moves the last active grain into the position of the current grain and decrements the number of active grains. If not, it simply returns false.
ru: Check karta hai ke grain ka counter zero se kam ya barabar hai ya nahi. Agar ho, last active grain ko current grain ki position mein move kar deta hai aur active grains ki tadaad ko decrement kar deta hai. Agar nahi, simply false return kar deta hai.

en: Sort a vector of ints and output them in a specific order.
ru: Ints ka ek vector sort karta hai aur unhe ek specific order mein output karta hai.

en: The function performs a depth-first ⟦0⟧ to collect all node values into a vector. It then sorts this vector and iterates through it to find the smallest difference between consecutive elements.
ru: Ye function sab node values ko ek vector mein collect karne ke liye ek depth-first ⟦0⟧ perform karta hai. Phir ye vector ko sort karta hai aur consecutive elements ke darmiyan sabse chota farq dhoondne ke liye us par iterate karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ scans the string with a sliding window, summing n·(n+1)/2 for each maximal run of '1's. flip inverts each bit. ⟦1⟧ reuses ⟦0⟧ on the original and flipped strings, adding the two results.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ek sliding window ke sath string scan karta hai, '1's ke har maximal run ke liye n·(n+1)/2 sum karte hue. flip har bit invert karta hai. ⟦1⟧ original aur flipped strings par ⟦0⟧ ko reuse karta hai, dono results add karte hue.

en: First, interleave newly allocated clone nodes directly after each original node. Second, copy random pointers by linking each clone’s random to the clone of its original’s random. Finally, separate the interleaved structure into two independent lists, restoring the original list’s next pointers and extracting the cloned list.
ru: Pehle, har original node ke turant baad newly allocated clone nodes ko interleave karta hai. Doosra, har clone ke random ko uske original ke random ke clone se link karke random pointers copy karta hai. Akhir mein, interleaved structure ko do independent lists mein separate karta hai, original list ke next pointers restore karte hue aur cloned list extract karte hue.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the character at that ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – us ⟦1⟧ par character.

en: The zero‑based index of the leftmost column with a 1, or –1 if the matrix has no 1s.
ru: Us leftmost column ka zero-based index jismein 1 ho, ya –1 agar matrix mein koi 1 na ho.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the signed number of steps forward from the container’s reference index to the iterator, accounting for wrap‑around.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – container ke reference index se iterator tak steps ki signed tadaad, wrap-around ko account karte hue.

en: Determines whether the sum of decimal digits in a string is divisible by 9.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek string ke decimal digits ka sum 9 se divisible hai ya nahi.

en: First, a stack pairs each '(' with its corresponding ')' and records the indices in an array ⟦0⟧. Then, a single pass walks through the string; when a parenthesis is encountered, the index jumps to its partner and the walking direction flips, effectively traversing the enclosed segment in reverse order. Non‑parenthesis characters are appended to the result.
ru: Pehle, ek stack har '(' ko uske corresponding ')' se pair karta hai aur indices ko ek array ⟦0⟧ mein record karta hai. Phir, ek single pass string ke through chalta hai; jab ek parenthesis mile, index uske partner par jump karta hai aur chalne ki direction flip ho jati hai, effectively enclosed segment ko reverse order mein traverse karte hue. Non-parenthesis characters result mein append ho jate hain.

en: Compute the total spread r = max‑min; if r is zero or odd, no solution exists. Let k = r/2. Insert all numbers into a multiset, then repeatedly take the smallest value a; if a+2k exists, the original value is a+k, and both a and a+2k are removed. If any counterpart is missing, return empty. The process continues until the multiset is empty.
ru: Total spread r = max-min compute karta hai; agar r zero ya odd ho, koi solution mojood nahi. k = r/2 le lo. Sab numbers ko ek multiset mein insert karta hai, phir baar baar sabse choti value a leta hai; agar a+2k mojood ho, original value a+k hai, aur a aur a+2k dono remove ho jate hain. Agar koi counterpart missing ho, empty return kar deta hai. Process tab tak continue hota hai jab tak multiset khali na ho jaye.

en: Compute the total money earned over n days where each Monday’s earning increases by 1 relative to the previous week.
ru: n dinon mein total earned money calculate karta hai, jahan har Monday ki earning previous week ke muqable mein 1 se increase hoti hai.

en: Returns a string showing the first non‑repeating character after each prefix of the input.
ru: Ek string return karta hai jo input ke har prefix ke baad pehla non-repeating character dikhata hai.

en: Returns the lexicographically maximum suffix of a given string.
ru: Ek di gayi string ki lexicographically maximum suffix return karta hai.

en: Scan the string, increment a counter for each '(' and decrement for each ')', tracking the highest counter value encountered. The final maximum is returned.
ru: String ko scan karta hai, har '(' ke liye counter increment karta hai aur har ')' ke liye decrement karta hai, milne wali sabse zyada counter value track karte hue. Final maximum return kiya jata hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ calculates the binomial coefficient using a reduced r and an iterative multiplicative formula to stay within integer range. ⟦1⟧ then multiplies this coefficient by p^k ⟦2⟧^{n-k} using ⟦3⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ integer range ke andar rehne ke liye ek reduced r aur ek iterative multiplicative formula istemal karke binomial coefficient calculate karta hai. ⟦1⟧ phir ⟦3⟧ istemal karke is coefficient ko p^k ⟦2⟧^{n-k} se multiply karta hai.

en: Adds two numbers represented as linked lists in reverse order.
ru: Reverse order mein linked lists ki tarah represent hone wale do numbers ko add karta hai.

en: Returns the count of integers ≤ 10ⁿ − 1 that contain at least one zero digit.
ru: Un integers ka count return karta hai jo 10ⁿ − 1 se kam ya barabar hon aur jinmein kam az kam ek zero digit ho.

en: Converts a raw pointer to a constant reference of type T while ensuring alignment compatibility.
ru: Ek raw pointer ko type T ke constant reference mein convert karta hai, sath hi alignment compatibility ko ensure karte hue.

en: The larger value is placed in ⟦0⟧; ⟦1⟧ is the simple division ⟦2⟧ (scaled then unscaled). ⟦3⟧ computes ⟦4⟧, scales, truncates to three decimals, and rescales. The function then checks exact equality of the two ratios and that the result is within 0.001 of 2.414.
ru: Bara value ⟦0⟧ mein rakha jata hai; ⟦1⟧ simple division ⟦2⟧ hai (scaled phir unscaled). ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧ compute karta hai, scale karta hai, teen decimals tak truncate karta hai, aur rescale karta hai. Function phir dono ratios ki exact equality check karta hai aur ye ke result 2.414 se 0.001 ke andar ho.

en: Loops from 0 to ⟦0⟧, writing each element followed by a space, then writes a newline. An empty array yields only a newline.
ru: 0 se ⟦0⟧ tak loop karta hai, har element ke baad space write karta hai, phir newline write karta hai. Agar array empty ho to sirf newline output hoti hai.

en: Checks whether text matches pat where ‘#’ acts as a wildcard that consumes characters until the next pattern symbol.
ru: Check karta hai ke text, pat se match karta hai ya nahi, jahan '#' ek wildcard ki tarah kaam karta hai jo agle pattern symbol tak characters consume karta hai.

en: Repeatedly divide out factor 2, then trial‑divide by odd numbers up to ⟦0⟧, tracking the last divisor that fully divides n. If a remainder >2 remains, it is the largest prime factor. Finally add this factor to the original input.
ru: Baar baar factor 2 ko nikalta hai, phir ⟦0⟧ tak odd numbers se trial-divide karta hai, us aakhri divisor ko track karte hue jo n ko poori tarah divide karta ho. Agar >2 ka remainder bache toh wahi largest prime factor hota hai. Akhir mein is factor ko original input mein add kar deta hai.

en: The function utilizes a two-pointer approach starting from both ends of the input vector. It compares the squares of the elements at these pointers, inserting the larger square at the beginning of the result vector. The pointer corresponding to the larger square is then moved inward. This process continues until all elements have been processed, resulting in a sorted vector of squared values.
ru: Ye function input vector ke dono ends se shuru hone wala two-pointer approach istemal karta hai. Ye in pointers par elements ke squares compare karta hai, aur bara square result vector ke shuru mein insert karta hai. Bare square wala pointer phir andar ki taraf move kar diya jata hai. Ye process tab tak chalta hai jab tak sab elements process na ho jayein, jisse squared values ka sorted vector milta hai.

en: Performs a single equality comparison between the entry’s key and the target key, returning the result of that comparison.
ru: Entry ki key aur target key ke darmiyan ek single equality comparison perform karta hai, us comparison ka result return karte hue.

en: Uses Boost’s ⟦0⟧ to obtain an iterator to the first element that fails the predicate, then constructs a new sequence from that iterator to the original end. Handles empty inputs and fully‑matched inputs by yielding an empty sequence.
ru: Predicate ko fail karne wale pehle element ka iterator hasil karne ke liye Boost ka ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai, phir us iterator se original end tak ek nayi sequence construct karta hai. Empty inputs aur fully-matched inputs ko ek empty sequence de kar handle karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a mutable reference to the list of integers.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – integers ki list ka ek mutable reference.

en: Checks for the presence of specific ⟦0⟧ to determine which deinitialization functions to call.
ru: Specific ⟦0⟧ ki mojoodgi check karta hai taake yeh determine kiya ja sake ke kaun se deinitialization functions call karne hain.

en: A float representing the interpolated weight; zero if the coordinate lies outside the image.
ru: Ek float jo interpolated weight represent karta hai; zero agar coordinate image ke bahar ho.

en: Determine whether a non‑negative integer can be expressed as the sum of two square numbers.
ru: Ye determine karne ke liye ke ek non-negative integer ko do square numbers ke sum ki tarah express kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi.

en: This function calculates the factorial of a given non-negative integer.
ru: Yeh function diye gaye non-negative integer ka factorial calculate karta hai.

en: Compute the difference between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧; then divide this difference by ⟦1⟧ to obtain the quotient and use the modulo operator to obtain the remainder. The resulting pair is returned.
ru: ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke darmiyan farq compute karta hai; phir quotient hasil karne ke liye is farq ko ⟦1⟧ se divide karta hai aur remainder hasil karne ke liye modulo operator istemal karta hai. Resulting pair return kiya jata hai.

en: Four nested loops walk the tensor in N‑H‑W‑C order, compute each element’s flat index, clamp negative values to zero, and write the clamped value back. No additional memory is allocated.
ru: Chaar nested loops tensor ko N-H-W-C order mein traverse karte hain, har element ka flat index calculate karte hain, negative values ko zero par clamp karte hain aur clamped value ko wapas write karte hain. Koi additional memory allocate nahi hoti.

en: vector<int> where each element is the integer average of its surrounding window or –1 if the window exceeds array bounds.
ru: vector<int> jahan har element apne surrounding window ka integer average hai, ya –1 agar window array bounds se bahar chala jaye.

en: Computes the total number of division steps performed by the Euclidean algorithm for two positive integers.
ru: Do positive integers ke liye Euclidean algorithm se perform hone wale division steps ki total tadaad compute karta hai.

en: The code applies Manacher’s algorithm. It first inserts ‘#’ delimiters to treat even‑length palindromes as odd‑length ones. While scanning each position, it reuses previously computed radii via symmetry and expands when possible, maintaining the rightmost reachable boundary. The longest radius and its center are recorded and finally mapped back to the original string indices.
ru: Code Manacher's algorithm apply karta hai. Ye pehle even-length palindromes ko odd-length ki tarah treat karne ke liye '#' delimiters insert karta hai. Har position scan karte hue, ye symmetry ke zariye pehle se compute ki gayi radii reuse karta hai aur jahan possible ho expand karta hai, rightmost reachable boundary maintain karte hue. Sabse lambi radius aur uska center record kiye jate hain aur akhir mein original string indices tak wapas map kiye jate hain.

en: Scan the string to record positions of ‘1’. Count internal gaps and the wrap‑around gap that are larger than m; if more than one such gap exists, rotation cannot fix it, otherwise it can.
ru: String ko scan karke '1' ki positions record karta hai. Internal gaps aur wrap-around gap ko count karta hai jo m se bare hon; agar aisa ek se zyada gap ho, toh rotation ise fix nahi kar sakti, warna kar sakti hai.

en: Converts a linear index into a 3D index for a structured data layout.
ru: Ek structured data layout ke liye ek linear index ko 3D index mein convert karta hai.

en: Factor out all 2’s, then trial‑divide by odd numbers up to √n, collecting each divisor. After each insertion, check if the collected count meets k and exit early. If a leftover prime >2 remains, add it and perform a final size check. The operation function guards against duplicate output and handles the trivial n<k case.
ru: Pehle sab 2's ko factor out karta hai, phir √n tak odd numbers se trial-divide karta hai, har divisor collect karte hue. Har insertion ke baad, check karta hai ke collected count k tak pahunch gaya hai aur early exit kar deta hai. Agar >2 ka koi leftover prime bache toh use add karta hai aur final size check karta hai. Ye function duplicate output se bachata hai aur trivial n<k case ko handle karta hai.

en: First strip any trailing path separators, then walk the string to find the last separator. If found, replace it with a null terminator, effectively dropping the final component.
ru: Pehle koi bhi trailing path separators strip karta hai, phir last separator dhoondne ke liye string mein chalta hai. Agar mil jaye, use ek null terminator se replace kar deta hai, effectively final component drop karte hue.

en: This function counts the occurrences of segments in different ⟦0⟧ regions.
ru: Yeh function different ⟦0⟧ regions mein segments ki occurrences ko count karta hai.

en: Calculate the missing number in a sequence of integers from 1 to n.
ru: 1 se n tak integers ki sequence mein missing number ko calculate karta hai.

en: An integer ⟦0⟧ representing the upper limit of the sequence.
ru: Ek integer ⟦0⟧ jo sequence ki upper limit represent karta hai.

en: Iterate through the string, updating a running remainder: for each digit, multiply the current remainder by 10, add the digit, and take modulo R. This avoids constructing the full integer and prevents overflow.
ru: String ke through iterate karta hai, ek running remainder update karte hue: har digit ke liye, current remainder ko 10 se multiply karta hai, digit add karta hai, aur modulo R leta hai. Ye full integer construct karne se bachta hai aur overflow rokta hai.

en: Applies a simplified Binet’s formula by multiplying n with the golden ratio φ = (1+√5)/2, then rounds the floating‑point result to the nearest integer. This provides a quick estimate but may be inaccurate for larger n.
ru: n ko golden ratio φ = (1+√5)/2 se multiply karke ek simplified Binet's formula apply karta hai, phir floating-point result ko nearest integer tak round kar deta hai. Ye ek quick estimate deta hai lekin bare n ke liye inaccurate ho sakta hai.

en: Uncertain<bool> – true, false, or indeterminate when the ordering cannot be decided.
ru: Uncertain<bool> – true, false, ya indeterminate jab ordering decide na ho sake.

en: Reverses the decimal digits of an integer while preserving its sign.
ru: Ek integer ke sign ko preserve karte hue uske decimal digits reverse karta hai.

en: A ⟦0⟧ is zero‑initialised, the context is initialised with ⟦1⟧, the whole input is fed via ⟦2⟧, and the final hash is produced with ⟦3⟧.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ zero-initialised hoti hai, context ⟦1⟧ se initialise hota hai, pura input ⟦2⟧ ke zariye feed kiya jata hai, aur final hash ⟦3⟧ se produce hoti hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the string to inspect.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – inspect karne wala string.

en: Recursively follows parent links until a node that is its own parent is ⟦0⟧. During unwinding, each visited node’s parent is updated to the ⟦1⟧, flattening the tree for future queries.
ru: Us node tak parent links recursively follow karta hai jo apna khud ka parent hai wo ⟦0⟧ hai. Unwinding ke doran, har visited node ka parent ⟦1⟧ se update ho jata hai, future queries ke liye tree ko flatten karte hue.

en: Iterate sequentially from ⟦0⟧, comparing each node’s ⟦1⟧ with ⟦2⟧. Return the node on a match; otherwise advance to ⟦3⟧. If the loop finishes without a match, return nullptr.
ru: ⟦0⟧ se sequentially iterate karta hai, har node ke ⟦1⟧ ko ⟦2⟧ se compare karte hue. Match hone par node return karta hai; warna ⟦3⟧ ki taraf advance karta hai. Agar loop bina match ke khatam ho jaye, nullptr return kar deta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ is an iterator type, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ define the range to be partitioned, ⟦3⟧ is a comparison functor.
ru: ⟦0⟧ aik iterator type hai, ⟦1⟧ aur ⟦2⟧ partition ki jane wali range define karte hain, jabke ⟦3⟧ aik comparison functor hai.

en: Handles the base cases N ≤ 1 directly, checks the cache to avoid recomputation, and otherwise recursively computes ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, stores their sum in the cache, and returns it.
ru: Base cases N ≤ 1 ko directly handle karta hai, recomputation se bachne ke liye cache check karta hai, aur warna recursively ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ compute karta hai, unka sum cache mein store karta hai, aur use return kar deta hai.

en: A double value representing the difference between the two products with enhanced precision.
ru: Ek double value jo enhanced precision ke sath do products ke darmiyan farq represent karti hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the number of cells in the maximal ⟦1⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – maximal ⟦1⟧ mein cells ki tadaad.

en: Finds the longest palindromic substring of the given string.
ru: Di gayi string ki sabse lambi palindromic substring dhoondta hai.

en: Compute the total number of set bits in all integers from 0 to n inclusive.
ru: 0 se n tak (inclusive) sab integers mein set bits ki total tadaad compute karta hai.

en: Determines if a given substring of a string is a palindrome.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek string ka diya gaya substring palindrome hai ya nahi.

en: Reset counters and “touched” flags for audio and control buses, allocate an aligned float buffer sized to the maximum number of wire buffers times the buffer length, clear hardware message queues, and finally set the running flag to true.
ru: Audio aur control buses ke counters aur "touched" flags reset karta hai, wire buffers ki maximum tadaad aur buffer length ke hisab se ek aligned float buffer allocate karta hai, hardware message queues clear karta hai, aur akhir mein running flag ko true set kar deta hai.

en: string containing the Roman numeral for x.
ru: string jismein x ka Roman numeral hota hai.

en: Test the lower bound first; if satisfied, return 0. Test the upper bound next; if satisfied, return 1. If neither test triggers, the input already lies inside the interval and is returned as‑is.
ru: Pehle lower bound test karta hai; agar satisfy ho, 0 return karta hai. Phir upper bound test karta hai; agar satisfy ho, 1 return karta hai. Agar dono tests trigger na hon, input pehle se interval ke andar hota hai aur as-is return kiya jata hai.

en: int N – first integer, int M – second integer.
ru: int N – pehla integer, int M – doosra integer.

en: Recursively visits each node in the order: root, then left subtree, then right subtree.
ru: Recursively har node ko is order mein visit karta hai: pehle root, phir left subtree, aur phir right subtree.

en: Determines which kids could have the greatest number of candies after receiving ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ⟦0⟧ milne ke baad kaunse bachon ke paas sabse zyada candies ho sakti hain.

en: three floats a, b, c representing the lengths of the triangle’s sides.
ru: Teen floats a, b, c jo triangle ki sides ki lengths ko represent karte hain.

en: Initializes a counter i at 1 and loops while i ≤ n. For each iteration it computes the i‑th odd number ⟦0⟧-1 and prints it, then increments i. The loop terminates after n iterations, handling n ≤ 0 by producing no output.
ru: Ek counter i ko 1 par initialize karta hai aur jab tak i ≤ n ho loop karta hai. Har iteration mein i-th odd number ⟦0⟧-1 compute karke print karta hai, phir i increment karta hai. Loop n iterations ke baad khatam hota hai, n ≤ 0 ko koi output produce na karke handle karte hue.

en: Compute a base odd count as half the range length, then increment it if both L and R are ⟦0⟧. Finally, check the parity of that odd count to decide the result.
ru: Range length ka aadha ek base odd count compute karta hai, phir use increment karta hai agar dono L aur R ⟦0⟧ hon. Akhir mein, result decide karne ke liye us odd count ki parity check karta hai.

en: Recursively assign each row to an unused column, tracking used columns via a bitmask. Memoize results in ⟦0⟧ to avoid recomputation, returning 0 when all rows are assigned and the minimum accumulated cost otherwise.
ru: Har row ko ek unused column mein recursively assign karta hai, ek bitmask ke zariye used columns track karte hue. Recomputation se bachne ke liye results ko ⟦0⟧ mein memoize karta hai, jab sab rows assign ho jayein toh 0 return karte hue aur warna minimum accumulated cost.

en: A, B – integers of type T; pointers ⟦0⟧, x, ⟦1⟧ to receive results.
ru: A, B – type T ke integers; results receive karne ke liye pointers ⟦0⟧, x, ⟦1⟧.

en: Iterates through the string, maintaining a count of open parentheses. Updates the maximum depth whenever a higher count is found.
ru: String ke through iterate karta hai, open parentheses ka count maintain karte hue. Jab bhi zyada count mile, maximum depth update kar deta hai.

en: Determines whether a root‑to‑leaf path in a binary tree matches a given sequence of integers.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke binary tree mein koi root-to-leaf path integers ki diye gaye sequence se match karta hai ya nahi.

en: Scan both strings once, counting mismatched positions and building character frequency tables. If more than two mismatches appear, return false early. After the scan, verify the frequency tables match, ensuring the strings contain the same letters. If both checks pass, a single swap can align the strings.
ru: Dono strings ko ek dafa scan karta hai, mismatched positions count karte hue aur character frequency tables build karte hue. Agar do se zyada mismatches mile, jaldi false return kar deta hai. Scan ke baad, frequency tables match hone ki verify karta hai, ye ensure karte hue ke strings mein wahi letters hon. Agar dono checks pass hon, ek single swap se strings align ho sakti hain.

en: On Linux, opens “/proc/cpuinfo”, streams each line to ⟦0⟧ if the file is accessible; on ⟦1⟧, runs “sysctl hw” via ⟦2⟧ and prints its output. Platform‑specific sections are selected with preprocessor guards.
ru: Linux par, "/proc/cpuinfo" open karta hai, agar file accessible ho toh har line ⟦0⟧ mein stream karta hai; ⟦1⟧ par, ⟦2⟧ ke zariye "sysctl hw" run karta hai aur iska output print karta hai. Platform-specific sections preprocessor guards se select kiye jate hain.

en: Sets the containment flag on a result face based on two input faces.
ru: Do input faces ke hisab se ek result face par containment flag set karta hai.

en: Early‑exit checks reject short inputs or a repeated first character. Then a single pass records the lengths of each maximal constant segment. Finally, the function checks if the segment count meets the threshold.
ru: Early-exit checks short inputs ya ek repeated first character ko reject karti hain. Phir ek single pass har maximal constant segment ki lengths record karta hai. Akhir mein, function check karta hai ke segment count threshold poori karta hai ya nahi.

en: Formats a validation state into a readable string.
ru: Validation state ko aik readable string mein format karta hai.

en: Determine whether an unsigned integer n is an exact power of base ⟦0⟧.
ru: Check karta hai ke unsigned integer n, base ⟦0⟧ ki exact power hai ya nahi.

en: Returns an output iterator positioned just after the last copied element.
ru: Copied element ke baad position par output iterator return karta hai.

en: A recursive divide‑and‑conquer fills the tree in a heap‑style array. The base case stores a leaf value; internal nodes compute XOR of left and right child results. The recursion proceeds until the whole array is represented.
ru: Ek recursive divide-and-conquer tree ko ek heap-style array mein fill karta hai. Base case ek leaf value store karta hai; internal nodes left aur right child results ka XOR compute karte hain. Recursion tab tak proceed hoti hai jab tak pura array represent na ho jaye.

en: Validate the correctness of ⟦0⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ki correctness validate karta hai.

en: Count occurrences of each ⟦0⟧ in a frequency array, then compute a suffix sum so ⟦1⟧ holds the number of elements ≥ i. Scan i from n downwards and return the first i where ⟦1⟧ equals i. If none match, return -1.
ru: Ek frequency array mein har ⟦0⟧ ke occurrences count karta hai, phir ek suffix sum compute karta hai taake ⟦1⟧ mein ≥ i wale elements ki tadaad ho. i ko n se neeche ki taraf scan karta hai aur pehla i return karta hai jahan ⟦1⟧, i ke barabar ho. Agar koi match na ho, -1 return karta hai.

en: Loop i from 1 to N, adding i/(i+1) when i is odd and subtracting it when i is even; accumulate the result in a double and output it.
ru: i ko 1 se N tak loop karta hai, i odd hone par i/(i+1) add karta hai aur i even hone par subtract karta hai; result ko ek double mein accumulate karta hai aur output kar deta hai.

en: Encrypt a static plaintext into a string, ensure the ciphertext differs from the plaintext, then decrypt it back and confirm the result matches the original. Any deviation or exception triggers a failure with the algorithm’s name.
ru: Ek static plaintext ko ek string mein encrypt karta hai, ensure karta hai ke ciphertext plaintext se differ kare, phir use wapas decrypt karta hai aur confirm karta hai ke result original se match kare. Koi bhi deviation ya exception algorithm ke naam ke sath ek failure trigger karta hai.

en: Initializes the member fields of the ⟦0⟧<false> object; no return value.
ru: ⟦0⟧<false> object ke member fields ko initialize karta hai; koi return value nahi hoti.

en: Perform a breadth‑first search from the all‑zero state, generating neighbor states by incrementing or decrementing each ⟦0⟧. Visited/blocked states are stored in an ⟦1⟧ to prevent revisiting. The search expands level‑by‑level, returning the depth when the target is first encountered.
ru: All-zero state se ek breadth-first search perform karta hai, har ⟦0⟧ ko increment ya decrement karke neighbor states generate karte hue. Visited/blocked states revisiting se bachne ke liye ek ⟦1⟧ mein store kiye jate hain. Search level-by-level expand hoti hai, target pehli baar milne par depth return karte hue.

en: An int representing the triplet sum with minimal absolute difference to x.
ru: Ek int jo x se minimal absolute difference wale triplet sum ko represent karta hai.

en: Allocates memory for a new ⟦0⟧, initializes its 'end' flag to false, sets its character value, and returns the pointer.
ru: Ek naye ⟦0⟧ ke liye memory allocate karta hai, iski 'end' flag ko false initialize karta hai, iski character value set karta hai, aur pointer return kar deta hai.

en: Determines whether a BST contains three nodes whose keys sum to zero.
ru: Check karta hai ke BST mein aise teen nodes hain jin ki keys ka sum zero ho.

en: Computes a combinatorial count based on three pairwise‑coprime parameters and an offset n.
ru: Teen pairwise-coprime parameters aur ek offset n ke hisab se ek combinatorial count compute karta hai.

en: If a profile already exists, it is cleared to prevent leaks. The structure is marked as having a defined ICC profile, then the new profile data is stored via a helper function, propagating its return code.
ru: Agar ek profile pehle se mojood ho, use leaks rokne ke liye clear kar diya jata hai. Structure ko ek defined ICC profile rakhne wala mark kiya jata hai, phir naya profile data ek helper function ke zariye store kiya jata hai, uska return code propagate karte hue.

en: If n is zero, return "0". Otherwise, repeatedly extract the least‑significant bit, prepend '0' or '1' to a result string that starts with a space, and right‑shift n until it becomes zero, then return the built string.
ru: Agar n zero ho to "0" return karta hai. Warna repeatedly least-significant bit extract karta hai aur '0' ya '1' ko result string ke start mein add karta hai. n ko right-shift karta rehta hai jab tak woh zero na ho jaye, phir tayyar ki gayi string return karta hai.

en: Perform an iterative depth‑first traversal on both trees using two stacks, each time drilling down to the next leaf. Compare leaf data values pairwise; if a mismatch is found or one tree runs out of leaves first, report and exit.
ru: Do stacks istemal karke dono trees par ek iterative depth-first traversal perform karta hai, har baar agli leaf tak drill down karte hue. Leaf data values ko pairwise compare karta hai; agar mismatch mil jaye ya ek tree ki leaves pehle khatam ho jayein, toh report karke exit kar deta hai.

en: To determine if a given sequence of popped elements is valid for a specific sequence of pushed elements, simulating the behavior of a stack's push and pop operations.
ru: Ye determine karne ke liye ke popped elements ki ek di gayi sequence pushed elements ki ek specific sequence ke liye valid hai ya nahi, ek stack ke push aur pop operations ke behavior ko simulate karte hue.

en: A ⟦0⟧ object representing the bounding box.
ru: Ek ⟦0⟧ object jo bounding box ko represent karta hai.

en: int – ⟦0⟧, representing how many times n can be divided by 2 before dropping below 1.
ru: int – ⟦0⟧, jo ye represent karta hai ke n ko 1 se neeche jane se pehle kitni dafa 2 se divide kiya ja sakta hai.

en: Perfectly forwards the input arguments to the constructor of T using move semantics where applicable.
ru: Input arguments ko T ke constructor tak perfectly forward karta hai, jahan mumkin ho move semantics istemal karte hue.

en: Returns the maximum number of consecutive 1s obtainable by flipping at most one 0 in a binary array.
ru: Ek binary array mein zyada se zyada ek 0 flip karke hasil hone wale maximum consecutive 1s return karta hai.

en: Determine whether two strings are equal after applying ⟦0⟧ operations.
ru: Check karta hai ke ⟦0⟧ operations apply karne ke baad dono strings equal hain ya nahi.

en: Sort intervals by start ascending and end descending; then sweep left‑to‑right, keeping the maximum right endpoint seen. An interval is kept only if its end exceeds this maximum, otherwise it is covered.
ru: Intervals ko start ke hisab se ascending aur end ke hisab se descending sort karta hai; phir left-to-right sweep karta hai, ab tak dekha gaya maximum right endpoint maintain karte hue. Ek interval sirf tab rakha jata hai jab uska end is maximum se zyada ho, warna wo covered samjha jata hai.

en: Calculates a scaled minimum radius based on size ratios.
ru: Size ratios ke hisab se ek scaled minimum radius calculate karta hai.

en: Copy the input string, search for the last ':' character, and if found, create a substring starting just after that position; otherwise return the original copy.
ru: Input string copy karta hai, last ':' character search karta hai, aur agar mile, us position ke turant baad se shuru hone wali ek substring create karta hai; warna original copy return kar deta hai.

en: The function creates a mask with value 1, bitwise‑ORs this mask with the integer representation of the input pointer, and then reinterprets the resulting integer back to a void*. This effectively toggles the LSB while leaving all other bits unchanged.
ru: Function 1 value ka mask banata hai, is mask ko input pointer ki integer representation ke sath bitwise-OR karta hai, aur phir resulting integer ko dobara void* mein reinterpret karta hai. Is se LSB set ho jata hai jabke baqi tamam bits unchanged rehti hain.

en: Iterate through each rectangle, compute the smaller of its two sides, and track the maximum of these ⟦0⟧. Whenever a rectangle's minimum side exceeds mx, reset the count to one; if it equals mx, increment the count. The final count is returned.
ru: Har rectangle par iterate karta hai, iske do sides mein se chota compute karta hai, aur in ⟦0⟧ ka maximum track karta hai. Jab bhi kisi rectangle ka minimum side mx se zyada ho, count ko ek par reset kar deta hai; agar mx ke barabar ho, count increment kar deta hai. Final count return kiya jata hai.

en: Initialise a boolean vector assuming all numbers are prime, then explicitly mark 0 and 1 as non‑prime. Iterate i from 2 up to √right; for each i that remains prime, mark all its multiples i·⟦0⟧ as composite. Finally, return the populated sieve.
ru: Ek boolean vector initialise karta hai ye assume karte hue ke sab numbers prime hain, phir explicitly 0 aur 1 ko non-prime mark karta hai. i ko 2 se √right tak iterate karta hai; har i jo prime rahe, uske sab multiples i·⟦0⟧ ko composite mark karta hai. Akhir mein, populated sieve return karta hai.

en: int buckets – total buckets; int ⟦0⟧ – time after which a pig dies; int ⟦1⟧ – total testing time available.
ru: int buckets – total buckets; int ⟦0⟧ – wo time jiske baad pig marta hai; int ⟦1⟧ – available total testing time.

en: The function asserts that ⟦0⟧ is a valid ⟦1⟧, then accesses the internal container via ⟦2⟧, selects the k‑th element, calls its ⟦3⟧ callable, and returns the obtained value.
ru: Ye function assert karta hai ke ⟦0⟧ ek valid ⟦1⟧ hai, phir ⟦2⟧ ke zariye internal container access karta hai, k-th element select karta hai, iska ⟦3⟧ callable call karta hai, aur hasil value return kar deta hai.

en: The function first finds the length of the longest common ⟦0⟧ using a space‑optimized DP with two rows, updating each cell by considering skips in either string or a match. The result is derived from the identity ⟦1⟧. Edge ⟦2⟧ are handled naturally by the DP initialization.
ru: Function sab se pehle space-optimized DP ki madad se longest common ⟦0⟧ ki length find karta hai, jismein do rows use hoti hain. Har cell ko dono strings mein skip karne ya match hone ki possibilities ko consider karke update karta hai. Result identity ⟦1⟧ se derive hota hai. Edge ⟦2⟧ ko DP initialization naturally handle karti hai.

en: Determines whether a string can be transformed into a different string by mirroring certain digits.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek string ko kuch digits mirror karke doosri string mein transform kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi.

en: Returns the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by decreasing a contiguous non‑'a' segment by one, with a special case when all characters are 'a'.
ru: Ek contiguous non-'a' segment ko ek se kam karke hasil hone wala lexicographically smallest string return karta hai, sab characters 'a' hone ke special case ke sath.

en: Build a frequency map for ⟦0⟧. Then scan ⟦1⟧; for each value with a remaining positive count in the map, decrement the count and append the value to the result. This respects duplicate occurrences and runs in ⟦2⟧ time with O(⟦3⟧) additional space.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke liye frequency map banata hai. Phir ⟦1⟧ ko scan karta hai; har value ke liye agar map mein uski remaining count positive ho to count ko decrease karta hai aur value ko result mein add karta hai. Yeh duplicate occurrences ko bhi handle karta hai aur ⟦2⟧ time mein run hota hai, jabke O(⟦3⟧) additional space use karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – true if the entire text matches the pattern, false otherwise.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – true agar pura text pattern se match kare, warna false.

en: Insert every product index into a Trie, recording the index at each node along its characters. Then walk the Trie following the characters of ⟦0⟧, and at each node collect the stored product indices into the result for that prefix, stopping early if a character path is missing.
ru: Har product index ko ek Trie mein insert karta hai, iske characters ke sath har node par index record karte hue. Phir ⟦0⟧ ke characters follow karte hue Trie chalta hai, aur har node par us prefix ke result mein stored product indices collect karta hai, agar koi character path missing ho toh jaldi ruk jata hai.

en: Uses depth‑first search with backtracking. At each position it iterates over all unused numbers, checks the divisibility condition, marks the number, recurses to the next position, and then backtracks. The recursion stops when all positions are filled, contributing one valid arrangement.
