ru: Backtracking ke sath depth-first search istemal karta hai. Har position par sab unused numbers par iterate karta hai, divisibility condition check karta hai, number ko mark karta hai, next position par recurse karta hai, aur phir backtrack karta hai. Recursion tab rukti hai jab sab positions fill ho jayein, ek valid arrangement contribute karte hue.

en: The function iterates over each character, appending it to a temporary string current. Whenever current differs from the previously stored string previous, a new partition is recorded, previous is updated, current is cleared, and the counter P is incremented. This logic results in a partition count equal to the string length.
ru: Ye function har character par iterate karta hai, use ek temporary string current mein append karte hue. Jab bhi current pehle se stored string previous se differ kare, ek naya partition record hota hai, previous update ho jata hai, current clear ho jata hai, aur counter P increment ho jata hai. Ye logic ek partition count deta hai jo string length ke barabar hota hai.

en: Compute the smallest positive integer n that satisfies a specific modulo condition based on k.
ru: Sabse chota positive integer n compute karta hai jo k ke hisab se ek specific modulo condition ko satisfy kare.

en: Two pointers to objects of type ⟦0⟧.
ru: Type ⟦0⟧ ke objects ke do pointers.

en: An Integer object representing the LCM of A and B.
ru: Ek Integer object jo A aur B ka LCM represent karta hai.

ru: Teen points ke har combination (⟦0⟧) par iterate karta hai. Har trio ke liye, ⟦1⟧ se side lengths calculate karta hai, Heron's formula aur shoelace formula dono istemal karke area nikalta hai, aur in values mein se bare se maximum area update karta hai. Final maximum return kiya jata hai.

en: int **arr – pointer to an n×(2n‑1) integer matrix already allocated; int n – number of ⟦0⟧.
ru: int **arr – pehle se allocated n×(2n-1) integer matrix ka pointer; int n – ⟦0⟧ ki tadaad.

en: Sort the first obstacles range values ascending, then iterate from the largest to smallest, doubling each range and subtracting it from the remaining dimension. Return the step count when the remaining dimension ≤ 0; otherwise return –1 after all obstacles are processed.
ru: Pehle obstacles ki range values ko ascending sort karta hai, phir largest se smallest tak iterate karta hai, har range ko double karke remaining dimension mein se subtract karta hai. Jab remaining dimension ≤ 0 ho jaye toh step count return karta hai; warna sab obstacles process hone ke baad –1 return karta hai.

en: Dynamic programming builds a 1‑D table dp where ⟦0⟧ holds the number of ways to reach sum i. For each possible ⟦1⟧ the table is updated by adding ⟦2⟧ to ⟦0⟧ for all i ≥ row, effectively counting combinations that include the current summand. The final answer is ⟦3⟧.
ru: Dynamic programming ek 1-D table dp build karta hai jahan ⟦0⟧, sum i tak pahunchne ke tareeqon ki tadaad rakhta hai. Har possible ⟦1⟧ ke liye table ko update kiya jata hai i ≥ row wale sab ke liye ⟦2⟧ ko ⟦0⟧ mein add karke, effectively un combinations ko count karte hue jismein current summand shamil ho. Final answer ⟦3⟧ hota hai.

en: The function uses a reverse in-order ⟦0⟧ to accumulate the sum of all greater node values and update each node accordingly.
ru: Ye function sab greater node values ka sum accumulate karne aur har node ko us hisab se update karne ke liye ek reverse in-order ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the size of the largest set of non‑intersecting matching pairs.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – non-intersecting matching pairs ke sabse bare set ka size.

en: Uses the standard formula for the determinant of a 3x3 matrix.
ru: 3x3 matrix ke determinant ke liye standard formula istemal karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ – two integers whose digit‑sum signatures are compared.
ru: ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ – do integers jin ke digit-sum signatures ko compare kiya jata hai.

en: Determines whether all elements in a vector are strictly less than a given limit.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke ek vector ke sab elements ek di gayi limit se strictly kam hain ya nahi.

en: The point associated with the vertex handle.
ru: Vertex handle se associated point.

en: Cast the destination to a byte pointer, store the high ⟦0⟧ at index 0, then store the low ⟦1⟧ at index 1, producing big‑endian order. No bounds checking is performed; the caller must ensure ⟦2⟧ points to sufficient space.
ru: Destination ko ek byte pointer mein cast karta hai, high ⟦0⟧ ko index 0 par store karta hai, phir low ⟦1⟧ ko index 1 par store karta hai, big-endian order produce karte hue. Koi bounds checking perform nahi hoti; caller ko ensure karna hoga ke ⟦2⟧ kaafi space ki taraf point kare.

en: Dynamic programming from the end of the array; for each possible segment start i, frequencies of elements are tracked while extending the segment leftwards, accumulating duplicate ⟦0⟧. The DP state ⟦1⟧ stores the best cost for the suffix starting at j, updated via the transition ⟦1⟧ = ⟦2⟧.
ru: Array ke end se dynamic programming; har possible segment start i ke liye, elements ki frequencies track ki jati hain jabke segment ko left ki taraf extend karte hue, duplicate ⟦0⟧ accumulate karte hue. DP state ⟦1⟧ j se shuru hone wale suffix ke liye best cost store karta hai, transition ⟦1⟧ = ⟦2⟧ ke zariye update hote hue.

en: Provides stream extraction for CSVRow, allowing ⟦0⟧ to read a row from an input stream.
ru: CSVRow ke liye stream extraction faraham karta hai, jisse ⟦0⟧ input stream se ek row parh sake.

en: Restores the max‑heap property for the subtree rooted at index i.
ru: Index i par rooted subtree ke liye max-heap property restore karta hai.

en: Boolean indicating if the point is inside the half-facet.
ru: Boolean jo indicate karta hai ke point half-facet ke andar hai ya nahi.

en: Compute ⟦0⟧ of each endpoint of one segment relative to the other using the cross‑product helper. If the orientations indicate a proper crossing, return true. Otherwise, handle collinear cases by checking if any endpoint lies on the opposite segment via ⟦1⟧.
ru: Aik segment ke dono endpoints ka doosre segment ke relative ⟦0⟧ calculate karta hai aur cross-product helper use karta hai. Agar orientations proper crossing ko indicate karein to true return karta hai. Warna collinear cases ko handle karne ke liye check karta hai ke koi endpoint opposite segment par ⟦1⟧ ke zariye lie karta hai ya nahi.

en: The first ⟦0⟧ is handled separately via ⟦1⟧. Then the first ⟦2⟧ is visited. Finally, all remaining ⟦3⟧ are processed row‑by‑row, calling the visitor for each element. This ordering ensures the top‑left element is treated specially while preserving a simple nested‑loop traversal.
ru: Pehle ⟦0⟧ ko ⟦1⟧ ke zariye separately handle kiya jata hai. Phir pehle ⟦2⟧ ko visit kiya jata hai. Aakhir mein baqi tamam ⟦3⟧ ko row-by-row process kiya jata hai aur har element ke liye visitor ko call kiya jata hai. Yeh ordering ensure karti hai ke top-left element ko specially treat kiya jaye, jabke simple nested-loop traversal maintain rahe.

en: ⟦0⟧ – pointer to an existing Expr, a newly allocated Constant Expr for numbers, or ⟦1⟧ if conversion is not applicable.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – existing Expr ka pointer, numbers ke liye newly allocated Constant Expr, ya agar conversion applicable na ho to ⟦1⟧.

en: Compute the maximum score Alice can obtain in the Stone Game V variant.
ru: Stone Game V variant mein Alice ka maximum score compute karta hai.

en: Sort the input, then iteratively pair each smallest unused element with its double using a set for ⟦0⟧ look‑ups, marking paired indices to avoid reuse. If any element lacks a matching double, abort and return an empty vector.
ru: Input ko sort karta hai, phir ⟦0⟧ look-ups ke liye ek set istemal karke har sabse chote unused element ko uske double ke sath iteratively pair karta hai, reuse se bachne ke liye paired indices mark karte hue. Agar kisi element ka matching double na mile, abort karke ek empty vector return kar deta hai.

en: Encode a board ⟦0⟧ into a unique integer ID.
ru: Ek board ⟦0⟧ ko ek unique integer ID mein encode karta hai.

en: Extract year, month, and day from ⟦0⟧, adjusting for ⟦0⟧'s offsets, and construct a ⟦1⟧. Extract hour, minute, and second to build a ⟦2⟧. Finally combine both into a ⟦3⟧ and return it.
ru: ⟦0⟧ se year, month aur day extract karta hai aur ⟦0⟧ ke offsets ke mutabiq adjust karke aik ⟦1⟧ banata hai. Hour, minute aur second extract karke aik ⟦2⟧ banata hai. Aakhir mein dono ko combine karke aik ⟦3⟧ return karta hai.

en: bool – true if at least one overlapping pair exists, false otherwise.
ru: bool – true agar kam az kam ek overlapping pair mojood ho, warna false.

en: Uses dynamic programming to build a table ⟦0⟧ where ⟦1⟧ indicates whether the substring from index ⟦2⟧ to ⟦3⟧ is a palindrome. It iterates over all possible substring lengths and checks if each substring can be formed as a palindrome by comparing its ends and the corresponding inner substring.
ru: Ek table ⟦0⟧ build karne ke liye dynamic programming istemal karta hai jahan ⟦1⟧ indicate karta hai ke index ⟦2⟧ se ⟦3⟧ tak ki substring palindrome hai ya nahi. Ye sab possible substring lengths par iterate karta hai aur check karta hai ke har substring apne ends aur corresponding inner substring ko compare karke palindrome ki tarah form ho sakti hai ya nahi.

en: Repeatedly apply operations: if n is even, halve it; if n is odd, either increment or decrement based on which neighboring value has fewer 1‑⟦0⟧. Count each operation until n becomes 1.
ru: Baar baar operations apply karta hai: agar n even ho, use halve karta hai; agar n odd ho, increment ya decrement karta hai is hisab se ke konsi neighboring value mein kam 1-⟦0⟧ hain. n ke 1 hone tak har operation count karta hai.

en: Initialize a = 0 and b = ⌊√c⌋. Repeatedly compare a² + b² with c: if the sum is smaller, increment a; if larger, decrement b. The loop stops when a exceeds b, guaranteeing all unordered pairs are examined. If an exact match occurs, return true; otherwise false.
ru: a = 0 aur b = ⌊√c⌋ initialize karta hai. Baar baar a² + b² ko c se compare karta hai: agar sum chota ho, a ko increment karta hai; agar bara ho, b ko decrement karta hai. Loop tab rukta hai jab a, b se zyada ho jaye, ye guarantee karte hue ke sab unordered pairs examine ho jayein. Agar exact match ho, true return karta hai; warna false.

en: First, apply Boyer‑Moore voting on indices where ⟦0⟧ == ⟦1⟧ to obtain a candidate majority value m. Then iterate again, tracking total ⟦2⟧, matches of the ⟦3⟧, and a ⟦4⟧ that reflects how many swaps can be “paid” by mismatched elements. If bal stays non‑negative, the answer is the maximum of fixing candidate occurrences and half the total ⟦5⟧; otherwise return -1.
ru: Pehle, un indices par Boyer-Moore voting apply karta hai jahan ⟦0⟧ == ⟦1⟧ ho ek candidate majority value m hasil karne ke liye. Phir dobara iterate karta hai, total ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ke matches, aur ek ⟦4⟧ track karte hue jo batata hai ke mismatched elements se kitne swaps "pay" ho sakte hain. Agar bal non-negative rahe, answer candidate occurrences fix karne aur total ⟦5⟧ ke aadhe mein se maximum hota hai; warna -1 return karta hai.

en: Handles the special case “0”, then rejects leading zeros and overly long strings. It checks that all characters are digits, converts the string to an integer, and finally ensures the value lies within the IPv4 octet range.
ru: "0" ka special case handle karta hai, phir leading zeros aur zyada lambi strings reject karta hai. Ye check karta hai ke sab characters digits hain, string ko integer mein convert karta hai, aur akhir mein ensure karta hai ke value IPv4 octet range ke andar aati hai.

en: Counts how many distinct strings can be generated using the characters of the input string, respecting their multiplicities.
ru: Ye count karta hai ke input string ke characters ki unki multiplicities respect karte hue kitni distinct strings generate ki ja sakti hain.

en: Uses a simple factorial routine, then applies two binomial‑coefficient formulas with validity checks to avoid negative factorial arguments. If the required arguments are invalid, the corresponding count is set to zero. Results are printed separated by “ ? ”.
ru: Ek simple factorial routine istemal karta hai, phir negative factorial arguments se bachne ke liye validity checks ke sath do binomial-coefficient formulas apply karta hai. Agar zaroori arguments invalid hon, corresponding count zero set kiya jata hai. Results "? " se separated print kiye jate hain.

en: The function iterates over the vector, testing each element against three hard‑coded ⟦0⟧. If an element falls into any of these ranges, a counter is incremented. The final counter value is returned.
ru: Ye function vector par iterate karta hai, har element ko teen hard-coded ⟦0⟧ ke khilaf test karte hue. Agar koi element in ranges mein se kisi mein aata ho, ek counter increment ho jata hai. Final counter value return hoti hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ representing the minimal cumulative merge cost.
ru: ⟦0⟧ jo minimal cumulative merge cost represent karta hai.

ru: Ek unique index generate karta hai jo multi-threaded environment mein race conditions ke bina istemal kiya ja sake.

en: Iterate row index i from 0 to ⟦0⟧‑1, building each row element‑by‑element. For each position j, set the value to 1 if it is at a row boundary; otherwise compute it as the sum of the two numbers directly ⟦1⟧. Append each completed row to the result.
ru: Row index i ko 0 se ⟦0⟧-1 tak iterate karta hai, har row ko element-by-element build karte hue. Har position j ke liye, value ko 1 set karta hai agar wo row boundary par ho; warna use ⟦1⟧ ke do numbers ke sum ki tarah compute karta hai. Har complete row ko result mein append karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ – pointers to the heads of two sorted ⟦2⟧ chains.
ru: ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ – do sorted ⟦2⟧ chains ke heads ke pointers.

en: Find the smallest maximum daily ⟦0⟧ that allows forming at least n groups of k consecutive days where each day's value ≤ mid.
ru: Sabse chota maximum daily ⟦0⟧ dhoondta hai jo k consecutive days ke kam az kam n groups banane deta ho jahan har din ki value ≤ mid ho.

en: ⟦0⟧ – true if all digits of ⟦1⟧ in base ⟦2⟧ are identical, false otherwise.

ru: Pehly pass mein tamam elements ke bit-counts ka frequency map banata hai. Doosray pass mein har element ko answer mein sirf tab add karta hai jab uska bit-count map mein exactly aik dafa ho, phir sum output karta hai.

en: The function calculates ⟦0⟧ via an iterative multiplicative formula, updating a running product and dividing by the loop index at each step. This avoids large intermediate factorials and runs in ⟦1⟧ time.
ru: Ye function ek iterative multiplicative formula ke zariye ⟦0⟧ calculate karta hai, har step par ek running product update karte hue aur loop index se divide karte hue. Ye bare intermediate factorials se bachta hai aur ⟦1⟧ time mein chalta hai.

en: Template parameter ⟦0⟧, which must expose ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ (or be ⟦3⟧).
ru: Template parameter ⟦0⟧, jise ⟦1⟧ aur ⟦2⟧ expose karne chahiye (ya ⟦3⟧ ho).

en: An integer representing the maximum number of bits set to 1.
ru: Ek integer jo maximum number of bits set to 1 ko represent karta hai.

ru: Har element ke liye recursively decide karta hai ke ⟦0⟧ include kare ya ⟦1⟧ exclude kare. Jab index input ke end tak pahunch jaye, constructed subset store ho jata hai. Ye binary decision tree ek n-element set ke liye 2ⁿ subsets deta hai.

ru: Sab cell coordinates ikattha karta hai, unhe unki original values ke hisab se sort karta hai, phir us order mein iterate karke har cell ko ek score assign karta hai jo current row aur column maxima mein se maximum plus ek ke barabar ho, chalte hue un maxima ko update karte hue.

ru: String ko scan karte hue paanch vowels ki ⟦0⟧ ek 5-bit mask track karti hai. Har character ke liye, corresponding bit toggle ho jati hai. Har mask ke liye earliest index store hoti hai; jab wahi mask dobara aaye, indices ke darmiyan distance ek aisi substring deta hai jismein sab vowels even hon. Aisi maximum distance return ki jati hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ is updated so that ⟦1⟧ holds the quietest employee reachable from ⟦2⟧ (including ⟦2⟧).
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko is tarah update kiya jata hai ke ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ (⟦2⟧ samet) se reachable sabse quiet employee rakhe.

en: The adjacency structure is mutated; the function returns void.
ru: Adjacency structure mutate ho jata hai; function void return karta hai.

en: Determine whether n is divisible by any integer composed solely of the digits a and b.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke n kisi aise integer se divisible hai ya nahi jo sirf a aur b digits se bana ho.

en: Build a vector of 20 cumulative sums of powers of two, then linearly scan it to locate the first element not less than N, returning its index + 1. If N exceeds the last element, the function falls off without returning a defined value.
ru: Powers of two ke 20 cumulative sums ka ek vector build karta hai, phir N se kam na hone wala pehla element locate karne ke liye linearly scan karta hai, uska index + 1 return karte hue. Agar N last element se zyada ho, function bina koi defined value return kiye khatam ho jata hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ (pointer to the graph), ⟦1⟧ (index of the control), ⟦2⟧ (bus identifier).
ru: ⟦0⟧ (graph ka pointer), ⟦1⟧ (control ka index), ⟦2⟧ (bus ka identifier).

en: If M > N, return S unchanged. Scan possible start indices from right to left; for each, compare M characters. Upon a full match, shift the trailing characters left by M positions, resize S, and break.
ru: Agar M > N ho to S ko bina change kiye return karta hai. Possible start indices ko right se left scan karta hai aur har index par M characters compare karta hai. Agar complete match mil jaye to trailing characters ko M positions left shift karta hai, S ka size resize karta hai aur loop ko break kar deta hai.

en: To determine the smallest integer composed entirely of ones that is divisible by a given number K.
ru: Sirf ones se bane hue sabse chote integer determine karne ke liye jo di gayi number K se divisible ho.

en: int – total number of training ⟦0⟧ required.
ru: int – zaroori total training ⟦0⟧ ki tadaad.

en: Performs a digit‑wise increment on a base‑('a'+k) encoded string, handling carries.
ru: Ek base-('a'+k) encoded string par digit-wise increment perform karta hai, carries handle karte hue.

en: The function uses two pointers, one starting at the ⟦0⟧ and the other at the ⟦1⟧ of the input vector. It compares the squares of the elements at these pointers and places the larger square at the current position in the result vector, moving the respective pointer inward. This process continues until all elements have been processed, resulting in a sorted vector of squares.
ru: Function two pointers use karta hai: aik input vector ke ⟦0⟧ se aur doosra ⟦1⟧ se start hota hai. Dono pointers ke elements ke squares compare karta hai aur larger square ko result vector ki current position par place karta hai, phir respective pointer ko andar move karta hai. Yeh process tab tak continue hota hai jab tak tamam elements process na ho jayein, aur result mein squares ki sorted vector hasil hoti hai.

en: Compute the minimum total ASCII value of characters that must be deleted from two strings to make them identical.
ru: Do strings ko identical banane ke liye jo characters delete karne zaroori hon, unki minimum total ASCII value compute karta hai.

en: The function uses the ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ methods to retrieve the error type, code, and text, respectively. These values are then formatted and appended to the output stream.
ru: Ye function error type, code, aur text hasil karne ke liye ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, aur ⟦2⟧ methods istemal karta hai. Ye values phir format karke output stream mein append kar di jati hain.

en: Determines whether two 26‑element frequency vectors are identical.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke do 26-element frequency vectors identical hain ya nahi.

en: Returns ⟦0⟧ if ⟦1⟧ are sorted under the alien order, otherwise ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ return karta hai agar ⟦1⟧ alien order ke mutabiq sorted hon, warna ⟦2⟧ return karta hai.

en: Retrieve the first slot of queueobj and confirm it contains an object. If so, call getheap to extract the smallest‑time entry; on failure or if the slot isn’t an object, set result to nil.
ru: queueobj ka pehla slot retrieve karta hai aur confirm karta hai ke usmein ek object hai. Agar hai, sabse chota-time entry extract karne ke liye getheap call karta hai; failure par ya agar slot object na ho, result ko nil set kar deta hai.

en: Uses a bottom-up dynamic programming approach with a space-optimized DP table. The table keeps track of the minimum distance between substrings of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. For each character pair, it calculates the cost of insertion, deletion, and replacement and updates the DP table accordingly.
ru: Space-optimized DP table ke sath bottom-up dynamic programming approach istemal karta hai. Table ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke substrings ke darmiyan minimum distance ko track karta hai. Har character pair ke liye, insertion, deletion, aur replacement ka cost calculate karke DP table ko update kar deta hai.

en: Iterate through the array. Maintain a counter that increments for each zero encountered. When a '1' is found, check if the counter is less than ⟦0⟧. If so, return false. Reset the counter to 0 if it meets or exceeds ⟦0⟧.
ru: Array ke through iterate karta hai. Har baar zero milne par counter ko increment karta hai. Jab ‘1’ mile, to check karta hai ke kya counter ⟦0⟧ se kam hai. Agar kam ho, to false return karta hai. Agar counter ⟦0⟧ ke barabar ya us se zyada ho, to counter ko 0 par reset kar deta hai.

en: void – the list is modified in‑place; no value is returned.
ru: void – list in-place modify hoti hai; koi value return nahi hoti.

en: Compute the minimum number of replacement operations needed to make the array non‑decreasing by repeatedly splitting elements.
ru: Elements ko repeatedly split karke array ko non-decreasing banane ke liye required minimum replacement operations calculate karta hai.

en: Calculates the distance between the start and end iterators. Copies all but the last element from the input range to ⟦0⟧, and then copies the last element to ⟦1⟧.
ru: Start aur end iterators ke darmiyan distance calculate karta hai. Input range ka last element ke ilawa sab kuch ⟦0⟧ mein copy karta hai, aur phir last element ko ⟦1⟧ mein copy kar deta hai.

en: Computes the length of the longest palindromic subsequence within a substring of ⟦0⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke ek substring ke andar sabse lambi palindromic subsequence ki length compute karta hai.

en: It uses a stack to keep track of characters. For each character in the string, if the stack is not empty and the current character forms a pair with the top of the ⟦0⟧, it pops the stack. Otherwise, it pushes the current character onto the stack. Finally, the size of the stack gives the minimum length of the string.
ru: Ye characters track karne ke liye ek stack istemal karta hai. String ke har character ke liye, agar stack empty na ho aur current character ⟦0⟧ ke top ke sath ek pair banaye, stack ko pop kar deta hai. Warna, current character ko stack par push kar deta hai. Akhir mein, stack ka size string ki minimum length deta hai.

en: Finds the maximum length of a contiguous substring that contains all five vowels in order.
ru: Ek aisi contiguous substring ki maximum length dhoondta hai jismein sab paanch vowels order mein hon.

en: ⟦0⟧ – the source ⟦1⟧; ⟦2⟧ – number of characters to delete.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – source ⟦1⟧; ⟦2⟧ – delete karne wale characters ki tadaad.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a sequence of length ⟦1⟧ where each element is the minimal possible sum of prefixes from ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – length ⟦1⟧ ki ek sequence jahan har element ⟦2⟧ aur ⟦3⟧ se prefixes ka minimal possible sum hota hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ if the trees are structurally identical or can be made identical by swapping left/right children at any nodes; otherwise ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ agar trees structurally identical hon ya kisi bhi node par left/right children ko swap karke identical banaye ja sakte hon; warna ⟦2⟧.

en: The function recursively compares nodes of the two trees. It returns ⟦0⟧ if both nodes are ⟦1⟧, or if their values are equal and the subtrees formed by swapping their children are also mirrors of each other. If any of these conditions fail, it returns ⟦2⟧.
ru: Ye function dono trees ke nodes ko recursively compare karta hai. Ye ⟦0⟧ return karta hai agar dono nodes ⟦1⟧ hon, ya agar unki values equal hon aur unke children swap karke bane subtrees bhi ek doosre ke mirror hon. Agar in mein se koi condition fail ho jaye toh ye ⟦2⟧ return karta hai.

en: double d – the floating‑point value to be examined.
ru: double d – examine kiya jane wala floating-point value.

en: Use a sliding window with two ⟦0⟧. Expand r while the count of c stays ≤ k; otherwise, move l forward, adjusting the count. After each adjustment, record the window size. The process runs in ⟦1⟧ time and ⟦2⟧ extra space.
ru: Sliding window use karta hai jismein do ⟦0⟧ hote hain. r ko expand karta hai jab tak c ki count ≤ k rahe; warna l ko aage move karta hai aur count ko adjust karta hai. Har adjustment ke baad window ka size record karta hai. Yeh process ⟦1⟧ time aur ⟦2⟧ extra space mein run hota hai.

en: int – the minimal start value satisfying the condition.
ru: int – condition satisfy karne wala minimal start value.

en: Returns ⟦0⟧ on success; on failure returns ⟦1⟧ and updates ⟦2⟧ with the required size.
ru: Success par ⟦0⟧ return karta hai; failure par ⟦1⟧ return karta hai aur ⟦2⟧ ko required size se update kar deta hai.

en: Sort the array in ascending order, then use the last two ⟦0⟧ and the first two ⟦1⟧ to ⟦2⟧ − (min1 * min2). The sorting ensures the required elements are at known indices.
ru: Array ko ascending order mein sort karta hai, phir last do ⟦0⟧ aur first do ⟦1⟧ istemal karke ⟦2⟧ − (min1 * min2) compute karta hai. Sorting ensure karti hai ke required elements known indices par hon.

en: For each ⟦0⟧ the code uses a KMP‑style prefix function to find the maximal overlap between the suffix of the first string and the prefix of the second. It then concatenates the non‑overlapping suffix of the second string. Finally, it selects the shorter of the two candidates.
ru: Har ⟦0⟧ ke liye code ek KMP-style prefix function istemal karta hai pehli string ke suffix aur doosri ke prefix ke darmiyan maximal overlap dhoondne ke liye. Phir ye doosri string ke non-overlapping suffix ko concatenate karta hai. Akhir mein, do candidates mein se chota wala select karta hai.

en: For each number, factorize it by trial division, linking its index to any previously seen index that shares a prime factor using a DSU. After processing all numbers, the function checks if the largest DSU component size equals the total number of elements.
ru: Har number ke liye, trial division se use factorize karta hai, DSU ka istemal karke uska index kisi bhi pehle se dekhe gaye index se link karta hai jo prime factor share karta ho. Sab numbers process hone ke baad, function check karta hai ke sabse bara DSU component size total elements ki tadaad ke barabar hai ya nahi.

en: Compute the minimum number of parentheses needed to make a string of '(' and ')' valid.
ru: '(' aur ')' ke ek string ko valid banane ke liye zaroori minimum parentheses compute karta hai.

en: Count how often each row pattern occurs. For each row, build its bitwise ⟦0⟧ and sum the frequencies of the row and its complement; the maximum of these sums is the answer.
ru: Har row pattern kitni baar occur hota hai count karta hai. Har row ke liye, iska bitwise ⟦0⟧ build karta hai aur row aur uske complement ki frequencies sum karta hai; in sums mein se maximum hi answer hota hai.

en: Build a 2‑D prefix‑sum array ⟦0⟧ in ⟦1⟧. For each query, slide a window of the requested size over the matrix, retrieving each window’s sum in ⟦2⟧ via the prefix array, and keep the maximum. Overall complexity ⟦3⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ mein 2-D prefix-sum array ⟦1⟧ mein build karta hai. Har query ke liye requested size ki window ko matrix par slide karta hai aur prefix array ki madad se har window ka sum ⟦2⟧ mein hasil karta hai, phir maximum value ko store karta hai. Overall complexity ⟦3⟧ hai.

en: Writes matching words to cout; prints a not‑found message if none match.
ru: Matching words ko cout par print karta hai; agar koi match na mile to not-found message print karta hai.

en: Atomically increments the integer pointed to by pw using a hardware fetch‑add instruction.
ru: Ek hardware fetch-add instruction istemal karke pw se pointed integer ko atomically increment karta hai.

en: If S is zero, the answer is ⟦0⟧; otherwise, subtract the prefix sum before ⟦1⟧ from ⟦0⟧ to obtain the sum of the sub‑range.
ru: Agar S zero ho, answer ⟦0⟧ hai; warna, sub-range ka sum hasil karne ke liye ⟦1⟧ se pehle wala prefix sum ⟦0⟧ mein se subtract karta hai.

en: Produce the lexicographically smallest non‑palindromic string by modifying at most one character of a given palindrome.
ru: Diye gaye palindrome ka zyada se zyada ek character modify karke lexicographically smallest non-palindromic string produce karta hai.

en: A single forward scan uses an outer index i; an inner loop counts consecutive equal ⟦0⟧. After printing, i is advanced by cnt‑1 so each group is processed exactly once, yielding ⟦1⟧ time.
ru: Ek single forward scan outer index i istemal karta hai; ek inner loop consecutive equal ⟦0⟧ count karta hai. Print karne ke baad, i ko cnt-1 se aage barha diya jata hai taake har group sirf ek hi baar process ho, jisse ⟦1⟧ time milta hai.

en: Compute the minimal sum of 1..k and the extra amount ⟦0⟧. Distribute this extra amount evenly across the k positions using floor/ceil, then add the base increasing sequence to ensure distinctness. Handle edge cases where ⟦1⟧ equals ⟦2⟧ or when k is 1,2,3 with specific adjustments or messages.
ru: 1..k ka minimal sum aur extra amount ⟦0⟧ compute karta hai. Is extra amount ko floor/ceil istemal karke k positions ke across evenly distribute karta hai, phir distinctness ensure karne ke liye base increasing sequence add karta hai. Edge cases handle karta hai jahan ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ke barabar ho ya jab k 1,2,3 ho specific adjustments ya messages ke sath.

en: Find all strings that occur more than ⌊n/k⌋ times in a read‑only stream.
ru: Ek read-only stream mein wo sab strings dhoondta hai jo ⌊n/k⌋ se zyada baar occur hoti hain.

en: Traverses the list using XOR of stored pointers to locate the insertion point, updates the surrounding nodes' XOR links to include the new node, handling edge cases for empty list, head insertion, and out‑of‑range positions. ⟦0⟧ similarly walks the list by recomputing each next pointer via XOR.
ru: Stored pointers ke XOR ka istemal karke insertion point locate karne ke liye list traverse karta hai, surrounding nodes ke XOR links ko naye node ke liye update karta hai, empty list, head insertion, aur out-of-range positions ke edge cases handle karte hue. ⟦0⟧ isi tarah XOR ke zariye har next pointer recompute karke list ko traverse karta hai.

en: Count the occurrences of each ⟦0⟧ in the string. Since "balloon" requires two 'l's and two 'o's, divide the counts of 'l' and 'o' by 2 before finding the minimum value among all counts, which gives the maximum number of "balloon" words.
ru: String mein har ⟦0⟧ ke occurrences count karta hai. Chunke "balloon" ke liye do 'l's aur do 'o's zaroori hain, sab counts mein se minimum value dhoondne se pehle 'l' aur 'o' ke counts ko 2 se divide karta hai, jo "balloon" words ki maximum tadaad deta hai.

en: Constructs and prints the longest possible palindrome by concatenating given strings.
ru: Diye gaye strings ko concatenate karke sabse lamba possible palindrome construct karta hai aur print karta hai.

en: Compute the digit count of N, then repeatedly move the least‑significant digit to the most‑significant position using ⟦0⟧. After each rotation, print the number and stop when the value returns to the original N. Edge ⟦1⟧ are not explicitly handled.
ru: N ka digit count compute karta hai, phir ⟦0⟧ istemal karke baar baar least-significant digit ko most-significant position par move karta hai. Har rotation ke baad, number print karta hai aur ruk jata hai jab value original N par wapas aa jaye. Edge ⟦1⟧ ko explicitly handle nahi kiya gaya.

en: an int representing ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ek int jo ⟦0⟧ ko represent karta hai.

en: int – the largest product obtainable from a sub‑array ⟦0⟧.
ru: int – ek sub-array ⟦0⟧ se hasil hone wala sabse bara product.

en: ⟦0⟧ – a reference to a 2‑D vector of ⟦1⟧; ⟦2⟧ – the integer to locate.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – ⟦1⟧ ke 2-D vector ka ek reference; ⟦2⟧ – locate karne wala integer.

en: void – the function populates the object’s arrays; no return value.
ru: void – function object ke arrays populate karta hai; koi return value nahi.

en: Perform integer division s/n to obtain the base count; if there is a non‑zero ⟦0⟧, add one to account for the leftover portion, effectively calculating ⌈s/n⌉.
ru: Base count hasil karne ke liye integer division s/n perform karta hai; agar ⟦0⟧ non-zero ho toh leftover portion ko account karne ke liye ek add kar deta hai, jisse effectively ⌈s/n⌉ calculate hota hai.

en: Recursively visit the left child, output the current node’s value, then recursively visit the right child, halting when a null pointer is encountered.
ru: Left child ko recursively visit karta hai, current node ki value output karta hai, phir right child ko recursively visit karta hai, null pointer milne par ruk jata hai.

en: Compute the count of irreflexive binary relations on a set of size N.
ru: Size N ke ek set par irreflexive binary relations ka count compute karta hai.

en: Simply returns a new ⟦0⟧ with the negated mantissa and exponent. If debugging is enabled, the rational part is also negated.
ru: Bas ek naya ⟦0⟧ return karta hai jisme mantissa aur exponent ko negate kiya jata hai. Agar debugging enabled ho, to rational part ko bhi negate kiya jata hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - The floating-point number to be rounded.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - wo floating-point number jise round karna hai.

en: Repeatedly replace n by the sum of the squares of its decimal ⟦0⟧. If the sequence reaches 1, the number is happy; if it reaches 4, it has entered the known loop that never reaches 1, so it is unhappy. The loop runs indefinitely until one of these two conditions is met.
ru: Baar baar n ko uske decimal ⟦0⟧ ke squares ke sum se replace karta hai. Agar sequence 1 tak pahunche, number happy hota hai; agar 4 tak pahunche, ye us known loop mein aa gaya hai jo kabhi 1 tak nahi pahunchta, isliye ye unhappy hota hai. Loop tab tak indefinitely chalta hai jab tak in do conditions mein se ek poori na ho.

en: Convert an English sentence to its Goat Latin representation.
ru: Ek English sentence ko uske Goat Latin representation mein convert karta hai.

en: Iterate through S, building a temporary substring T that continues while the absolute difference between consecutive characters is not 1. When a difference of 1 occurs, compare T’s length to the current best ans and reset T. After the loop, perform a final comparison and output ans.
ru: S ke through iterate karta hai aur aik temporary substring T banata hai jo tab tak continue hoti hai jab tak consecutive characters ka absolute difference 1 na ho. Jab difference 1 ho to T ki length ko current best ans ke sath compare karta hai aur T ko reset karta hai. Loop ke baad final comparison karta hai aur ans output karta hai.

en: Find the maximum integer obtainable by swapping at most one pair of digits in the input number.
ru: Input number mein zyada se zyada ek pair digits swap karke hasil hone wala maximum integer find karta hai.

en: Reports a BLAS error by printing its code and message.
ru: Ek BLAS error ko uska code aur message print karke report karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ - A reference to a vector of integers where each element represents the height of a bar in the histogram.
ru: ⟦0⟧ - Integers ke vector ka ek reference jahan har element histogram mein ek bar ki height represent karta hai.

en: To find the last occurrence of a given target value in a sorted array.
ru: Ek sorted array mein di gayi target value ka last occurrence dhoondne ke liye.

en: The method uses two bit‑mask variables, ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, to track bits that have appeared once and twice respectively. For each number, it XORs with the masks and clears bits that have transitioned to the next count using bitwise AND with the negated other mask. After processing, ⟦0⟧ contains the bits of the unique element.
ru: Ye method do bit-mask variables, ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧, istemal karta hai un bits ko track karne ke liye jo respectively ek baar aur do baar appear hui hon. Har number ke liye, ye masks se XOR karta hai aur negated doosre mask ke sath bitwise AND istemal karke un bits ko clear karta hai jo agle count tak transition ho chuki hon. Processing ke baad, ⟦0⟧ unique element ke bits rakhta hai.

en: Recursively process each element, branching into two paths – one that includes the element in the current subset and one that excludes it. When the index reaches the end of nums, the current subset is added to the result. This depth‑first traversal yields 2^n subsets.
ru: Har element ko recursively process karta hai, do paths mein branch karte hue – ek jo element ko current subset mein include karta hai aur ek jo exclude karta hai. Jab index nums ke end tak pahunch jaye, current subset result mein add ho jata hai. Ye depth-first traversal 2^n subsets deta hai.

en: Compute the number of ways to choose X items from ⟦0⟧ using Pascal’s identity.
ru: Pascal's identity istemal karke ⟦0⟧ se X items choose karne ke tareeqon ki tadaad compute karta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ – pointer to an array of type T containing non‑negative integers; ⟦1⟧ – number of elements in the array.
ru: ⟦0⟧ – type T ke array ka pointer jismein non-negative integers hain; ⟦1⟧ – array mein elements ki tadaad.

en: Determine whether two field elements are equal in constant‑time.
ru: Ye determine karne ke liye ke do field elements constant-time mein equal hain ya nahi.

en: Iterate while ⟦0⟧, assign ⟦1⟧, then increment both iterators. After the loop, return the updated ⟦2⟧.
ru: Jab tak ⟦0⟧ ho, iterate karta hai, ⟦1⟧ assign karta hai, phir dono iterators ko increment karta hai. Loop ke baad, updated ⟦2⟧ return kar deta hai.

en: float64 – 1.0 if x ∈ [0, 1], else 0.0.
ru: float64 – 1.0 agar x ∈ [0, 1] ho, warna 0.0.

en: Calls the database's internal ⟦0⟧ method to inform LevelDB that the snapshot is no longer needed, then deallocates the snapshot wrapper with ⟦1⟧. The function assumes both pointers are valid and that the snapshot belongs to the given database.
ru: LevelDB ko batane ke liye ke snapshot ki zarurat nahi rahi database ka internal ⟦0⟧ method call karta hai, phir ⟦1⟧ se snapshot wrapper ko deallocate kar deta hai. Function assume karta hai ke dono pointers valid hain aur snapshot di gayi database ka hai.

en: Checks whether x falls outside the closed ⟦0⟧; if so, returns 0, otherwise returns 1. The test includes the interval boundaries, ensuring the window is inclusive.
ru: Check karta hai ke x closed ⟦0⟧ se bahar aata hai ya nahi; agar aata ho, 0 return karta hai, warna 1. Test interval boundaries ko shamil karta hai, ye ensure karte hue ke window inclusive ho.

en: Count subarrays containing exactly k odd numbers.
ru: Un subarrays ko count karta hai jinmein exactly k odd numbers hon.

en: Reads up to five bytes, each contributing 7 bits to the result while the high‑bit flag indicates continuation. If a byte without the flag is found, the accumulated result is stored and the new pointer is returned; otherwise, reaching the limit or exceeding five bytes yields failure.
ru: Zyada se zyada paanch bytes parhta hai, har ek result mein 7 bits contribute karta hai jabke high-bit flag continuation indicate karta hai. Agar bina flag wala byte mil jaye, accumulated result store ho jata hai aur naya pointer return hota hai; warna, limit tak pahunchna ya paanch bytes se zyada ho jana failure deta hai.

en: Perform an in‑order ⟦0⟧. While traversing, update *p whenever a node’s data is less than ⟦1⟧ and update *q when a node’s data exceeds a, keeping the smallest such value as the successor. The function skips updates when a node’s data equals a.
ru: Ek in-order ⟦0⟧ perform karta hai. Traverse karte hue, jab bhi node ka data ⟦1⟧ se kam ho *p update karta hai aur jab node ka data a se zyada ho *q update karta hai, successor ke tor par sabse choti aisi value rakhte hue. Function jab node ka data a ke barabar ho toh updates skip kar deta hai.

en: Use ⟦0⟧ on the first row to locate the first 1 (column j). If j==0 the first row is maximal. Then iterate rows 1…R‑1, moving j left while a 1 is found; each left move indicates a row with more 1s, so update the result. The process is ⟦1⟧.
ru: Pehla 1 (column j) locate karne ke liye first row par ⟦0⟧ istemal karta hai. Agar j==0 ho, pehli row maximal hai. Phir rows 1…R-1 par iterate karta hai, j ko left move karte hue jab tak 1 milta rahe; har left move zyada 1s wali row indicate karta hai, isliye result update karta hai. Process ⟦1⟧ hai.

en: A constant reference to a C3t3 object and a filename without ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ek C3t3 object ka constant reference aur bina ⟦0⟧ wala ek filename.

en: Sets the target vertex of a half‑edge and closes the mesh tip by correctly linking its twin.
ru: Ek half-edge ka target vertex set karta hai aur uske twin ko sahi tarah link karke mesh tip ko close kar deta hai.

en: Sets the count of text entries to zero and nullifies both the key and string pointer arrays, ensuring the structure starts with no allocated text data and avoids undefined behavior from stale pointers.
ru: Text entries ka count zero set karta hai aur key aur string pointer arrays dono ko null kar deta hai, ye ensure karte hue ke structure koi bhi allocated text data ke bina shuru ho aur stale pointers se undefined behavior se bacha jaye.

en: Translate ⟦0⟧ to a column ⟦1⟧, defaulting to 0. Then scan ⟦2⟧, comparing the chosen column to ⟦3⟧ and summing ⟦4⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ko ek column ⟦1⟧ mein translate karta hai, default 0 ke sath. Phir ⟦2⟧ ko scan karta hai, chosen column ko ⟦3⟧ se compare karke aur ⟦4⟧ ko sum karte hue.

en: The function marks the possibly‑unused parameters as used, asserts that the map is valid for the graph via ⟦0⟧, and then returns the map unchanged.
ru: Ye function possibly-unused parameters ko used mark karta hai, ⟦0⟧ ke zariye assert karta hai ke map graph ke liye valid hai, aur phir map ko bina change kiye return kar deta hai.

en: Sets preview features in the builder configuration based on the provided build options.
ru: Di gayi build options ke hisab se builder configuration mein preview features set karta hai.

en: Calculates φ = (1+√5)/2 and ψ = (1-√5)/2, raises each to the Nth power, takes their difference, divides by √5, and rounds the result to the nearest integer. This leverages Binet's formula, which is exact for integer N but may suffer floating‑point precision limits for large N.
ru: φ = (1+√5)/2 aur ψ = (1-√5)/2 calculate karta hai, har ek ko Nth power tak raise karta hai, unka farq leta hai, √5 se divide karta hai, aur result ko nearest integer tak round karta hai. Ye Binet's formula ka faida uthata hai, jo integer N ke liye exact hai lekin bare N ke liye floating-point precision limits ka shikar ho sakta hai.

en: Determine whether two strings can be made identical using allowed ⟦0⟧.
ru: Ye determine karta hai ke allowed ⟦0⟧ istemal karke do strings ko identical banaya ja sakta hai ya nahi.

en: Compute 2ⁿ (where n = ⟦0⟧()) to know the total number of subsets. Loop over each integer i from 0 to 2ⁿ‑1, treating i as a bitmask; for each bit j that is set, include ⟦1⟧ in the current subset. Collect all subsets into the result vector.
ru: Subsets ki total tadaad janne ke liye 2ⁿ compute karta hai (jahan n = ⟦0⟧()). 0 se 2ⁿ-1 tak har integer i par loop karta hai, i ko bitmask ki tarah treat karte hue; jo bhi bit j set ho, uske liye ⟦1⟧ ko current subset mein shamil karta hai. Sab subsets ko result vector mein collect kar deta hai.

en: ⟦0⟧ (the current node to process) and ⟦1⟧ (a vector indicating the path taken through the tree).
ru: ⟦0⟧ (process karne wala current node) aur ⟦1⟧ (ek vector jo tree ke through liya gaya path indicate karta hai).

en: Scan the array left‑to‑right, maintaining the maximum ⟦0⟧ seen so far. For each position j, evaluate the candidate score ⟦1⟧ - j plus this maximum, update the global result, and refresh the stored maximum with ⟦1⟧ + j. This yields an ⟦2⟧ solution.
ru: Array ko left-to-right scan karta hai, ab tak dekha gaya maximum ⟦0⟧ maintain karte hue. Har position j ke liye, candidate score ⟦1⟧ - j plus is maximum ko evaluate karta hai, global result update karta hai, aur stored maximum ko ⟦1⟧ + j se refresh kar deta hai. Ye ek ⟦2⟧ solution deta hai.

en: Compute the maximum number of disjoint pairs of equal adjacent characters that can be removed from the string.
ru: String se remove kiye ja sakne wale equal adjacent characters ke disjoint pairs ki maximum tadaad compute karta hai.

en: This function decodes a string containing numbers followed by '[' and ']', where each number indicates how many times the substring enclosed between '[' and ']' should be repeated.
ru: Ye function ek string decode karta hai jismein numbers ke baad '[' aur ']' aate hain, jahan har number batata hai ke '[' aur ']' ke darmiyan enclosed substring kitni baar repeat honi chahiye.

en: Compute the k‑times repeated digit sum of the concatenated alphabetical positions of a lowercase string.
ru: Lowercase string ke letters ki alphabetical positions ko concatenate karke, us digit string ka k-times repeated digit sum calculate karta hai.

en: The function uses a loop to repeatedly search for "AB" and "CD" in the string and erase them until no more occurrences are found. Finally, it returns the length of the resulting string.
ru: Ye function ek loop istemal karta hai string mein "AB" aur "CD" ko baar baar search karne aur erase karne ke liye jab tak koi aur occurrence na mile. Akhir mein, resulting string ki length return karta hai.

en: Find the key that was held down for the longest ⟦0⟧.
ru: Wo key dhoondta hai jo sabse lambe ⟦0⟧ ke liye held down thi.

en: To determine the longest sequence of consecutive 1s in a binary array that can be achieved by flipping exactly one 0.
ru: Ek binary array mein consecutive 1s ki sabse lambi sequence determine karne ke liye jo exactly ek 0 flip karke hasil ki ja sake.

en: Initialise a counter to zero. Repeatedly replace ⟦0⟧ with its logarithm base b while ⟦0⟧ remains ≥ 1, incrementing the counter each time. Return the final counter.
ru: Counter ko zero initialise karta hai. Jab tak ⟦0⟧ ≥ 1 rahe, ⟦0⟧ ko uske base b logarithm se baar baar replace karta hai, har baar counter increment karte hue. Final counter return karta hai.

en: Finds the largest prime number that can be formed by interpreting any prefix of the binary strings generated from the input string of '0'/'1' characters.
ru: '0'/'1' characters wali input string se generate hone wali binary strings ke kisi bhi prefix ko interpret karke ban sakne wala sabse bara prime number dhoondta hai.

en: Prints to stdout the count of valid ⟦0⟧.
ru: Valid ⟦0⟧ ka count stdout par print karta hai.

en: For each a from 0 up to √c, compute x = c – a². Perform a binary search ⟦0⟧ to check whether x is a perfect ⟦1⟧. Return true on first success; otherwise, after all a are tried, return false.
ru: 0 se √c tak har a ke liye, x = c – a² compute karta hai. x ek perfect ⟦1⟧ hai ya nahi check karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ par ek binary search perform karta hai. Pehli success par true return karta hai; warna, sab a try hone ke baad false return karta hai.

en: int a – the number to inspect; int n – 1‑based position of the desired digit; int b – the ⟦0⟧.
ru: int a – wo number jise inspect karna hai; int n – desired digit ki 1-based position; int b – ⟦0⟧.

en: Compute the minimum number of length‑K subarray flips needed to turn all elements of A into 0, or output -1 if impossible.
ru: A ke sab elements ko 0 mein tabdeel karne ke liye zaroori minimum length-K subarray flips compute karta hai, ya -1 output karta hai agar impossible ho.

en: Compute the count of non‑empty subsequences whose sum is odd.
ru: Un non-empty subsequences ka count compute karta hai jinka sum odd ho.

en: Scan the array while tracking the farthest index ⟦0⟧ and the remaining steps in the current ⟦1⟧. When ⟦2⟧ depletes, increment the jump count and reset ⟦2⟧ based on the new ⟦3⟧. Early exits handle trivial cases and dead‑ends.
ru: Array ko scan karta hai sath hi farthest index ⟦0⟧ aur current ⟦1⟧ ke remaining steps track karte hue. Jab ⟦2⟧ khatam ho jaye, jump count ko increment karta hai aur naye ⟦3⟧ ke hisab se ⟦2⟧ ko reset kar deta hai. Early exits trivial cases aur dead-ends ko handle karte hain.

en: Starting at index i, determine the parity of the first digit, then accumulate digits while the running sum retains that parity. When parity changes or the string ends, output the segment sum and recursively process the remaining substring starting after the last examined digit.
ru: Index i se shuru karke, pehle digit ki parity determine karta hai, phir digits accumulate karta hai jab tak running sum wo parity retain kare. Jab parity change ho ya string khatam ho jaye, segment sum output karta hai aur last examined digit ke baad se remaining substring ko recursively process karta hai.

en: No explicit return value; modifies the state through the passed-in counter.
ru: Koi explicit return value nahi; passed-in counter ke zariye state ko modify karta hai.

en: Adds a new slot to an object's indexed slots array if there is space available.
ru: Agar space available ho toh ek object ke indexed slots array mein ek naya slot add karta hai.

en: int – the smallest ⟦0⟧ that yields zero when AND‑ed with n, or –1 if none exists.
ru: int – sab se chhota ⟦0⟧ jo n ke sath AND karne par zero result deta hai, ya agar koi na mile to –1.

en: Compute the minimum number of button presses required to change a clock from a current time to a target time using preset minute increments.
ru: Preset minute increments istemal karke clock ko current time se target time tak change karne ke liye minimum button presses ki tadaad compute karta hai.

en: Initialise both vertices with the base coordinates from e, then increment the coordinate component indicated by ⟦0⟧ for the end vertex to move it one unit in the edge's direction.
ru: Dono vertices ko e se base coordinates ke sath initialise karta hai, phir end vertex ko edge ki direction mein ek unit move karne ke liye ⟦0⟧ se indicate ki gayi coordinate component ko increment kar deta hai.

en: Compares a Gmpfi object with a double value to determine if it's uncertain.
ru: Gmpfi object ko double value ke sath compare karta hai taake yeh determine kiya ja sake ke yeh uncertain hai ya nahi.

en: Cast the opaque pointer to State, invoke ⟦0⟧() to obtain a ⟦1⟧, then memcpy the vector’s raw data into the output buffer.
ru: Opaque pointer ko State mein cast karta hai, ⟦1⟧ hasil karne ke liye ⟦0⟧() invoke karta hai, phir vector ke raw data ko memcpy karke output buffer mein daal deta hai.

en: Generates a specific permutation of the integers 1…n.
ru: Integers 1…n ka ek specific permutation generate karta hai.

en: Iterate through the characters of ⟦0⟧, detecting spaces or the end of the string as token boundaries. When a boundary is found, extract the substring from the current start index to the boundary and store it. Update the start index to the character after the delimiter and continue scanning.
ru: ⟦0⟧ ke characters ke through iterate karta hai aur spaces ya string ke end ko token boundaries ke tor par detect karta hai. Jab boundary milti hai to current start index se boundary tak substring extract karke store karta hai. Start index ko delimiter ke baad wale character par update karta hai aur scanning continue karta hai.

en: Starting at start+1, iterate forward through the string; on each character, test with islower. The loop stops and returns the current index at the first failure; if the loop completes, return the string length.
ru: start+1 se shuru karke, string ke through forward iterate karta hai; har character par, islower se test karta hai. Pehli failure par loop rukta hai aur current index return karta hai; agar loop mukammal ho jaye, string length return kar deta hai.

en: Uses a sliding window technique with a set to keep track of cumulative sums up to each index. For each element, it calculates the current cumulative sum and checks if there exists a previous cumulative sum such that the difference is less than 'k'. If such a sum exists, it updates the maximum sum accordingly.
ru: Har index tak cumulative sums track karne ke liye ek set ke sath sliding window technique istemal karta hai. Har element ke liye, current cumulative sum calculate karta hai aur check karta hai ke koi previous cumulative sum mojood hai jiska farq 'k' se kam ho. Agar aisa sum mojood ho, us hisab se maximum sum update kar deta hai.

en: Returns true for n = 2, rejects n < 2 and even numbers, then checks odd divisors from 3 up to n‑1; if any divide n evenly, returns false, otherwise true.
ru: n = 2 ke liye true return karta hai, n < 2 aur even numbers ko reject karta hai, phir 3 se n-1 tak odd divisors check karta hai; agar koi n ko evenly divide kare, false return karta hai, warna true.

en: The function looks up each 4‑bit nibble in a constant lookup table of hex characters. The high ⟦0⟧ populates the first character, the low ⟦1⟧ the second, and the resulting string is returned.
ru: Function har 4-bit nibble ko hex characters ki constant lookup table mein find karta hai. High ⟦0⟧ pehla character set karta hai, low ⟦1⟧ doosra character set karta hai, aur resulting string return karta hai.

en: Updates a sequence by incrementally adding k to earlier occurrences of duplicate values.
ru: Ek sequence ko update karta hai duplicate values ke pehle occurrences mein incrementally k add karke.

en: Count occurrences of each value while tracking the maximum ⟦0⟧. The array can be divided into K subsequences only if the total length divided by this maximum ⟦1⟧ is ≥ K. The function returns the result of this inequality.
ru: Maximum ⟦0⟧ track karte hue har value ke occurrences count karta hai. Array ko K subsequences mein tabhi divide kiya ja sakta hai jab total length ko is maximum ⟦1⟧ se divide karne par result ≥ K ho. Function is inequality ka result return karta hai.

en: Checks if the child node's ID is valid. If not, it returns early. Then, it updates the pointers of the child node and the current head node, and sets the parent pointer of the child node. If the list was empty, it also updates the tail pointer.
ru: Check karta hai ke child node ki ID valid hai ya nahi. Agar nahi, jaldi return kar deta hai. Phir, child node aur current head node ke pointers update karta hai, aur child node ka parent pointer set karta hai. Agar list empty thi, tail pointer bhi update kar deta hai.

en: Uses dynamic programming with two states – ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. Starting from n = 1 (both states = 6), it iteratively applies the recurrence same' = 3·same + 2·diff, diff' = 2·same + 2·diff for each additional post, and finally outputs same + diff.
ru: Do states – ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke sath dynamic programming istemal karta hai. n = 1 se shuru karke (dono states = 6), har additional post ke liye recurrence same' = 3·same + 2·diff, diff' = 2·same + 2·diff ko iteratively apply karta hai, aur akhir mein same + diff output karta hai.

en: Initialise a DP array where ⟦0⟧=0 and ⟦1⟧=1. For each i≥2, use the relation ⟦2⟧ = ⟦3⟧ + (i mod 2); this exploits that right‑shifting drops the least‑significant bit. The loop fills the array in ⟦4⟧ time and ⟦4⟧ space.
ru: Ek DP array initialise karta hai jahan ⟦0⟧=0 aur ⟦1⟧=1. Har i≥2 ke liye, relation ⟦2⟧ = ⟦3⟧ + (i mod 2) istemal karta hai; ye is baat ka faida uthata hai ke right-shifting sabse chota bit gira deti hai. Loop array ko ⟦4⟧ time aur ⟦4⟧ space mein fill karta hai.

en: A vec2 object representing the coordinates of the midpoint.
ru: Ek vec2 object jo midpoint ke coordinates ko represent karta hai.

en: bool – true if N equals the sum of its digits each raised to the power of the digit count; otherwise false.
ru: bool – true agar N apne digits ke sum ke barabar ho, jahan har digit digit-count ki power tak raise ho; warna false.

en: To determine the minimum number of character changes needed to ensure that the input string alternates between two distinct characters.
ru: Ye determine karne ke liye ke input string ko do distinct characters ke darmiyan alternate karne ke liye zaroori minimum character changes kitni hain.
